```text
func newConfigShowCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var projectOnly bool
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use: "show [repo]", Short: "Print the effective global or project configuration",
		Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			if !projectOnly && len(args) == 0 {
				source := app.Cfg.Source
				if source == "" {
					source = "built-in defaults (no config.toml)"
				}
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "# source: %s\n", config.Contract(source))
				return toml.NewEncoder(app.Out).Encode(app.Cfg)
			}
			root, err := resolveSetupRepo(app, args)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			project, err := projectconfig.Load(root, legacyProjectLayer(root))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for _, layer := range project.Layers {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "# project source: %s\n", config.Contract(layer))
			}
			for _, diagnostic := range project.Diagnostics {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "# %s: %s\n", diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Message)
			}
			return toml.NewEncoder(app.Out).Encode(project.Effective)
		},
	}
	cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&projectOnly, "project", false, "show the current/selected repository overlay")
	cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)
	return cmd
}
```

```text
---
description: Record dev-cli dependencies, upstream preview status, documentation constraints, and behavior that is intentionally incomplete.
authority: project-and-upstream
status: evolving
verified_on: 2026-08-31
tested_with: Claude Code 2.1.250
---

# Compatibility and known limitations

This page separates graceful degradation from real limitations. Reverify it whenever command/runtime code or version-sensitive Claude Code documentation changes.

## dev-cli capability matrix

| Capability | Dependency | Without it |
|---|---|---|
| core repository/task/worktree operations | Git | unavailable; Git is the only hard runtime dependency |
| rich grouped runtime and agent activity | Herdr server + CLI | `auto` tries tmux, then Zellij, then none |
| named terminal session | tmux or compatible Zellij | `none` preserves core behavior and shell navigation |
| GitHub pull requests/remotes | `gh` authenticated | branch still pushes when Git works; browser/manual flow may be needed |
| GitLab merge requests/remotes | `glab` authenticated | same graceful fallback |
| repository bootstrap publishing | authenticated `gh` or `glab` | local repository/scaffold still works; the wizard explains how to log in |
| remote repository snapshot template | Git plus network/authentication for the source | validation fails before the destination is created and rendered URL userinfo is redacted; local templates still work |
| setup-capable project skills | skills provider plus the entrypoint interpreter | unselected skills are skipped; selected required setup fails before scaffold mutation when its interpreter is unavailable; a clone acquired first is retained |
| staged lazygit message prefill | a lazygit version that reads `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` | files remain staged and dev prints the suggested message; normal Git commit remains available |
| worktree dependency setup | ecosystem manager (`uv`, npm, Cargo, etc.) | plan reports the missing tool and keeps the checkout |
| remote portable-file plan/apply | Git, SSH target running a compatible `dev`, matching existing clone/branch/commit; apply also needs a verified machine UUID pin | fails before content is sent or leaves the target unchanged; no clone/task fallback is inferred |
| interactive dashboard | terminal input/output | bare `dev` prints the plain task list when piped |
| repository-note search | linked `modernc.org/sqlite` with FTS5 | no external `sqlite3` executable is required |
| terminal multiplexing on Windows | tmux/Zellij/Herdr (POSIX only) | Windows always uses the `none` backend; `dev shell-init powershell` still moves the shell |
| in-place self-update | standalone install (not Homebrew/Scoop/`go install`) | `dev upgrade` delegates to the package manager's upgrade command instead |

## Confirmed project limitations

### Note search and filesystem durability vary by text and platform

Latin note queries use term-wise prefix FTS and SQLite ranking. Non-ASCII queries use literal term-wise substring matching because SQLite's `unicode61` tokenizer does not segment arbitrary CJK substrings; those results do not use the same FTS ranking.

Note writes sync the file and atomically rename it on every supported platform. Unix also syncs the containing directory after rename/delete. The Windows implementation cannot provide that directory-fsync step, so a sudden power loss has a narrower durability guarantee there. Concurrent mutations by cooperating `dev` processes are serialized and each Markdown replacement is atomic; arbitrary external writers do not participate in that lock.

### Pull-request completion is not tracked automatically

`dev done --pr` pushes and opens a pull/merge request, then leaves the task, runtime, and worktree unchanged because review owns integration. Current `dev sweep` does not query the forge to infer that a request later merged. Verify integration and finish/reconcile deliberately; do not assume remote merge implies local DONE.

### Agent session capture is reserved, not wired

The task schema has an `AgentSession` field and Herdr inventory can expose live agent session IDs. The production start/park/resume path does not yet capture or attach that ID. Treat the field and live inventory as observability/future integration, not a promise that `dev resume` restores the coding-agent conversation.

### Built-in forge cache TTL differs from generated config

`dev config init` writes `forge.cache_ttl = "15m"`. With no config file, the current built-in `Forge.CacheTTL` zero value means an existing valid cache is not rejected by age; explicit `r` refresh still replaces it. Freshness also requires a source fingerprint matching the configured GH/GL hosts and Azure targets, so an endpoint change is never hidden by the zero TTL. Legacy source-less caches remain available only through explicit `--cached` and are reported stale. Run `config init` or set the TTL when freshness matters.

Older generated configs may contain `forge.remote_limit = 100`. The field is
still accepted, but complete forge inventories are now paginated and it no
longer caps synchronization. `dev config init` no longer writes it. The
`--limit` flag on `dev repo remote` limits rendered matches after the complete
inventory has been searched.

### Lazygit staged-message prefill is best effort
```

```text
		Long: `Make a parked task hot again.

Warm tasks still have their worktree, so this just reopens a runtime session.

cold is safe in the first place — the branch, not the directory, is the task's

		Long: `Retire local execution state after a change has been integrated.

Run this from outside the target worktree and runtime. dev re-resolves every
covering session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for
runtime closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes a linked worktree
without force. A task is deleted only after every requested cleanup step works.

Unknown runtime status fails closed. An external coordinator may acknowledge it
with --close-unknown; working, blocked and waiting agents are never overridden.`,
		Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			ctx := ctxOf()

			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := ensureArtifactsFinalized(app, target.CheckoutPath); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			service := &retirement.Service{Runtime: rt, Tasks: app.Tasks}
			result, err := service.Retire(ctx, retirement.Request{
				Target: target,
				Safety: retirement.Options{
					CloseUnknown: closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: assumeNoRuntime, Timeout: timeout,
				},
				DeleteBranch: deleteBranch,
			})
			if err != nil {

			}

			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s  %d session(s) closed\n", style.label("runtime"), result.ClosedSessions)
			if result.RemovedWorktree {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   %s removed\n", style.label("worktree"))
			}
			if result.DeletedBranch {
```

```text
func TestLoadOverlay(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "config.toml")
	os.WriteFile(path, []byte(`
[paths]
worktree_root = "/mnt/fast/wt"
worktree_path = "{{worktree_root}}/{{repo|lower}}/{{branch|slug}}"

[runtime]
backend = "tmux"

[worktree]
include = [".env", "config/secrets.json"]
post_create = ["uv sync"]
provision_timeout = "90s"
`), 0o644)

	cfg, err := Load(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Load: %v", err)
	}
	if cfg.Runtime.Backend != "tmux" {
		t.Errorf("backend = %q", cfg.Runtime.Backend)
	}
	if cfg.Worktree.PostCreate.Auto || len(cfg.Worktree.PostCreate.Commands) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("post_create = %+v", cfg.Worktree.PostCreate)
	}
	if cfg.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout.Seconds() != 90 {
		t.Errorf("provision_timeout = %v", cfg.Worktree.ProvisionTimeout)
	}
	// Defaults for untouched sections survive the overlay.
	if cfg.Paths.TriesRoot == "" {

	}
	if got != "/mnt/fast/wt/myrepo/feat-auth" {
		t.Errorf("WorktreePathFor = %q", got)
	}
}
```

```text
BINARY  := dev
PREFIX  ?= $(HOME)/.local
# Only vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tags are version authority; any other tag in the
# repository (a backup or rescue marker, say) must never become --version.
VERSION ?= $(shell git describe --tags --match 'v[0-9]*' --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo dev)
LDFLAGS := -s -w -X github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/cli.Version=$(VERSION)

.PHONY: build install test lint fmt vet skill-sync skill-check e2e clean all

all: fmt vet test build

build:
	go build -ldflags '$(LDFLAGS)' -o $(BINARY) ./cmd/dev

# Install the binary and its agent skill together, so the documentation an
# agent reads always matches the binary that is on PATH.
install: build
	install -d $(PREFIX)/bin
	install -m 0755 $(BINARY) $(PREFIX)/bin/$(BINARY)
	$(PREFIX)/bin/$(BINARY) skill install
	@echo
	@echo 'Add to your shell rc:  eval "$$($(PREFIX)/bin/$(BINARY) shell-init zsh)"'

test:
	go test ./...

vet:
	go vet ./...

fmt:
	gofmt -w .

# Regenerate the skill's command reference from the live command tree.
skill-sync: build
	./$(BINARY) skill sync
	$(MAKE) build

# Fail if the checked-in command reference has drifted from the command tree.
# Wire this into CI and a pre-push hook.
skill-check: build
	./$(BINARY) skill sync --check

e2e: build
	./scripts/e2e.sh

clean:
	rm -f $(BINARY)
	go clean -testcache
```

Here is the complete picture of dev-cli's caching.

## 1. Where cache code lives, what is cached, on-disk layout

**XDG root resolution** — `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-combine-fzf/internal/config/paths.go`

```go
func CacheHome() string { return xdgDir("XDG_CACHE_HOME", ".cache") }  // line 34
func Contract(p string) string   // display-only ~ collapsing
```

Everything lands under `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/`. There is **no single "cache package"** — caching is per-domain, each package owning its own file format:

| Cache | On-disk path | Owner file | Format | Freshness policy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| forge/remote inventory | `dev/remotes.json` | `internal/forge/cache.go` | JSON, `version: 2`, 0600, atomic rename | `forge.cache_ttl` (config); **default zero → never expires by age**, only manual `r` / `--refresh`. Also invalidated by `SourceID` mismatch |
| fleet host snapshots | `dev/fleet/v1/<slug>.json` | `internal/fleet/cache.go` | JSON, `version: 1`, 0600, atomic rename | `fleet.defaults.cache_ttl`, default **15m** (`internal/fleet/config.go:64`); also keyed by `EndpointID` sha256 |
| disk usage (sizes) | `dev/sizes-v1.json` | `internal/diskusage/cache.go` | JSON `{version, entries: map[key]Usage}`, 0600, atomic rename | TTL **10 minutes**, hard-coded at `internal/cli/app.go:99` |
| note FTS index | `dev/notes.db` (+ `-wal`, `-shm`) | `internal/note/index.go`, `internal/note/service.go` | SQLite FTS5 (`notes_fts` virtual table + `note_manifest`), 0600, WAL, `busy_timeout(5000)` | **No TTL** — content-addressed: `Index.Current(notes)` compares a per-note `Revision()` fingerprint manifest; `Ensure` rebuilds only on mismatch |
| gitignore templates | `dev/gitignore/<Name>` | `internal/ignore/ignore.go` | raw template bodies | **No TTL** — network first, cache is a fallback (`SourceRemote` → `SourceCache` → `SourceBundled`) |
| license templates | `dev/licenses/<key>.json` | `internal/licenses/licenses.go` | JSON `{key,name,body}`, 0644 | Same network → cache → bundled order, no TTL |
| release check | `dev/release-check.json` | `internal/cli/version.go` | JSON | `releaseCheckTTL = 24h` (line 22). **Note: not listed in `cacheItems()`, so `dev cache list`/`clear all` ignores it** |

Explicitly *not* cache: `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/` (tasks, assets, notes Markdown, `stats.db`) — the `dev cache` long help calls this out.

**Public API — `internal/forge/cache.go`**
```go
const CacheVersion = 2
type Cache struct {
    Version   int; SourceID string; FetchedAt time.Time; Complete bool
    Providers map[Kind]ProviderStatus; Repos []RemoteRepo
}
type ProviderStatus struct { FetchedAt time.Time; Complete bool; Error string }

func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool)   // fresh+complete only
func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool)                      // stale-while-revalidate
func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool
func (c Cache) FreshFor(maxAge time.Duration, sourceID string) bool
func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error
func SaveCacheState(path string, cache Cache) error
func SaveCacheStateContext(ctx context.Context, path string, cache Cache) error
func CacheExists(path string) bool
```
Hardening: `maxCacheBytes = 32<<20`, `maxCachedRepos = 100_000`, `maxCacheClockSkew = 5m`, full `validCache` string/NUL/length validation, per-path `sync.Map` write mutex so a superseded generation cannot rename after a newer one.

## 4. Consumers and performance

**Cache consumers**
- forge `remotes.json`: TUI REMOTE tab (`internal/cli/tui.go:1139-1215` — `cachedRemoteRows`, `cachedRemotes`, `cachedRemotesForRepoRows`, `cachedRemotesAny`), `dev repo remote [--cached|--refresh]` (`internal/cli/repo.go:535+`), `dev repo context` (`internal/cli/repo_context.go:178-232`, maps cache → `assessment.AuthorityCache` + Fresh/Stale + Complete/Partial provenance)
- fleet cache: `dev fleet` (`internal/cli/fleet.go:581,593,732`), TUI FLEET seed via `cachedFleetRows`
- sizes cache: `dev repo list --sizes`, `dev tries --sizes`, `dev summary --sizes`, TUI SIZE column (`internal/cli/sizes.go`, `internal/cli/tui.go:426`)
- notes.db: `dev note search`, TUI note search
- gitignore/licenses: `dev gitignore`, `dev repo create` scaffolding (`repo_initializers.go:117,149`, `repo_scaffold.go:124`, `gitignore.go:85`)
- release-check.json: `dev version --check`, the once-a-day upgrade nudge (deferred until after first TUI frame via `AfterFirstView`)

**Repo discovery is NOT cached** — `repo.Discover` (`internal/repo/discover.go:90`) does a live `filepath.WalkDir` per invocation, bounded by `MaxDepth: 3` and a `skipDirs` set (`node_modules`, `.venv`, `target`, `vendor`, `Library`, …). `CompletionOptions{Fast: true}` skips per-repo git subprocesses "for interactive latency".

**Measured performance notes in the code**
- `internal/cli/tui.go:969-972`: "Each repo needs status, worktree and remote subprocesses. Serialising ~3*56 git processes was the measured **4.2s** startup bottleneck; eight workers brings that down without forking hundreds at once."
- `internal/cli/repo.go:103`: `dev repo list` reuses the TUI collector — "The old serial status/worktree/remote loop measured **4.2s over 56 repos**."
- `internal/inventory/inventory.go:107-109`: git probes run concurrently because "a machine with dozens of tasks would otherwise make `dev ls` feel slow"; limiter default 8.
- `internal/cli/tui.go:1137-1141`: `cachedRemoteRows` "reads only the private JSON cache — no repository scan or subprocess — so it is safe on the startup path."
- Timeouts: forge probe 10s (`forge.go:264`), GitHub/GitLab list 60s (`github.go:117`, `gitlab.go:128`), Azure 15s (`azuredevops.go:139`), gitignore/licenses HTTP 15s; fleet connect 15s / command 5m defaults with `MaxParallel` semaphore.
- Startup orchestration: `internal/cli/tui_load.go` fans tasks/runtime/repos out as `tuiFuture`s sharing one `inventory.NewLimiter(8)`; `internal/cli/tui.go:333-341` seeds REMOTE/FLEET from disk cache before any network work.
- Instrumentation: `internal/perftrace/trace.go` — `StageCacheAccepted`, `SourceCache`/`SourceLive`, `FreshnessFresh`/`FreshnessStale`, ops `TUICacheRemoteRead`/`TUICacheFleetRead`/`TUIProducerTasks|Repos|Tries`; applied in `internal/tui/readiness.go:164` and `internal/tui/model.go:357-368`.
- Benchmarks exist at `internal/forge/cache_benchmark_test.go` (`BenchmarkLoadCacheAny`) and `internal/cli/tui_benchmark_test.go` (`BenchmarkTUILocalLoadOrchestration`, `BenchmarkFleetSnapshotFromRepoRows`).

**Two things worth flagging**
1. `release-check.json` is written into the cache root but is absent from `cacheItems()`, so `dev cache list` and `dev cache clear all` silently skip it.
2. `Forge.CacheTTL` has no default in `config.Default()` (`internal/config/config.go:283`), so with no `config.toml` a complete remote cache is never age-rejected; `dev config init` writes `cache_ttl = "15m"` (`internal/cli/config.go:227`).

| Location | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `internal/repo/discover.go:294,303-315` | `&AmbiguousError{Ref, Candidates []Repo}` — **already carries the candidate list** |
| `internal/task/store.go:446-449` | `fmt.Errorf("%q is ambiguous: %s", ref, strings.Join(names, ", "))` — candidates flattened into a string, not structured |
| `internal/experiment/service.go:71-97` | `AmbiguousError{Ref, Candidates []Candidate}` + `ErrAmbiguous`; produced by `selectResolved` (`inventory.go:389`) and `inventory.go:146` |
| `internal/catalog/registry.go:20-40, 276-341` | `ErrAmbiguous`, `AmbiguousMatchError{Observation, CandidateIDs, Reason}`, `func ambiguous(...)` |
| `internal/cli/note.go:391` | `fmt.Errorf("note prefix %q is ambiguous (%d matches)", ...)` — **count only, candidates discarded** |
| `internal/cli/fleet.go:230` | `fmt.Errorf("remote repository %q is ambiguous", query)` — **candidates discarded entirely** |
| `internal/localfiles/target.go:24,150` | `TargetAmbiguous` / `&TargetError{Code: TargetAmbiguous}` |
| `internal/fleet/sync.go:35,107` | `SyncAmbiguous` state |
| `internal/repocontext/report.go:229,614-680` | `FleetMatchAmbiguous`, `forge-match-ambiguous`, `fleet-match-ambiguous` |
| `internal/experiment/transitions.go:935-937` | pending-move ambiguity |
| `internal/diskusage/usage.go:140` | ambiguous totals |

**"Pick the first match" sites:**
- `internal/cli/fleet.go:182` — `request.RemoteIdentity = repository.RemoteIdentities[0]`
- `internal/repo/discover.go:275-280` — exact `Name`/`Display()`/`Path` match returns the *first* hit in iteration order without checking for a second exact match
- `internal/task/store.go:427-431` — same: first exact `ID`/`Branch` match wins
- `internal/experiment/inventory.go:345-360` — tiered exact matchers, but each tier funnels into `selectResolved`, so ties do error rather than silently pick

## 5. fzf / external-binary detection

**No fzf anywhere.** `grep -ri fzf --include=*.go` returns nothing. No `exec.Command("fzf")`, no `FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS`, no vendored fuzzy-finder library.

### The reusable optional-binary patterns

**Best seam — `internal/forge/forge.go:445-449`** (testable indirection):
```go
var (
    probeRunner   cliRunner = run
    publishRunner cliRunner = runCombined
    lookupPath              = exec.LookPath
)
```
consumed at `internal/forge/forge.go:493`:
```go
_, err := lookupPath(bin)
```
`cliRunner` is `func(context.Context, string, string, ...string) (string, error)` (forge.go:441). Tests swap `lookupPath` wholesale (`internal/forge/publishing_test.go:12-151`). **This is the pattern to copy for an `fzf` detector.**

**Runtime backends — `internal/runtime/runtime.go:189-192`:**
```go
func haveBinary(name string) bool { _, err := exec.LookPath(name); return err == nil }
```
plus `Runtime.Available() bool` on the interface (runtime.go:120) and `runInteractive(ctx, bin string, args ...string) error` (runtime.go:197) which wires `os.Stdin/Stdout/Stderr` straight through — **exactly the plumbing an fzf child process needs.**

**Other `exec.LookPath` call sites** (all inline, no helper):
- `internal/cli/doctor.go:123` (`gh`, `glab` loop), `doctor.go:138` (`az`)
- `internal/cli/edit.go:149` (editor: `$VISUAL → $EDITOR → nvim → vim → vi`)
- `internal/cli/git.go:187` (`gitleaks`), `git.go:191` (`pre-commit`)
- `internal/cli/tui.go:1098` (TUI custom tool validation)
- `internal/cli/repo_skills.go:124`, `repo_create.go:531,540`, `repo_builtin_skill_setup.go:53,56`
- `internal/wt/ecosystem.go:182` (`Ecosystem.Tool`)
- `internal/agentskill/agentskill.go:502,505,512,515` (`skills` then `npx` fallback — a clean two-tier fallback example)

### Already-existing fuzzy selection UI (in-process, not fzf)

`internal/tui/` is a full Bubble Tea dashboard with live `/`-filtering:
- `func matches(haystack, query string) bool` — `internal/tui/rows.go:203`. **Term-wise AND-of-substrings** (splits on whitespace, order-independent), not prefix, not fzf-style subsequence. This is the semantics an fzf integration should stay consistent with.
- `func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` — `internal/tui/model.go:2702`
- `func (m Model) prompt(md mode, value, placeholder string) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` — `internal/tui/model.go:2693`
- Filter applied per-view at `model.go:923,937,961,1038,1060,1125`; `skillMatches` and `RemoteRow`/`row.matches` variants
- Bubble Tea + `bubbles/textinput` are already dependencies (used in `prompt.go` too), so an in-process picker is viable without adding fzf.

### Summary of the highest-value fzf insertion points

1. `start_wizard.go:promptStartRepository` — replaces a hand-rolled numbered list.
2. All `prompter.choice(...)` sites — the alias map is already a candidate set with labels.
3. `*AmbiguousError` handlers where `Candidates` already exists (`repo`, `experiment`, `catalog`) — offer a picker instead of erroring.
4. The 15 `cobra.CompletionFunc`s in `completion.go` — reuse verbatim as candidate providers for a `--pick`/no-arg interactive mode.
5. Unwired arg domains: `tries *`, `graduate`, `note show/edit/delete`, `fleet open <host>`, `artifact discard`, `skill update`, `--branch`/`--base`.

## A) TUI `/` filter

### Where it lives

| Concern | File |
|---|---|
| Key `/` → enter filter mode | `/Users/zhouhanru/Worktrees/dev-cli/feat-combine-fzf/internal/tui/model.go:1993` (in `updateList`) |
| Live typing / esc / enter | `internal/tui/model.go:2702` — `func (m Model) updateFilter(msg tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` |
| Generic matcher | `internal/tui/rows.go:203` — `func matches(haystack, query string) bool` |
| Per-row search text + structured matchers | `internal/tui/rows.go`, `internal/tui/try.go`, `internal/tui/model.go:1132` |
| Size predicate | `internal/tui/size.go:89` — `func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool` |
| Render (header chip + prompt) | `internal/tui/view.go:145`, `internal/tui/view.go:795` |
| Help text | `internal/tui/overlay.go:296`, `internal/tui/view.go:1191` |

### Matching algorithm — **not fuzzy, not bubbles/list**

There is **no** `bubbles/list` usage at all; the dashboard is a hand-rolled `tea.Model` with its own cursors and windowing. The only bubbles component used is `textinput` (`internal/tui/model.go:12`).

The algorithm is **AND-of-substrings over whitespace-separated terms, case-insensitive**:

```go
// internal/tui/rows.go:203
func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
	query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
	if query == "" { return true }
	for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
		if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) { return false }
	}
	return true
}
```

Documented rationale in-file: term-wise rather than one substring so `"auth api"` matches `"api token auth"` (test: `internal/tui/tui_test.go:1482` `TestFilterMatchesTermsOutOfOrder`; live-narrowing test at `:1457`).

On top of that, three of the six views implement **structured `key:value` prefix filters** in their own `matches` methods (each falls through to plain substring when the term has no recognized key):

- `func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool` — `internal/tui/rows.go:151` — keys `tag:`, `remote:`, `size:`, `kind:`
- `func (r TryRow) matches(query string) bool` — `internal/tui/try.go:81` — keys `tag:`, `phase:`, `where:`, `git:`, `remote:`, `size:`
- `func (r RemoteRow) matches(query string) bool` — `internal/tui/rows.go:260` — keys `vis:` / `visibility:` (exact equality)
- `func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool` — `internal/tui/model.go:1132` — keys `scope:`, `agent:`, `update:`

`size:` accepts `>=`, `<=`, `>`, `<`, `=` plus a `humanize.ParseBytes` value (e.g. `size:>500MB`).

### Fields matched against (the "haystack" builders)

- `func (r RepoRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:113`: repo display name, branch, topology summary + every branch/upstream, catalog asset kind/note/tags, every task title + branch, every checkout path/branch/ownership. Lowercased.
- `func taskSearchText(r inventory.Row) string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:191`: task title, repo, branch, next, note, state.
- `func (r FleetRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:241`: host, state, error, repo name/display/path/branch/status summary/remote identities.
- `func (r RemoteRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:253`: forge kind, name, full name, description, visibility, default branch, local name, local kind.
- `func (r TryRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/try.go:73`: `Item.SearchText()`, `Where()`, runtime, runtime status, topology summary, local-only branches, upstream remotes.

### Filter application points

`internal/tui/model.go`: `visibleTasks()` (:912), `visibleRepos()` (:932), `visibleTries()` (:958), `visibleRepoItems()` (:980), `visibleRemotes()` (:1035), `visibleFleet()` (:1055), `visibleSkills()` (:1123). Filtering is recomputed on every render — there is no cached/indexed match state.

Behavioral details:
- `/` seeds the input with the existing filter and focuses it (`model.go:1993-1998`).
- `esc` in filter mode **clears** the filter; `enter` keeps it and returns to list mode.
- Every keystroke sets `m.setAt(0)` (cursor resets to top).
- `esc` in list mode clears filter+state before it means quit (`model.go:1961`).
- `0` clears filter and state selectors (`model.go:2057`).
- The filter is a single `string` field on `Model` (`model.go:282`), **shared across all six views** — switching tabs keeps the query.

### Second, separate `/` — note search (different algorithm)

Inside the note browser (`modeNoteBrowse`), `/` opens `modeNoteSearch` (`internal/tui/model.go` ~:2385) which calls `Actions.Notes.Search` → `internal/note/index.go:231` `func (i *Index) Search(query, repositoryID string, limit int) ([]Hit, error)` — SQLite **FTS5** prefix matching for Latin text, with a literal term-wise `LIKE` fallback for non-ASCII (`searchLiteral`, `internal/note/index.go:284`). This is the only ranked search in the repo.

### Actions available on the selected row

`func (m Model) openSelected() tea.Cmd` — `internal/tui/model.go:2823` dispatches by view to `Actions.Open` / `OpenRepo` / `OpenCheckout` / `TryOpen` / `OpenRemote` / `OpenFleet`.

Key table from `updateList` (`internal/tui/model.go:1947`+) and the reserved-key map in `internal/config/config.go:231`:

`enter`/`o` open · `n` new Try / add note · `N` browse notes · `space` expand worktrees / Try action menu · `m` repo metadata form · `y` copy repo context · `p` park task · `c` next-action / clone remote / check skills · `s` start worktree task · `d` start direct task · `u` update skill · `e` edit config (or `remotes.toml` in FLEET) · `O`/`R` sort/reverse · `H` heatmap · `a` toggle hidden history · `1`/`2`/`3` state filters · `0` clear · `r` reload · `?` help · plus any configured `[[tui.tools]]` key via `func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd`.

### `internal/cli/tui.go` callback injection

`func runTUI(app *App) error` — `internal/cli/tui.go:246`. It builds closures (`reload`, `reloadRepos`, `reloadRemote`, `reloadFleet`, `reloadSkills`, `reloadTries`, `openResolved`) then assembles a single `tui.Actions` literal at `internal/cli/tui.go:327-687`, and runs:

```go
model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
```

The `Actions` struct is defined at `internal/tui/model.go:67-146` — the TUI owns zero domain logic, every capability is a `func` field (sub-structs `RepoActions`, `TryActions`, `NoteActions`, `SizeActions`, `LocalActions`). Display policy is passed as plain values: `RepoColumns`, `RepoSort`, `RepoReverse`, `Tools`.

Live config reload is `Actions.ReloadConfig` (`internal/cli/tui.go:665`) returning `tui.ConfigUpdate` (`internal/tui/model.go:157-166`) with an `Apply func()` commit hook — **note there is no filter-related field in `ConfigUpdate`**, so anything new that must live-reload has to be added there too.

`grep -rni "fuzzy|fzf|levenshtein|smartcase"` across `*.go`, `*.md`, `go.sum` returns only:
- `TODO.md:56` — **`### P3 · S — Television / fzf channel`**: "A `tv` channel over `dev ls --json` for fuzzy-picking a task, and an `fzf` fallback… the TUI covers it, but a picker composes better with other tools." (This is presumably why the branch is `feat-combine-fzf`.)
- `.claude/plans/init-plan.md:312` — same idea in the original plan.
- Two unrelated comment uses ("fuzzy names", "fuzzy LIKE semantics").

**No** `sahilm/fuzzy`, **no** `lithammer/fuzzysearch`, **no** `charmbracelet/bubbles/list` filtering (only `bubbles/textinput`), **no** vendored fuzzy scorer. `go.sum` has no fuzzy library either. If fuzzy matching is wanted, it must be added as a new dependency or written in-repo.

### Defaults → TOML overlay → validation

```go
func Default() Config          // internal/config/config.go:283
func Load(path string) (Config, error)  // :322
func (c Config) Validate() error        // :345
```

`Load` semantics (:322-341):
1. Start from `Default()` — the defaults **are** the zero-config behavior; the struct's Go zero values are never used directly.
2. `toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)` (BurntSushi) decodes **on top of** the default value. Sections not present keep their defaults (tested by `TestLoadOverlay`, `internal/config/config_test.go:117`). Note: slices are *replaced*, not merged.
3. `fs.ErrNotExist` → return defaults, **no error** ("dev must be useful with zero setup").
4. Any other decode error → wrapped error.
5. `md.Undecoded()` non-empty → **warning to stderr only, not a failure** — "so a newer config still works on an older dev". This is the forward-compat contract.
6. `cfg.Source = path`, then `return cfg, cfg.Validate()`.

`Validate()` checks, in order: runtime backend enum; non-empty `worktree_path` + template renders against `probeVars()` (:459); `LocalFiles.Limits().Validate()` (delegated to `internal/safefile/limits.go`, which enforces compiled ceilings that config can only lower); bootstrap layout enum + non-negative depth; non-negative deprecated `forge.remote_limit`; Azure org URL shape via `validAzureDevOpsOrganization` (:438) + non-empty project + duplicate detection; worktree strategy enum (global + per-ecosystem); `tui.repos.columns` against a whitelist map (:403); `tui.repos.sort` enum; `tui.tools` key/run required, key not in `reservedKeys` (:231), no duplicate keys.

### Exact pattern for adding a new config section/field

The reference commit is `37a681a` ("feat: ship Windows binaries and let dev update itself"), which added the whole `[update]` section. The mechanical steps:

1. **`internal/config/config.go`** — add the field to `type Config` with a `toml:"..."` tag; define the section struct immediately below with a doc comment explaining *why* (house style is a rationale comment, not a restatement).
2. **`internal/config/config.go` `Default()`** (:283) — add the baseline value. Required if the useful default is not the Go zero value (e.g. `Update: Update{Check: true}`).
3. **`internal/config/config.go` `Validate()`** (:345) — add enum/range/duplicate checks. Return `fmt.Errorf("section.field %q: want …", value)` — errors name the exact TOML path.
4. If the value needs an "unset means X" fallback, add an `Effective*()` method next to `EffectiveTools`/`EffectiveRepoSort` rather than mutating in `Load`.
5. If it needs a non-scalar TOML shape, add an `UnmarshalTOML`/`MarshalTOML` pair in **`internal/config/types.go`** (pattern: `PostCreate`, `Duration`).
6. **`internal/cli/config.go`** — extend `const starterConfig` (:145, ends :316) with an annotated block; if it needs detected machine values, add a `@@TOKEN@@` placeholder and a `strings.NewReplacer` pair in `func renderStarterConfig(l config.Layout) string` (:120), plus a field on `config.Layout` / `DetectLayout()` in `internal/config/detect.go`.
7. If it's TUI-facing and must apply without restart, thread it through `tui.ConfigUpdate` (`internal/tui/model.go:157`) and `Actions.ReloadConfig` (`internal/cli/tui.go:665`).
8. `dev config show` needs **no** change — `internal/cli/config_scaffolds.go:15` does `toml.NewEncoder(app.Out).Encode(app.Cfg)`, so the field appears automatically (which also means an exported field with no `toml:"-"` will show up in every user's `config show` output).
9. Docs: the section table in `docs/reference/commands-config.md:249-256`, and the zh-TW mirror `docs/reference/commands-config.zh-TW.md`.
10. Tests: add to `internal/config/config_test.go` following `TestLoadOverlay` / `TestRepoTableConfigValidation` / `TestTUIToolConfigAndReservedKeys`.

### Where config fields are documented

- **`docs/reference/commands-config.md`** — `## Configuration` at :230, section table at :249-256 (one row per top-level TOML table). zh-TW mirror at `docs/reference/commands-config.zh-TW.md`.
- **`docs/reference/compatibility.md`** — capability matrix + a dedicated `### Built-in forge cache TTL differs from generated config` (:49) documenting `Default()`-vs-`config init` divergence and the deprecated `forge.remote_limit`. zh-TW mirror exists.
- **`internal/cli/config.go` `const starterConfig`** (:145-316) — the richest prose documentation; every section is annotated inline and emitted by `dev config init`.
- **`internal/skill/dev-cli/SKILL.md`** — :218 (`paths.scan_roots` / `paths.repo_paths`), :260 (`.dev-cli/config.toml`), :289 (REMOTE `/` filters), :365 (`[[tui.tools]]`). References under `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/` (`commands.md` is generated by `dev skill sync`).
- **`docs/guides/tui-repos-bootstrap.md`** — :46, :57, :92, :147 document the `/` filter and its structured keys per view. zh-TW mirror.
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/llms.txt` / `docs/llms-full.txt` (generated aggregate), `docs/guides/worktrees-provisioning.md`, `docs/guides/remote-fleet.md`.

### How config compatibility is tested

There is **no** golden-file / fixture-corpus compatibility suite and no `testdata/` directory anywhere in the repo. Compatibility is enforced by four mechanisms:

1. **Forward compat by design** — unknown keys warn on stderr and are dropped (`Load`, `internal/config/config.go:334-338`); `TestLoadMissingFileUsesDefaults` (`config_test.go:80`) pins the missing-file path.
2. **Overlay preservation** — `TestLoadOverlay` (`config_test.go:117`) writes a partial TOML and asserts untouched sections keep defaults ("Defaults for untouched sections survive the overlay").
3. **Generated-template round-trip** — `TestConfigInitDetectsAndRefusesOverwrite` (`internal/cli/cli_test.go:863`) runs `dev config init --stdout`, writes the output, and asserts `config.Load` parses it AND that `EffectiveTools()` == 4, `Bootstrap.Layout == "flat"`, `Forge.CacheTTL != 0` — i.e. the generated file must round-trip through the loader. This is the strongest compat test.
4. **Per-section validation tests** — `TestAzureDevOpsTargetsLoadAndValidate` (:160), `TestAzureDevOpsTargetsRejectInvalidAndDuplicateValues` (:181), `TestValidateRejectsBadBackendAndTemplate` (:204), `TestBootstrapPolicyValidation` (:224), `TestTUIToolConfigAndReservedKeys` (:241), `TestDependencyStrategyConfigValidation` (:273), `TestRepoTableConfigValidation` (:292), `TestNotePathsSeparateDurableSourceFromCache` (:317), `TestNotesRepoColumnIsOptionalButValid` (:332); `local_files_test.go` pins that config can lower but **never raise** compiled safefile ceilings.
5. Deprecated-field policy: keep the struct field, keep it accepted by `Validate`, stop writing it in `config init`, and document it in `docs/reference/compatibility.md` (see `Forge.RemoteLimit`, `internal/config/config.go:129`).

CI/dev loop: `Makefile` — `make test` (`go test ./...`), `make vet`, `make skill-check` (`dev skill sync --check`, fails if the checked-in command reference drifted from the live command tree).

### Project-level overlay (separate package)

`internal/projectconfig` handles repo-local `.dev-cli/config.toml` (legacy `.dev.toml`): `func Load(repoRoot string, legacy *Layer) (Result, error)` at `internal/projectconfig/load.go:41`, with `Override`, `LocalFilesOverride`, `WorktreeOverride`, `RepoOverride`, `SetupOverride`, `Layer`, `Diagnostic`, `Result` in `internal/projectconfig/types.go`, plus a content-hash trust store in `trust.go`. Deliberately a *constrained* subset — a repo cannot raise host ceilings.

## Optional external tool integration — existing patterns

There are **three distinct patterns**, and notably the forge integration is *not* an enable/disable flag.

**1. `[[tui.tools]]` — the closest match to "optional external tool" (config-declared, probed, degrades in the UI).** This is the pattern to copy for an fzf integration.

- Config: `config.Tool{Key, Name, Run, Interactive}` (`internal/config/config.go:214`), `DefaultTools()` (:252), `EffectiveTools()` (:264) — "a configured list replaces the defaults entirely — a partial merge would make it unclear which bindings are in effect."
- Key-collision guard: `reservedKeys` map (:231) + `ReservedKey()` (:244), enforced in `Validate()` (:419-434). **Note `/` is reserved as `"filter"` at :234.**
- Resolution: `func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool` — `internal/cli/tui.go:1039`. Builds argv as `[$SHELL, -c, run]`, or `[$SHELL, -lic, 'eval "$1"', "dev-tui-tool", run]` when `Interactive` (so shell aliases/functions work).
- Availability probe: `func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool` (`internal/cli/tui.go:1066`) and `func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool` (:1070) — expands a leading `$VAR`, uses `exec.LookPath` for non-interactive, or a 3s-timeout `$SHELL -lic 'command -v "$1"'` for interactive.
- Model side: `type Tool struct { Key, Name string; Command []string; Probe func(context.Context) bool; Availability ToolAvailability; NeedsRepo bool }` (`internal/tui/model.go:195-207`) with a tri-state `ToolUnknown/ToolAvailable/ToolUnavailable` (:186-192). **Probing is asynchronous — `View` never launches a process** (`model.go:661`, `:2894`, `:2926`). `m.Tools()` filters the footer to available tools; test at `internal/tui/tui_test.go:1582`.
- Doctor surface: `internal/cli/doctor.go:123` uses `exec.LookPath` to report missing tools; `dev tui tools` subcommand at `internal/cli/tui.go:92`.

**2. Forge CLIs (`gh`/`glab`/`az`) — capability-detected, *not* flag-gated.** There is no `forge.enabled`. The interface is `Available() bool` (`internal/forge/forge.go:51`), implemented per forge via a `have(bin)` / `lookupPath` helper (`internal/forge/forge.go:448`, `azuredevops.go:56`). `Probe`/`ProbeAll`/`ProbeForge` (`forge.go:236/248/284`) return a `Readiness{Installed, Authenticated}`; `Preferred()` (:213) picks the first available. The **only** config gate is Azure DevOps, and it is opt-in *because it needs arguments*, not because it's optional: `[[forge.azure_devops]]` with `organization`/`project` (`internal/config/config.go:137`). `forge.cache_ttl` is the other knob.

**3. Boolean feature toggles** — the simple enable/disable pattern: `Stats.Sampler bool`, `Stats.WakaTime bool` + `Stats.WakaTimeConfig string` (`config.go:272-279`), and `Update.Check bool` (`config.go:36`) with an env-var override (`DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK`). The WakaTime one is the cleanest template for "optional external tool with a config path": a `bool` to enable plus a `string` pointing at the tool's own config, defaulted in `Default()`.

Relevant project stance (`TODO.md`, "Deliberately not doing → Installing dependencies"): *"`dev doctor` reports what is missing and what degrades; it will not install anything."*

### Matching algorithm — **not fuzzy, not bubbles/list**

There is **no** `bubbles/list` usage at all; the dashboard is a hand-rolled `tea.Model` with its own cursors and windowing. The only bubbles component used is `textinput` (`internal/tui/model.go:12`).

The algorithm is **AND-of-substrings over whitespace-separated terms, case-insensitive**:

```go
// internal/tui/rows.go:203
func matches(haystack, query string) bool {
	query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
	if query == "" { return true }
	for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
		if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) { return false }
	}
	return true
}
```

Documented rationale in-file: term-wise rather than one substring so `"auth api"` matches `"api token auth"` (test: `internal/tui/tui_test.go:1482` `TestFilterMatchesTermsOutOfOrder`; live-narrowing test at `:1457`).

On top of that, three of the six views implement **structured `key:value` prefix filters** in their own `matches` methods (each falls through to plain substring when the term has no recognized key):

- `func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool` — `internal/tui/rows.go:151` — keys `tag:`, `remote:`, `size:`, `kind:`
- `func (r TryRow) matches(query string) bool` — `internal/tui/try.go:81` — keys `tag:`, `phase:`, `where:`, `git:`, `remote:`, `size:`
- `func (r RemoteRow) matches(query string) bool` — `internal/tui/rows.go:260` — keys `vis:` / `visibility:` (exact equality)
- `func skillMatches(row agentskill.Skill, query string) bool` — `internal/tui/model.go:1132` — keys `scope:`, `agent:`, `update:`

`size:` accepts `&gt;=`, `&lt;=`, `&gt;`, `&lt;`, `=` plus a `humanize.ParseBytes` value (e.g. `size:&gt;500MB`).

### Fields matched against (the "haystack" builders)

- `func (r RepoRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:113`: repo display name, branch, topology summary + every branch/upstream, catalog asset kind/note/tags, every task title + branch, every checkout path/branch/ownership. Lowercased.
- `func taskSearchText(r inventory.Row) string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:191`: task title, repo, branch, next, note, state.
- `func (r FleetRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:241`: host, state, error, repo name/display/path/branch/status summary/remote identities.
- `func (r RemoteRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/rows.go:253`: forge kind, name, full name, description, visibility, default branch, local name, local kind.
- `func (r TryRow) searchText() string` — `internal/tui/try.go:73`: `Item.SearchText()`, `Where()`, runtime, runtime status, topology summary, local-only branches, upstream remotes.

### Filter application points

`internal/tui/model.go`: `visibleTasks()` (:912), `visibleRepos()` (:932), `visibleTries()` (:958), `visibleRepoItems()` (:980), `visibleRemotes()` (:1035), `visibleFleet()` (:1055), `visibleSkills()` (:1123). Filtering is recomputed on every render — there is no cached/indexed match state.

Behavioral details:
- `/` seeds the input with the existing filter and focuses it (`model.go:1993-1998`).
- `esc` in filter mode **clears** the filter; `enter` keeps it and returns to list mode.
- Every keystroke sets `m.setAt(0)` (cursor resets to top).
- `esc` in list mode clears filter+state before it means quit (`model.go:1961`).
- `0` clears filter and state selectors (`model.go:2057`).
- The filter is a single `string` field on `Model` (`model.go:282`), **shared across all six views** — switching tabs keeps the query.

### Second, separate `/` — note search (different algorithm)

Inside the note browser (`modeNoteBrowse`), `/` opens `modeNoteSearch` (`internal/tui/model.go` ~:2385) which calls `Actions.Notes.Search` → `internal/note/index.go:231` `func (i *Index) Search(query, repositoryID string, limit int) ([]Hit, error)` — SQLite **FTS5** prefix matching for Latin text, with a literal term-wise `LIKE` fallback for non-ASCII (`searchLiteral`, `internal/note/index.go:284`). This is the only ranked search in the repo.

### Actions available on the selected row

`func (m Model) openSelected() tea.Cmd` — `internal/tui/model.go:2823` dispatches by view to `Actions.Open` / `OpenRepo` / `OpenCheckout` / `TryOpen` / `OpenRemote` / `OpenFleet`.

Key table from `updateList` (`internal/tui/model.go:1947`+) and the reserved-key map in `internal/config/config.go:231`:

`enter`/`o` open · `n` new Try / add note · `N` browse notes · `space` expand worktrees / Try action menu · `m` repo metadata form · `y` copy repo context · `p` park task · `c` next-action / clone remote / check skills · `s` start worktree task · `d` start direct task · `u` update skill · `e` edit config (or `remotes.toml` in FLEET) · `O`/`R` sort/reverse · `H` heatmap · `a` toggle hidden history · `1`/`2`/`3` state filters · `0` clear · `r` reload · `?` help · plus any configured `[[tui.tools]]` key via `func (m Model) launchTool(key string) tea.Cmd`.

### `internal/cli/tui.go` callback injection

`func runTUI(app *App) error` — `internal/cli/tui.go:246`. It builds closures (`reload`, `reloadRepos`, `reloadRemote`, `reloadFleet`, `reloadSkills`, `reloadTries`, `openResolved`) then assembles a single `tui.Actions` literal at `internal/cli/tui.go:327-687`, and runs:

```go
model := tui.New(actions, nil, nil).WithTrace(app.trace).WithContext(runCtx).BeginLoading()
final, err := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen()).Run()
```

The `Actions` struct is defined at `internal/tui/model.go:67-146` — the TUI owns zero domain logic, every capability is a `func` field (sub-structs `RepoActions`, `TryActions`, `NoteActions`, `SizeActions`, `LocalActions`). Display policy is passed as plain values: `RepoColumns`, `RepoSort`, `RepoReverse`, `Tools`.

Live config reload is `Actions.ReloadConfig` (`internal/cli/tui.go:665`) returning `tui.ConfigUpdate` (`internal/tui/model.go:157-166`) with an `Apply func()` commit hook — **note there is no filter-related field in `ConfigUpdate`**, so anything new that must live-reload has to be added there too.

`grep -rni "fuzzy|fzf|levenshtein|smartcase"` across `*.go`, `*.md`, `go.sum` returns only:

### Defaults → TOML overlay → validation

```go
func Default() Config          // internal/config/config.go:283
func Load(path string) (Config, error)  // :322
func (c Config) Validate() error        // :345
```

`Load` semantics (:322-341):
1. Start from `Default()` — the defaults **are** the zero-config behavior; the struct's Go zero values are never used directly.
2. `toml.DecodeFile(path, &amp;cfg)` (BurntSushi) decodes **on top of** the default value. Sections not present keep their defaults (tested by `TestLoadOverlay`, `internal/config/config_test.go:117`). Note: slices are *replaced*, not merged.
3. `fs.ErrNotExist` → return defaults, **no error** ("dev must be useful with zero setup").
4. Any other decode error → wrapped error.
5. `md.Undecoded()` non-empty → **warning to stderr only, not a failure** — "so a newer config still works on an older dev". This is the forward-compat contract.
6. `cfg.Source = path`, then `return cfg, cfg.Validate()`.

`Validate()` checks, in order: runtime backend enum; non-empty `worktree_path` + template renders against `probeVars()` (:459); `LocalFiles.Limits().Validate()` (delegated to `internal/safefile/limits.go`, which enforces compiled ceilings that config can only lower); bootstrap layout enum + non-negative depth; non-negative deprecated `forge.remote_limit`; Azure org URL shape via `validAzureDevOpsOrganization` (:438) + non-empty project + duplicate detection; worktree strategy enum (global + per-ecosystem); `tui.repos.columns` against a whitelist map (:403); `tui.repos.sort` enum; `tui.tools` key/run required, key not in `reservedKeys` (:231), no duplicate keys.

### Exact pattern for adding a new config section/field

The reference commit is `37a681a` ("feat: ship Windows binaries and let dev update itself"), which added the whole `[update]` section. The mechanical steps:

1. **`internal/config/config.go`** — add the field to `type Config` with a `toml:"..."` tag; define the section struct immediately below with a doc comment explaining *why* (house style is a rationale comment, not a restatement).
2. **`internal/config/config.go` `Default()`** (:283) — add the baseline value. Required if the useful default is not the Go zero value (e.g. `Update: Update{Check: true}`).
3. **`internal/config/config.go` `Validate()`** (:345) — add enum/range/duplicate checks. Return `fmt.Errorf("section.field %q: want …", value)` — errors name the exact TOML path.
4. If the value needs an "unset means X" fallback, add an `Effective*()` method next to `EffectiveTools`/`EffectiveRepoSort` rather than mutating in `Load`.
5. If it needs a non-scalar TOML shape, add an `UnmarshalTOML`/`MarshalTOML` pair in **`internal/config/types.go`** (pattern: `PostCreate`, `Duration`).
6. **`internal/cli/config.go`** — extend `const starterConfig` (:145, ends :316) with an annotated block; if it needs detected machine values, add a `@@TOKEN@@` placeholder and a `strings.NewReplacer` pair in `func renderStarterConfig(l config.Layout) string` (:120), plus a field on `config.Layout` / `DetectLayout()` in `internal/config/detect.go`.
7. If it's TUI-facing and must apply without restart, thread it through `tui.ConfigUpdate` (`internal/tui/model.go:157`) and `Actions.ReloadConfig` (`internal/cli/tui.go:665`).
8. `dev config show` needs **no** change — `internal/cli/config_scaffolds.go:15` does `toml.NewEncoder(app.Out).Encode(app.Cfg)`, so the field appears automatically (which also means an exported field with no `toml:"-"` will show up in every user's `config show` output).
9. Docs: the section table in `docs/reference/commands-config.md:249-256`, and the zh-TW mirror `docs/reference/commands-config.zh-TW.md`.
10. Tests: add to `internal/config/config_test.go` following `TestLoadOverlay` / `TestRepoTableConfigValidation` / `TestTUIToolConfigAndReservedKeys`.

### Where config fields are documented

- **`docs/reference/commands-config.md`** — `## Configuration` at :230, section table at :249-256 (one row per top-level TOML table). zh-TW mirror at `docs/reference/commands-config.zh-TW.md`.
- **`docs/reference/compatibility.md`** — capability matrix + a dedicated `### Built-in forge cache TTL differs from generated config` (:49) documenting `Default()`-vs-`config init` divergence and the deprecated `forge.remote_limit`. zh-TW mirror exists.
- **`internal/cli/config.go` `const starterConfig`** (:145-316) — the richest prose documentation; every section is annotated inline and emitted by `dev config init`.
- **`internal/skill/dev-cli/SKILL.md`** — :218 (`paths.scan_roots` / `paths.repo_paths`), :260 (`.dev-cli/config.toml`), :289 (REMOTE `/` filters), :365 (`[[tui.tools]]`). References under `internal/skill/dev-cli/references/` (`commands.md` is generated by `dev skill sync`).
- **`docs/guides/tui-repos-bootstrap.md`** — :46, :57, :92, :147 document the `/` filter and its structured keys per view. zh-TW mirror.
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/llms.txt` / `docs/llms-full.txt` (generated aggregate), `docs/guides/worktrees-provisioning.md`, `docs/guides/remote-fleet.md`.

### How config compatibility is tested

There is **no** golden-file / fixture-corpus compatibility suite and no `testdata/` directory anywhere in the repo. Compatibility is enforced by four mechanisms:

1. **Forward compat by design** — unknown keys warn on stderr and are dropped (`Load`, `internal/config/config.go:334-338`); `TestLoadMissingFileUsesDefaults` (`config_test.go:80`) pins the missing-file path.
2. **Overlay preservation** — `TestLoadOverlay` (`config_test.go:117`) writes a partial TOML and asserts untouched sections keep defaults ("Defaults for untouched sections survive the overlay").
3. **Generated-template round-trip** — `TestConfigInitDetectsAndRefusesOverwrite` (`internal/cli/cli_test.go:863`) runs `dev config init --stdout`, writes the output, and asserts `config.Load` parses it AND that `EffectiveTools()` == 4, `Bootstrap.Layout == "flat"`, `Forge.CacheTTL != 0` — i.e. the generated file must round-trip through the loader. This is the strongest compat test.
4. **Per-section validation tests** — `TestAzureDevOpsTargetsLoadAndValidate` (:160), `TestAzureDevOpsTargetsRejectInvalidAndDuplicateValues` (:181), `TestValidateRejectsBadBackendAndTemplate` (:204), `TestBootstrapPolicyValidation` (:224), `TestTUIToolConfigAndReservedKeys` (:241), `TestDependencyStrategyConfigValidation` (:273), `TestRepoTableConfigValidation` (:292), `TestNotePathsSeparateDurableSourceFromCache` (:317), `TestNotesRepoColumnIsOptionalButValid` (:332); `local_files_test.go` pins that config can lower but **never raise** compiled safefile ceilings.
5. Deprecated-field policy: keep the struct field, keep it accepted by `Validate`, stop writing it in `config init`, and document it in `docs/reference/compatibility.md` (see `Forge.RemoteLimit`, `internal/config/config.go:129`).

CI/dev loop: `Makefile` — `make test` (`go test ./...`), `make vet`, `make skill-check` (`dev skill sync --check`, fails if the checked-in command reference drifted from the live command tree).

### Project-level overlay (separate package)

`internal/projectconfig` handles repo-local `.dev-cli/config.toml` (legacy `.dev.toml`): `func Load(repoRoot string, legacy *Layer) (Result, error)` at `internal/projectconfig/load.go:41`, with `Override`, `LocalFilesOverride`, `WorktreeOverride`, `RepoOverride`, `SetupOverride`, `Layer`, `Diagnostic`, `Result` in `internal/projectconfig/types.go`, plus a content-hash trust store in `trust.go`. Deliberately a *constrained* subset — a repo cannot raise host ceilings.

## Optional external tool integration — existing patterns

There are **three distinct patterns**, and notably the forge integration is *not* an enable/disable flag.

**1. `[[tui.tools]]` — the closest match to "optional external tool" (config-declared, probed, degrades in the UI).** This is the pattern to copy for an fzf integration.

- Config: `config.Tool{Key, Name, Run, Interactive}` (`internal/config/config.go:214`), `DefaultTools()` (:252), `EffectiveTools()` (:264) — "a configured list replaces the defaults entirely — a partial merge would make it unclear which bindings are in effect."
- Key-collision guard: `reservedKeys` map (:231) + `ReservedKey()` (:244), enforced in `Validate()` (:419-434). **Note `/` is reserved as `"filter"` at :234.**
- Resolution: `func externalTools(app *App) []tui.Tool` — `internal/cli/tui.go:1039`. Builds argv as `[$SHELL, -c, run]`, or `[$SHELL, -lic, 'eval "$1"', "dev-tui-tool", run]` when `Interactive` (so shell aliases/functions work).
- Availability probe: `func commandRunnable(run string, interactive bool) func(context.Context) bool` (`internal/cli/tui.go:1066`) and `func checkCommandRunnable(ctx context.Context, run string, interactive bool) bool` (:1070) — expands a leading `$VAR`, uses `exec.LookPath` for non-interactive, or a 3s-timeout `$SHELL -lic 'command -v "$1"'` for interactive.
- Model side: `type Tool struct { Key, Name string; Command []string; Probe func(context.Context) bool; Availability ToolAvailability; NeedsRepo bool }` (`internal/tui/model.go:195-207`) with a tri-state `ToolUnknown/ToolAvailable/ToolUnavailable` (:186-192). **Probing is asynchronous — `View` never launches a process** (`model.go:661`, `:2894`, `:2926`). `m.Tools()` filters the footer to available tools; test at `internal/tui/tui_test.go:1582`.
- Doctor surface: `internal/cli/doctor.go:123` uses `exec.LookPath` to report missing tools; `dev tui tools` subcommand at `internal/cli/tui.go:92`.

**2. Forge CLIs (`gh`/`glab`/`az`) — capability-detected, *not* flag-gated.** There is no `forge.enabled`. The interface is `Available() bool` (`internal/forge/forge.go:51`), implemented per forge via a `have(bin)` / `lookupPath` helper (`internal/forge/forge.go:448`, `azuredevops.go:56`). `Probe`/`ProbeAll`/`ProbeForge` (`forge.go:236/248/284`) return a `Readiness{Installed, Authenticated}`; `Preferred()` (:213) picks the first available. The **only** config gate is Azure DevOps, and it is opt-in *because it needs arguments*, not because it's optional: `[[forge.azure_devops]]` with `organization`/`project` (`internal/config/config.go:137`). `forge.cache_ttl` is the other knob.

**3. Boolean feature toggles** — the simple enable/disable pattern: `Stats.Sampler bool`, `Stats.WakaTime bool` + `Stats.WakaTimeConfig string` (`config.go:272-279`), and `Update.Check bool` (`config.go:36`) with an env-var override (`DEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK`). The WakaTime one is the cleanest template for "optional external tool with a config path": a `bool` to enable plus a `string` pointing at the tool's own config, defaulted in `Default()`.

Relevant project stance (`TODO.md`, "Deliberately not doing → Installing dependencies"): *"`dev doctor` reports what is missing and what degrades; it will not install anything."*</result>

```text
119		in, inputOK := input.(fileDescriptor)

131	func newLineEditorModel(prefix string) lineEditorModel {
132		input := textinput.New()
133		input.Prompt = prefix
134		input.Focus()
135		return lineEditorModel{prefix: prefix, input: input}
136	}

138	func (m lineEditorModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
139		return textinput.Blink
140	}
141	
142	func (m lineEditorModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
143		if key, ok := message.(tea.KeyMsg); ok {
144			switch key.Type {
145			case tea.KeyEnter:
146				m.done = true
147				m.input.Blur()
148				return m, tea.Quit
149			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
150				m.done = true
151				m.canceled = true
152				m.input.Blur()
153				return m, tea.Quit
154			}
155		}
156	
157		var command tea.Cmd
158		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
159		return m, command
160	}
161	
162	func (m lineEditorModel) View() string {
163		if m.done {
164			// Leave the completed prompt in scrollback. Bubble Tea clears the line
165			// containing its cursor when the renderer stops, so the trailing newline
166			// moves that cursor below the submitted value first.
167			return m.prefix + m.input.Value() + "\n"
168		}
169		return m.input.View()
170	}
171	
172	func runLineEditor(input io.Reader, output io.Writer, prefix string) (string, error) {
173		final, err := tea.NewProgram(
174			newLineEditorModel(prefix),
175			tea.WithInput(input),
176			tea.WithOutput(output),
177		).Run()
178		if err != nil {
179			return "", fmt.Errorf("prompt editor: %w", err)
180		}
181		model, ok := final.(lineEditorModel)
182		if !ok {
183			return "", errors.New("prompt editor returned an unexpected model")
184		}
185		if model.canceled {
186			return "", errPromptCanceled
187		}
188		return model.input.Value(), nil
189	}
```

```text
13	)
14	
15	func promptStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, p *prompter, req startRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
16		if req.RepoExplicit {
17			return resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, req.RepoRef)
18		}
19	
20		var current repo.Repo
21		if r, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, ""); err == nil {
22			current = r
23		}
24		if current.Path == "" {
25			all, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
26			if err != nil {
27				return repo.Repo{}, err
28			}
29			candidates := all[:0:0]
30			for _, r := range all {
31				if r.HasGit && !r.Bare {
32					candidates = append(candidates, r)
33				}
34			}
35			all = candidates
36			if len(all) == 0 {
37				return repo.Repo{}, errors.New("no non-bare repositories found under paths.scan_roots")
38			}
39			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Repositories:"))
40			for i, r := range all {
41				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %d) %-24s %s\n", i+1, r.Display(), config.Contract(r.Path))
42			}
43			fallback := ""
44			if len(all) == 1 {
45				fallback = all[0].Display()
46			}
47			for {
48				value, err := p.line("Repository", fallback)
49				if err != nil {
50					return repo.Repo{}, err
51				}
52				if value == "" {
53					fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("repository is required"))
54					continue
55				}
56				var index int
57				if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(value, "%d", &index); err == nil && index > 0 && index <= len(all) {
58					return all[index-1], nil
59				}
60				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), value)
61				if err == nil {
62					return r, nil
63				}
64				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(err.Error()))
65			}
66		}
67	
68		for {
69			value, err := p.line("Repository", current.Display())
70			if err != nil {
71				return repo.Repo{}, err
72			}
73			if value == current.Display() || value == current.Name || value == current.Path {
74				return current, nil
75			}
76			r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), value)
77			if err == nil {
78				return r, nil
79			}
80			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(err.Error()))
81		}
82	}
83	
84	func runStartWizard(ctx context.Context, app *App, req startRequest) (*startSpec, bool, error) {
85		p := newPrompter(app)
86		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Start a tracked change stream"))
87	
88		r, err := promptStartRepository(ctx, app, p, req)
89		if err != nil {
90			return nil, false, err
91		}
92		if r.Bare {
93			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a bare repository and cannot host a task checkout", r.Display())
94		}
95		req.RepoRef, req.RepoExplicit = r.Path, true
96	
97		for strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
98			req.Name, err = p.line("Task name", "")
99			if err != nil {
100				return nil, false, err
101			}
102			if strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
103				fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("task name is required"))
104			}
105		}
106	
107		for {
108			if !req.ModeExplicit {
109				fallback := "worktree"
110				switch req.Mode {
111				case task.ModeBranch:
112					fallback = "branch-only"
113				case task.ModeDirect:
114					fallback = "direct"
115				}
116				selected, err := p.choice("Mode (w=worktree, b=branch-only, d=direct)", fallback,
117					"worktree (w), branch-only (b), direct (d)", map[string]string{
118						"w": "worktree", "worktree": "worktree",
119						"b": "branch-only", "branch": "branch-only", "branch-only": "branch-only",
120						"d": "direct", "direct": "direct",
121					})
122				if err != nil {
123					return nil, false, err
124				}
125				switch selected {
126				case "direct":
127					req.Mode = task.ModeDirect
128				case "branch-only":
129					req.Mode = task.ModeBranch
130				default:
131					req.Mode = task.ModeWorktree
132				}
133			}
134	
135			if req.Mode == task.ModeDirect {
136				st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
137				if statusErr != nil {
138					return nil, false, statusErr
139				}
140				req.Branch, req.Base = st.Branch, st.Branch
141			} else {
142				if !req.BranchExplicit {
143					fallback := req.Branch
144					if fallback == "" {
145						fallback = "feat/" + config.Slug(req.Name)
146					}
147					req.Branch, err = p.line("Branch", fallback)
148					if err != nil {
149						return nil, false, err
150					}
151				}
152				if !req.BaseExplicit {
153					fallback := req.Base
154					if fallback == "" {
155						fallback = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path)
156					}
157					req.Base, err = p.line("Base", fallback)
158					if err != nil {
159						return nil, false, err
160					}
161				}
162			}
163			if !req.NextExplicit {
164				req.Next, err = p.line("Next action (optional)", req.Next)
165				if err != nil {
166					return nil, false, err
167				}
168			}
169	
170			spec, buildErr := buildStartSpec(ctx, app, req)
171			if buildErr != nil {
172				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(buildErr.Error()))
173				if req.BranchExplicit || req.BaseExplicit || req.ModeExplicit {
174					return nil, false, buildErr
175				}
176				req.Branch, req.Base = "", ""
177				continue
178			}
179	
180			rt := app.Runtime()
181			checkout := spec.RepoPath
182			if spec.WorktreePath != "" {
183				checkout = spec.WorktreePath
184			}
185			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "\n"+p.style.title("Summary"))
186			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s  %s (%s)\n", p.style.label("repository"), spec.RepoName, config.Contract(spec.RepoPath))
187			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("task"), spec.Name)
188			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("mode"), spec.Mode)
189			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s      %s\n", p.style.label("branch"), spec.Branch)
190			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("base"), spec.Base)
191			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s    %s\n", p.style.label("checkout"), config.Contract(checkout))
192			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s   %s\n", p.style.label("provision"), p.style.success(fmt.Sprint(!spec.NoProvision)))
193			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s     %s\n", p.style.label("runtime"), p.style.success(rt.Name()))
194			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s       %s\n", p.style.label("focus"), fmt.Sprint(spec.Focus))
195			if spec.Run != "" {
196				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s         %s\n", p.style.label("run"), "configured for the new Herdr root pane")
197			}
198			if spec.Next != "" {
199				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("next"), spec.Next)
200			}
201	
202			confirmed, err := p.confirm("Create this task?", true)
203			if err != nil {
204				return nil, false, err
205			}
206			return spec, confirmed, nil
207		}
208	}
```

Options:
- **內建 picker（dev 自己叫 fzf）** - 缺參數或 ambiguous 時，dev 直接 spawn fzf 讓你選，選完把值填回原本的流程。start wizard 的手寫編號清單、prompter.choice、AmbiguousError 都改走同一個 picker seam。對「更快速在 CLI 填內容」最直接。
- **只做對外 candidate source** - 新增 `dev pick <domain> --json` 之類的候選輸出，再附 tv channel 定義與 shell 函式，由你自己在 shell 端組 fzf。dev 二進位不 spawn 任何 picker。
- **兩者都做** - 內建 picker + 對外 candidate source/tv channel。範圍最大，等於把 TODO P3 一起收掉。

**沒裝 fzf（或非 TTY、CI、pipe）時要怎麼退？**

Options:
- **內建 Bubble Tea picker** - 自己寫一個小的 list+filter picker（bubbletea/textinput 已是既有相依，TUI 的 matches() term-wise AND 語意可直接沿用）。fzf 只是「有就更快」，行為與可測試性不依賴外部程式。
- **退回現有行為** - 沒 fzf 就走目前的編號清單 / 現有 ambiguous 錯誤訊息。零新 UI 程式碼，但沒 fzf 的機器體驗不變。
- **要求安裝 fzf** - 沒 fzf 就報錯提示安裝。最少程式碼，但和 TODO.md「doctor 只回報、不安裝、要能 degrade」的立場衝突。

**picker 程式要寫死 fzf 還是可設定？（本機已有 fzf 0.67 / tv 0.15.6 / gum）**

Options:
- **config 可設定，預設 fzf** - 新增 `[picker]` 區塊（command / args / enabled），預設偵測 fzf。想換 tv、gum、sk 都行。沿用 [[tui.tools]] 既有的「config 宣告 + exec.LookPath 探測 + 優雅降級」模式。
- **只認 fzf** - 寫死 exec.LookPath("fzf")，不開設定面。最簡單，但之後想用 tv/gum 要改碼。

- **start wizard** - promptStartRepository 的手寫編號清單改成 picker；mode/branch/base 也走 picker（branch/base 目前連 completion 都沒有，要新增 gitx.Branches 列舉）。

```text
- `--session` — exact agent session provider:uuid (inferred from task/runtime when unique)

### `dev repo`

List, clone, create and sync repositories

```
dev repo
```

### `dev repo clone`

Clone a repository and optionally apply a setup preset

```
dev repo clone [owner/name|url|path] [flags]
```

- `--agent` — agent targets for selected project skills
- `--browse-skills` — open the upstream skills installer during setup
- `-c, --category` — category subdirectory under project_root
- `--check-in` — finish generated changes: auto, commit, stage or none
- `--description` — repository description
- `--disable` — disable a scaffold item by id (repeatable)
- `--dry-run` — show the plan without changing anything
- `--enable` — enable a scaffold item by id (repeatable)
- `--gitignore` — gitignore template (repeatable or comma-separated)
- `--handoff` — afterwards: stay, cd, open or start
- `--import-orphan-plans` — copy matching global Claude plans into the repository
- `--json` — emit a machine-readable result
- `--license` — license keyword (for example mit or apache-2.0)
- `--license-holder` — copyright holder used in the license template
- `-m, --message` — commit message for --check-in=commit or stage
- `-o, --open` — open the clone in the runtime afterwards (alias for --handoff=open)
- `--path` — exact destination path
- `--preset` — scaffold preset
- `--set` — preset input as key=value (repeatable)
- `-y, --yes` — confirm the non-interactive scaffold plan

### `dev repo context`

Print agent-ready Git, worktree, runtime and task context

```
dev repo context [repo] [flags]
```

- `--json` — emit the additive schema-v1 JSON report
- `--refresh` — refresh external forge and configured fleet observations

### `dev repo list`

List every repository under the scan roots

```
dev repo list [flags]
```

- `-c, --category` — only this category
- `--dirty` — only repositories with uncommitted changes
- `--include-tries` — include active and deprecated Try repositories
```

```text
}

func contractAll(paths []string) []string {
	out := make([]string, len(paths))
	for i, p := range paths {
		out[i] = config.Contract(p)
	}
	return out
}

func newRepoRemoteCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (
		jsonOut    bool
		cachedOnly bool
		refresh    bool
		visibility string
		limit      int
	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:     "remote [query]",
		Aliases: []string{"search"},
		Short:   "List and search repositories visible through configured forge CLIs",
		Long: `Combine repositories visible to authenticated gh and glab CLIs with any
configured Azure DevOps organization/project targets, and mark those already cloned
under paths.scan_roots.

The TUI exposes the same data in its REMOTE tab and filters it live with /.
This command is the non-interactive form for scripts, pipes and terminals where
a full-screen UI is not wanted. Fresh complete cache is reused automatically;
use --cached for an offline result or --refresh to force synchronization. The
cache is private, and forge.cache_ttl decides when it needs refresh.`,
		Args: cobra.MaximumNArgs(1),
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			var (
				rows []tui.RemoteRow
				err  error
			)
			if cachedOnly && refresh {
				return fmt.Errorf("--cached cannot be combined with --refresh")
			}
			visibility = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(visibility))
			switch visibility {
			case "", "public", "private", "internal":
			default:
				return fmt.Errorf("unknown --visibility %q: want public, private or internal", visibility)
			}
			if cachedOnly {
				var ok bool
				var cache forge.Cache
				rows, cache, ok = cachedRemotesAny(ctxOf(), app)
				if !ok {
					return fmt.Errorf("no remote cache; run `dev repo remote --refresh` once online")
				}
				if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
					app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh`")
				}
			} else if !refresh {
				var ok bool
				rows, ok = cachedRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
				if !ok {
					rows, err = collectRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
				}
			} else {
				rows, err = collectRemotes(ctxOf(), app)
			}
			// Partial results are useful when one forge is authenticated and
			// the other is not. Render them, then report the partial failure.
			if len(rows) == 0 && err != nil {
				return err
			}
			query := ""
			if len(args) == 1 {
				query = strings.ToLower(args[0])
			}
			var filtered []tui.RemoteRow
			for _, r := range rows {
				if visibility != "" && !strings.EqualFold(r.Repo.Visibility, visibility) {
					continue
				}
				hay := strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{
					string(r.Repo.Forge), r.Repo.FullName, r.Repo.Description,
					r.Repo.Visibility, r.LocalName,
				}, " "))
				matched := true
				for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
					if !strings.Contains(hay, term) {
						matched = false
						break
					}
				}
				if matched {
					filtered = append(filtered, r)
				}
			}
			sort.SliceStable(filtered, func(i, j int) bool {
				if !filtered[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.Equal(filtered[j].Repo.UpdatedAt) {
					return filtered[i].Repo.UpdatedAt.After(filtered[j].Repo.UpdatedAt)
				}
				return filtered[i].Repo.Label() < filtered[j].Repo.Label()
			})
			if limit > 0 && len(filtered) > limit {
				filtered = filtered[:limit]
			}

			if jsonOut {
				enc := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
				enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
				if encodeErr := enc.Encode(filtered); encodeErr != nil {
					return encodeErr
				}
			} else {
				t := app.newTable("FORGE", "REPOSITORY", "VIS", "LOCAL", "UPDATED", "DESCRIPTION")
				style := app.outStyle()
				for _, r := range filtered {
					local := "—"
					if r.LocalPath != "" {
						local = style.success(config.Contract(r.LocalPath))
					}
					updated := "—"
					if !r.Repo.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
						updated = r.Repo.UpdatedAt.Format("2006-01-02")
					}
					t.Add(string(r.Repo.Forge), truncate(r.Repo.FullName, 36),
						strings.ToLower(r.Repo.Visibility), truncate(local, 30), updated,
						truncate(r.Repo.Description, 50))
				}
				if t.Len() == 0 {
					fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No remote repositories match that query.")
				} else {
					t.Render(app.Out)
				}
			}
			if err != nil {
				app.warnf("partial remote results: %v", err)
			}
			return nil
		},
	}
	f := cmd.Flags()
	f.BoolVar(&jsonOut, "json", false, "emit JSON")
	f.BoolVar(&cachedOnly, "cached", false, "use the XDG cache without querying forge providers")
	f.BoolVar(&refresh, "refresh", false, "force a complete forge inventory refresh")
	f.StringVar(&visibility, "visibility", "", "filter visibility: public, private or internal")
	f.IntVar(&limit, "limit", 0, "maximum matching repositories to render (0 for all)")
	registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "visibility", fixedCompletions("public", "private", "internal"))
	return cmd
}
```
