```text
153	func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
154		manual := func() (string, error) {
155			return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
156		}
157		if !app.canPick() {
158			return manual()
159		}
160	
161		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
162		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
163		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
164			return manual()
165		}
166		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
167		for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
168			if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
169				continue
170			}
171			var details []string
172			if remote.Visibility != "" {
173				details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
174			}
175			if remote.Archived {
176				details = append(details, "archived")
177			}
178			if remote.Description != "" {
179				details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
180			}
181			items = append(items, picker.Item{
182				Value:       remote.CloneURL,
183				Label:       remote.Label(),
184				Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
185			})
186		}
187		if len(items) == 0 {
188			return manual()
189		}
190		items = append(items, picker.Item{
191			Value:       manualCloneReference,
192			Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
193			Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
194		})
195		if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
196			app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
197		}
198		result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
199		if err != nil {
200			return "", err
201		}
202		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
203			if result.Canceled {
204				return "", errPromptCanceled
205			}
206			return manual()
207		}
208		return result.Item.Value, nil
209	}

224		}

227			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err

339	func promptScaffoldPreset(p *prompter, catalog scaffold.Config, fallback string) (string, error) {
340		names := scaffoldPresetNames(catalog)
341		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Presets:"))
342		for _, name := range names {
343			preset, _ := catalog.ResolvePreset(name)
344			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %-16s %s\n", name, preset.Description)
345		}
346		for {
347			value, err := p.line("Preset", fallback)
348			if err != nil {
349				return "", err
350			}
351			if _, ok := catalog.Presets[value]; ok {
352				return value, nil
353			}
354			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning("choose one of: "+strings.Join(names, ", ")))
355		}
356	}

358	func promptScaffoldOptions(p *prompter, catalog scaffold.Config, presetName string, flags *repoBootstrapFlags) error {
359		preset, err := catalog.ResolvePreset(presetName)
360		if err != nil {
361			return err
362		}
363		for _, input := range preset.Inputs {
364			label := input.Label
365			if label == "" {
366				label = input.ID
367			}
368			fallback := parseInputDefault(input.Default)
369			switch input.Type {
370			case scaffold.InputBool:
371				value, _ := strconvParseBoolDefault(fallback)
372				chosen, err := p.confirm(label, value)
373				if err != nil {
374					return err
375				}
376				flags.set = replaceSetValue(flags.set, input.ID, fmt.Sprint(chosen))
377			case scaffold.InputChoice:
378				choices := map[string]string{}
379				for _, choice := range input.Choices {
380					choices[strings.ToLower(choice)] = choice
381				}
382				if fallback == "" && len(input.Choices) > 0 {
383					fallback = input.Choices[0]
384				}
385				value, err := p.choice(label+" ("+strings.Join(input.Choices, "/")+")", fallback,
386					strings.Join(input.Choices, ", "), choices)
387				if err != nil {
388					return err
389				}
390				flags.set = replaceSetValue(flags.set, input.ID, value)
391			default:
392				for {
393					value, err := p.line(label, fallback)
394					if err != nil {
395						return err
396					}
397					if input.IsRequired() && strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
398						fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning(label+" is required"))
399						continue
400					}
401					flags.set = replaceSetValue(flags.set, input.ID, value)
402					break
403				}
404			}
405		}
406	
407		readme := preset.Readme != nil && *preset.Readme
408		readme, err = p.confirm("Create README.md?", readme)
409		if err != nil {
410			return err
411		}
412		if presetHasItem(preset, "readme") {
413			setSelection(flags, "readme", readme)
414		}
415	
416		gitignoreFallback := strings.Join(preset.Gitignore, ",")
417		gitignore, err := p.line("Gitignore templates (comma-separated, blank for common only)", gitignoreFallback)
418		if err != nil {
419			return err
420		}
421		flags.gitignore = splitCommaValues(gitignore)
422	
423		licenseFallback := preset.License
424		if licenseFallback == "ask" || licenseFallback == "" {
425			licenseFallback = "none"
426		}
427		flags.license, err = p.line("License (none/mit/apache-2.0/...)", licenseFallback)
428		if err != nil {
429			return err
430		}
431		if flags.license != "" && flags.license != "none" {
432			flags.licenseHolder, err = p.line("License holder", flags.licenseHolder)
433			if err != nil {
434				return err
435			}
436		}
437	
438		if preset.ClaudePlans != nil || presetHasItem(preset, "claude-settings") || presetHasItem(preset, "claude-plans-directory") {
439			claudePlans := preset.ClaudePlans != nil && *preset.ClaudePlans
440			claudePlans, err = p.confirm("Keep Claude plans in .claude/plans?", claudePlans)
441			if err != nil {
442				return err
443			}
444			if presetHasItem(preset, "claude-settings") {
445				setSelection(flags, "claude-settings", claudePlans)
446			}
447			if presetHasItem(preset, "claude-plans-directory") {
448				setSelection(flags, "claude-plans-directory", claudePlans)
449			}
450		}
451	
452		if preset.AgentContract != "" || presetHasItem(preset, "agent-contract") {
453			agentContract := preset.AgentContract != "" && preset.AgentContract != "none"
454			agentContract, err = p.confirm("Create AGENTS.md guidance?", agentContract)
455			if err != nil {
456				return err
457			}
458			if presetHasItem(preset, "agent-contract") {
459				setSelection(flags, "agent-contract", agentContract)
460			}
461		}
462	
463		for _, item := range preset.Catalog {
464			selected, err := p.confirm("Enable "+item.Label+"?", item.IsDefault())
465			if err != nil {
466				return err
467			}
468			setSelection(flags, item.ID, selected)
469		}
470		if len(preset.Skills) > 0 {
471			agentDefault := catalog.DefaultAgents
472			if flags.agents != nil {
473				agentDefault = flags.agents
474			}
475			agents, err := p.line("Skill agents (comma-separated)", strings.Join(agentDefault, ","))
476			if err != nil {
477				return err
478			}
479			flags.agents = splitCommaValues(agents)
480			if len(flags.agents) == 0 {
481				return fmt.Errorf("at least one skill agent is required")
482			}
483		}
484		flags.browseSkills, err = p.confirm("Browse additional skills in the upstream installer?", flags.browseSkills)
485		return err
486	}

488	func promptUpstream(app *App, p *prompter, name string, flags *repoBootstrapFlags) error {
489		create, err := p.confirm("Create a GitHub/GitLab upstream?", flags.remote)
490		if err != nil || !create {
491			flags.remote = false
492			return err
493		}
494		ready := forge.ProbeAll(ctxOf())
495		var available []forge.Readiness
496		for _, candidate := range ready {
497			if candidate.Ready() {
498				available = append(available, candidate)
499			} else {
500				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s: %s (%s)\n", candidate.Forge, candidate.Status, candidate.Action)
501			}
502		}
503		if len(available) == 0 {
504			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("no authenticated GitHub or GitLab CLI is ready; creating locally only"))
505			flags.remote = false
506			return nil
507		}
508		selected := available[0].Forge
509		if len(available) > 1 {
510			choices := map[string]string{"github": "github", "gh": "github", "gitlab": "gitlab", "gl": "gitlab"}
511			choice, err := p.choice("Forge (github/gitlab)", string(selected), "github, gitlab", choices)
512			if err != nil {
513				return err
514			}
515			selected = forge.Kind(choice)
516		}
517		flags.remote = true
518		flags.forge = string(selected)
519		flags.namespace, err = p.line("Owner / organization / namespace (optional)", flags.namespace)
520		if err != nil {
521			return err
522		}
523		flags.visibility, err = p.choice("Visibility (private/public/internal)", "private",
524			"private, public, internal", map[string]string{
525				"private": "private", "public": "public", "internal": "internal",
526			})
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		flags.push, err = p.confirm("Push the initial branch?", true)
531		_ = name
532		return err
533	}

538			"open": "open", "o": "open", "start": "start", "t": "start",
539		})

544			"commit": "commit", "c": "commit",
545			"stage": "stage", "s": "stage",
546			"none": "none", "n": "none",
547		})
548	}

550	func presetInitialCheckIn(preset scaffold.Preset) string {
551		if preset.InitialCheckIn != "" {
552			return preset.InitialCheckIn
553		}
554		if preset.InitialCommit == nil || *preset.InitialCommit {
555			return string(repoCheckInCommit)
556		}
557		return string(repoCheckInNone)
558	}

560	func repoWizardCustomizationSelected(flags repoBootstrapFlags) bool {
561		return flags.template != "" || flags.templateRef != "" || flags.templateSubdir != "" ||
562			flags.gitignore != nil || flags.license != "" || flags.licenseHolder != "" ||
563			len(flags.set) > 0 || len(flags.enable) > 0 || len(flags.disable) > 0 ||
564			flags.agents != nil || flags.browseSkills || flags.importOrphans
565	}
566	
567	func presetRequiresWizardInput(preset scaffold.Preset) bool {
568		for _, input := range preset.Inputs {
569			if input.IsRequired() && strings.TrimSpace(parseInputDefault(input.Default)) == "" {
570				return true
571			}
572		}
573		return false
574	}

576	func renderRepoWorkflowSummary(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest) {
577		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().title("Repository workflow"))
578		if template := repoTemplateSummary(request.Template); template != nil {
579			selection := template.Source
580			if template.Ref != "" {
581				selection += "@" + template.Ref
582			}
583			if template.Subdir != "" {
584				selection += "//" + template.Subdir
585			}
586			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  template   %s (%d files)\n", selection, template.Files)
587			renderRepoTemplateFilePreview(app, request.Template)
588		}
589		checkIn, message := plannedRepoCheckIn(request)
590		if message == "" {
591			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  check-in   %s\n", checkIn)
592		} else {

618	func replaceSetValue(values []string, key, value string) []string {
619		prefix := key + "="
620		result := values[:0]
621		for _, existing := range values {
622			if !strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
623				result = append(result, existing)
624			}
625		}
626		return append(result, prefix+value)
627	}
628	
629	func removeString(values []string, remove string) []string {
630		result := values[:0]
631		for _, value := range values {
632			if value != remove {
633				result = append(result, value)
634			}
635		}
636		return result
637	}

639	func splitCommaValues(value string) []string {
640		var result []string
641		for _, part := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
642			if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(part); trimmed != "" {
643				result = append(result, trimmed)
644			}
645		}
646		return result
647	}

652		}
```

```text
17	func promptStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, p *prompter, req startRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
18		if req.RepoExplicit {
19			return resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, req.RepoRef)

21

32				return selected, nil
33			}
34		}
35		if current.Path == "" {
36			all, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())

42				if r.HasGit && !r.Bare {
43					candidates = append(candidates, r)

45			}

50			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Repositories:"))

53			}
54			fallback := ""
55			if len(all) == 1 {
56				fallback = all[0].Display()

58			for {
59				value, err := p.line("Repository", fallback)
60				if err != nil {
61					return repo.Repo{}, err
62				}
63				if value == "" {
64					fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("repository is required"))
65					continue
66				}
67				var index int

97	func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
98		discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
99		if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
100			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
101		}
102	
103		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
104		byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
105		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
106		add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
107			if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
108				return
109			}
110			identity := repository.RealPath
111			if identity == "" {
112				identity = repository.Path
113			}
114			identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
115			if seen[identity] {
116				return
117			}
118			seen[identity] = true
119			byPath[repository.Path] = repository
120			items = append(items, picker.Item{
121				Value:       repository.Path,
122				Label:       repository.Display(),
123				Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
124			})
125		}
126		add(current)
127		for _, repository := range discovered {
128			add(repository)
129		}
130		if len(items) == 0 {
131			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
132		}
133		items = append(items, picker.Item{
134			Value:       manualStartRepository,
135			Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
136			Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
137		})
138	
139		result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
142		}
143		if result.Canceled {
144			return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
145		}
146		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
147			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
148		}
149		selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
150		if !ok {
151			return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
152		}
153		resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
154		if err != nil {
155			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
156		}
157		return resolved, true, nil
158	}

160	func runStartWizard(ctx context.Context, app *App, req startRequest) (*startSpec, bool, error) {
161		p := newPrompter(app)
162		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Start a tracked change stream"))
163	
164		r, err := promptStartRepository(ctx, app, p, req)
165		if err != nil {
166			return nil, false, err
167		}
168		if r.Bare {
169			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a bare repository and cannot host a task checkout", r.Display())
170		}
171		req.RepoRef, req.RepoExplicit = r.Path, true
172	
173		for strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
174			req.Name, err = p.line("Task name", "")

181		}
182	
183		for {
184			if !req.ModeExplicit {

188					fallback = "branch-only"
189				case task.ModeDirect:
190					fallback = "direct"
191				}
192				selected, err := p.choice("Mode (w=worktree, b=branch-only, d=direct)", fallback,
193					"worktree (w), branch-only (b), direct (d)", map[string]string{
194						"w": "worktree", "worktree": "worktree",
195						"b": "branch-only", "branch": "branch-only", "branch-only": "branch-only",
196						"d": "direct", "direct": "direct",
197					})
198				if err != nil {
199					return nil, false, err
200				}
201				switch selected {
202				case "direct":
203					req.Mode = task.ModeDirect
204				case "branch-only":
205					req.Mode = task.ModeBranch
206				default:
207					req.Mode = task.ModeWorktree
208				}
209			}
210	
211			if req.Mode == task.ModeDirect {
212				st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
213				if statusErr != nil {
214					return nil, false, statusErr
215				}
216				req.Branch, req.Base = st.Branch, st.Branch
217			} else {
218				if !req.BranchExplicit {
219					fallback := req.Branch
220					if fallback == "" {
221						fallback = "feat/" + config.Slug(req.Name)

223					req.Branch, err = p.line("Branch", fallback)

225						return nil, false, err
226					}
227				}
228				if !req.BaseExplicit {
229					fallback := req.Base

234					if err != nil {
235						return nil, false, err
236					}
237				}
238			}
239			if !req.NextExplicit {
240				req.Next, err = p.line("Next action (optional)", req.Next)
241				if err != nil {
242					return nil, false, err
243				}
244			}
245	
246			spec, buildErr := buildStartSpec(ctx, app, req)
247			if buildErr != nil {
248				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(buildErr.Error()))
249				if req.BranchExplicit || req.BaseExplicit || req.ModeExplicit {
250					return nil, false, buildErr

252				req.Branch, req.Base = "", ""

255	
256			rt := app.Runtime()
```

```text
+func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
+	manual := func() (string, error) {
+		return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
+	}
+	if !app.canPick() {
+		return manual()
+	}
+
+	cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
+	sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})
+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
+		app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
+	}
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
+		if result.Canceled {
+			return "", errPromptCanceled
+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil
+}

+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}
```

```text
1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
```

```text
13	const defaultVisibleRows = 10
14	
15	type builtinModel struct {
16		prompt   string
17		input    textinput.Model
18		items    []Item
19		visible  []int
20		cursor   int
21		offset   int
22		rows     int
23		width    int

28	
29	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
30		input := textinput.New()
31		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
32		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
33		input.Focus()
34		model := builtinModel{
35			prompt: request.Prompt,
36			input:  input,
37			items:  append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
38			rows:   defaultVisibleRows,
39		}
40		model.refilter()
41		return model
42	}
43	
44	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
45		return textinput.Blink
46	}
47	
48	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
49		switch msg := message.(type) {
50		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
51			m.width = msg.Width
52			if available := msg.Height - 3; available > 0 && available < defaultVisibleRows {
53				m.rows = available
54			} else {
55				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
56			}
57			m.keepVisible()
58			return m, nil
59		case tea.KeyMsg:
60			switch msg.Type {
61			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
62				m.done = true
63				m.canceled = true
64				m.input.Blur()
65				return m, tea.Quit
66			case tea.KeyEnter:
67				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
68					return m, nil
69				}
70				m.done = true
71				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
72				m.input.Blur()
73				return m, tea.Quit
74			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
75				m.move(-1)
76				return m, nil
77			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
78				m.move(1)
79				return m, nil
80			}
81		}
82	
83		var command tea.Cmd
84		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
85		m.refilter()
86		return m, command
87	}
88	
89	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
90		if m.done {
91			return "\n"
92		}
93		var out strings.Builder
94		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
95		out.WriteByte('\n')
96		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
97			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
98			return out.String()
99		}
100		end := m.offset + m.rows
101		if end > len(m.visible) {
102			end = len(m.visible)
103		}
104		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
105			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
106			marker := "  "
107			if position == m.cursor {
108				marker = "> "
109			}
110			line := marker + item.Label
111			if item.Description != "" {
112				line += "  " + item.Description
113			}
114			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
115			out.WriteByte('\n')
116		}
117		return out.String()
118	}
119	
120	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
121		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
122		for index, item := range m.items {
123			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
124				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
125			}
126		}
127		m.cursor = 0
128		m.offset = 0
129	}
130	
131	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
132		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
133			return
134		}
135		m.cursor += delta
136		if m.cursor < 0 {
137			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
138		}
139		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
140			m.cursor = 0
141		}
142		m.keepVisible()
143	}
144	
145	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
146		if m.rows <= 0 {
147			m.rows = 1
148		}
149		if m.cursor < m.offset {
150			m.offset = m.cursor
151		}
152		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
153			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
154		}
155	}
156	
157	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
158		if width <= 0 {
159			return value
160		}
161		runes := []rune(value)
162		if len(runes) <= width {
163			return value
164		}
165		if width == 1 {
166			return "…"
167		}
168		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
169	}
170	
171	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
172		program := tea.NewProgram(
173			newBuiltinModel(request),
174			tea.WithInput(s.in),
175			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
176			tea.WithContext(ctx),
177		)
178		final, err := program.Run()
179		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
180			return Result{}, ctxErr
181		}
182		if err != nil {
183			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
184		}
185		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
186		if !ok {
187			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
188		}
189		if model.canceled {
190			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
191		}
192		if !model.done {
193			return Result{}, nil
194		}
195		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
196	}
```

```text
1	// Package textmatch provides the small query language shared by interactive
2	// lists. It deliberately matches terms rather than assigning fuzzy scores so
3	// filtering stays predictable across dev's built-in interfaces.
4	package textmatch
5	
6	import "strings"
7	
8	// Terms reports whether every whitespace-separated query term appears in the
9	// haystack, case-insensitively and in any order. An empty query matches all.
10	func Terms(haystack, query string) bool {
11		haystack = strings.ToLower(haystack)
12		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
13		for term := range strings.FieldsSeq(query) {
14			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
15				return false
16			}
17		}
18		return true
19	}
```

```text
15	// their deterministic line-oriented fallback for pipes and tests.
16	func (a *App) pick(ctx context.Context, request picker.Request) (picker.Result, bool, error) {
17		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
18			return picker.Result{}, false, nil
19		}
20		if a.pickerSelect != nil {
21			result, err := a.pickerSelect(ctx, request)
22			return result, true, err
23		}
24		if !a.canPick() {
25			return picker.Result{}, false, nil
26		}
27		result, err := picker.New(a.In, a.Out, a.Err, a.Cfg.Picker.Command).Select(ctx, request)
28		return result, true, err
29	}
```

```text
14	
15	type builtinModel struct {

17		input    textinput.Model

29	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
30		input := textinput.New()
31		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
32		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
33		input.Focus()
34		model := builtinModel{
35			prompt: request.Prompt,
36			input:  input,
37			items:  append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
38			rows:   defaultVisibleRows,
39		}
40		model.refilter()
41		return model
42	}
43	
44	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
45		return textinput.Blink
46	}
47	
48	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
49		switch msg := message.(type) {
50		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
51			m.width = msg.Width
52			if available := msg.Height - 3; available > 0 && available < defaultVisibleRows {
53				m.rows = available
54			} else {
55				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
56			}
57			m.keepVisible()
58			return m, nil
59		case tea.KeyMsg:
60			switch msg.Type {
61			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
62				m.done = true
63				m.canceled = true
64				m.input.Blur()
65				return m, tea.Quit
66			case tea.KeyEnter:
67				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
68					return m, nil
69				}
70				m.done = true
71				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
72				m.input.Blur()
73				return m, tea.Quit
74			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
75				m.move(-1)
76				return m, nil
77			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
78				m.move(1)
79				return m, nil
80			}
81		}
82	
83		var command tea.Cmd
84		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
85		m.refilter()
86		return m, command
87	}
88	
89	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
90		if m.done {
91			return "\n"
92		}
93		var out strings.Builder
94		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
95		out.WriteByte('\n')
96		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
97			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
98			return out.String()
99		}
100		end := m.offset + m.rows
101		if end > len(m.visible) {
102			end = len(m.visible)
103		}
104		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
105			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
106			marker := "  "
107			if position == m.cursor {
108				marker = "> "
109			}
110			line := marker + item.Label
111			if item.Description != "" {
112				line += "  " + item.Description
113			}
114			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
115			out.WriteByte('\n')
116		}
117		return out.String()
118	}
119	
120	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
121		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
122		for index, item := range m.items {
123			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
124				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
125			}
126		}
127		m.cursor = 0
128		m.offset = 0
129	}
130	
131	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
132		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
133			return
134		}
135		m.cursor += delta
136		if m.cursor < 0 {
137			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
138		}
139		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
140			m.cursor = 0
141		}
142		m.keepVisible()
143	}
144	
145	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
146		if m.rows <= 0 {
147			m.rows = 1
148		}
149		if m.cursor < m.offset {
150			m.offset = m.cursor
151		}
152		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
153			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
154		}
155	}
156	
157	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
158		if width <= 0 {
159			return value
160		}
161		runes := []rune(value)
162		if len(runes) <= width {
163			return value
164		}
165		if width == 1 {
166			return "…"
167		}
168		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
169	}
170	
171	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
172		program := tea.NewProgram(
173			newBuiltinModel(request),
174			tea.WithInput(s.in),
175			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
176			tea.WithContext(ctx),
177		)
178		final, err := program.Run()
179		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
180			return Result{}, ctxErr
181		}
182		if err != nil {
183			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
184		}
185		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
186		if !ok {
187			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
188		}
189		if model.canceled {
190			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
191		}
192		if !model.done {
193			return Result{}, nil
194		}
195		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
196	}
```

```text
9		"errors"

13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
```

```text
1	// Package textmatch provides the small query language shared by interactive
2	// lists. It deliberately matches terms rather than assigning fuzzy scores so
3	// filtering stays predictable across dev's built-in interfaces.
4	package textmatch
5	
6	import "strings"
7	
8	// Terms reports whether every whitespace-separated query term appears in the
9	// haystack, case-insensitively and in any order. An empty query matches all.
10	func Terms(haystack, query string) bool {
11		haystack = strings.ToLower(haystack)
12		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
13		for term := range strings.FieldsSeq(query) {
14			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
15				return false
16			}
17		}
18		return true
19	}
20
```

```text
8	      jq -r '.[] | select(.repo.clone_url != null and .repo.clone_url != "") | select((.repo.clone_url | test("[\\t\\r\\n]")) | not) | [.repo.clone_url, (.repo.forge + ":" + .repo.full_name), (.repo.visibility // ""), (.local_path // ""), ((.repo.description // "") | gsub("[\\t\\r\\n]+"; " "))] | @tsv' |
9	      fzf --delimiter=$'\t' --with-nth=2.. --prompt='Repository to clone> '
10	  })"
11	  status=$?

13	    return "$status"
14	  fi
15	  [ -n "$selected" ] || return 0

17	  ref=${selected%%$'\t'*}
18	  [ -n "$ref" ] || return 1
```

```text
68					return m, nil
69				}
70				m.done = true
71				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
72				m.input.Blur()
73				return m, tea.Quit
74			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
75				m.move(-1)
76				return m, nil
77			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
78				m.move(1)
79				return m, nil
80			}
81		}
82	
83		var command tea.Cmd
84		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
85		m.refilter()
86		return m, command
87	}
88	
89	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
90		if m.done {
91			return "\n"
92		}
93		var out strings.Builder
94		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
95		out.WriteByte('\n')
96		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
97			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
98			return out.String()
99		}
100		end := m.offset + m.rows
101		if end > len(m.visible) {
102			end = len(m.visible)
103		}
104		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
105			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
106			marker := "  "
107			if position == m.cursor {
108				marker = "> "
109			}
110			line := marker + item.Label
111			if item.Description != "" {
112				line += "  " + item.Description
113			}
114			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
115			out.WriteByte('\n')
116		}
117		return out.String()
118	}
119	
120	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
121		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
122		for index, item := range m.items {
123			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
124				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
125			}
126		}
127		m.cursor = 0
128		m.offset = 0
129	}
130	
131	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
132		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
133			return
134		}
135		m.cursor += delta
136		if m.cursor < 0 {
137			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
138		}
139		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
140			m.cursor = 0
141		}
142		m.keepVisible()
143	}
144	
145	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
146		if m.rows <= 0 {
147			m.rows = 1
148		}
149		if m.cursor < m.offset {
150			m.offset = m.cursor
151		}
152		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
153			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
154		}
155	}
156	
157	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
158		if width <= 0 {
159			return value
160		}
161		runes := []rune(value)
162		if len(runes) <= width {
163			return value
164		}
165		if width == 1 {
166			return "…"
167		}
168		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
169	}
170	
171	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
172		program := tea.NewProgram(
173			newBuiltinModel(request),
174			tea.WithInput(s.in),
175			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
176			tea.WithContext(ctx),
177		)
178		final, err := program.Run()
179		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
180			return Result{}, ctxErr
181		}
182		if err != nil {
183			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
184		}
185		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
186		if !ok {
187			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
188		}
189		if model.canceled {
190			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
191		}
192		if !model.done {
193			return Result{}, nil
194		}
195		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
196	}
197
```

```text
1	// Package textmatch provides the small query language shared by interactive
2	// lists. It deliberately matches terms rather than assigning fuzzy scores so
3	// filtering stays predictable across dev's built-in interfaces.
4	package textmatch
5	
6	import "strings"
7	
8	// Terms reports whether every whitespace-separated query term appears in the
9	// haystack, case-insensitively and in any order. An empty query matches all.
10	func Terms(haystack, query string) bool {
11		haystack = strings.ToLower(haystack)
12		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
13		for term := range strings.FieldsSeq(query) {
14			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
15				return false
16			}
17		}
18		return true
19	}
20
```

```text
4	dev-repo-clone-fzf() {

8	      jq -r '.[] | select(.repo.clone_url != null and .repo.clone_url != "") | select((.repo.clone_url | test("[\\t\\r\\n]")) | not) | [.repo.clone_url, (.repo.forge + ":" + .repo.full_name), (.repo.visibility // ""), (.local_path // ""), ((.repo.description // "") | gsub("[\\t\\r\\n]+"; " "))] | @tsv' |
9	      fzf --delimiter=$'\t' --with-nth=2.. --prompt='Repository to clone> '
10	  })"
11	  status=$?
12	  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
13	    return "$status"
14	  fi
15	  [ -n "$selected" ] || return 0
16	
17	  ref=${selected%%$'\t'*}
18	  [ -n "$ref" ] || return 1
```

```text
1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
```

```text
1	package picker
2	
3	import (
4		"context"

8		"github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles/textinput"
9		tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/textmatch"
11	)
12	
13	const defaultVisibleRows = 10
14	
15	type builtinModel struct {
16		prompt   string
17		input    textinput.Model
18		items    []Item
19		visible  []int
20		cursor   int
21		offset   int
22		rows     int
23		width    int
24		done     bool
25		canceled bool
26		selected Item
27	}
28	
29	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
30		input := textinput.New()
31		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
32		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
33		input.Focus()
34		model := builtinModel{
35			prompt: request.Prompt,
36			input:  input,
37			items:  append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
38			rows:   defaultVisibleRows,
39		}
40		model.refilter()
41		return model
42	}
43	
44	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
45		return textinput.Blink
46	}
47	
48	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
49		switch msg := message.(type) {
50		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
51			m.width = msg.Width
52			if available := msg.Height - 3; available > 0 && available < defaultVisibleRows {
53				m.rows = available
54			} else {
55				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
56			}
57			m.keepVisible()
58			return m, nil
59		case tea.KeyMsg:
60			switch msg.Type {
61			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
62				m.done = true
63				m.canceled = true
64				m.input.Blur()
65				return m, tea.Quit
66			case tea.KeyEnter:
```

```text
1	// Package textmatch provides the small query language shared by interactive
2	// lists. It deliberately matches terms rather than assigning fuzzy scores so
3	// filtering stays predictable across dev's built-in interfaces.
4	package textmatch
5	
6	import "strings"
7	
8	// Terms reports whether every whitespace-separated query term appears in the
9	// haystack, case-insensitively and in any order. An empty query matches all.
10	func Terms(haystack, query string) bool {
11		haystack = strings.ToLower(haystack)
12		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
13		for term := range strings.FieldsSeq(query) {
14			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
15				return false
16			}
17		}
18		return true
19	}
```

```text
1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
```

```text
 func newRepoWizardApp(t *testing.T, input string) (*App, *bytes.Buffer) {
 	t.Helper()
 	home := t.TempDir()
 	t.Setenv("HOME", home)
 	t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config"))
 	t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache"))
 	gitConfig := "[user]\n\temail = dev@example.test\n\tname = dev test\n"
 	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(home, ".gitconfig"), []byte(gitConfig), 0o644); err != nil {
 		t.Fatal(err)
 	}
 	projects := filepath.Join(home, "projects")
 	if err := os.MkdirAll(projects, 0o755); err != nil {
 		t.Fatal(err)
 	}
 	cfg := config.Default()
 	cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot = projects
 	cfg.Paths.ScanRoots = []string{projects}
 	cfg.Paths.StateDir = filepath.Join(home, "state")
 	cfg.Runtime.Backend = "none"
 	var out bytes.Buffer
 	app := &App{
 		Cfg: cfg, Tasks: task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir()), Catalog: catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir()),
 		In: strings.NewReader(input), Out: &out, Err: &bytes.Buffer{}, runtimeInstance: runtime.None{},
 		interactiveCheck: func() bool { return true },
 	}
 	app.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(app.Catalog)
 	return app, &out
 }

+func TestRenderCandidatesKeepsDuplicateItemsDistinct(t *testing.T) {
+	items := []Item{
+		{Value: "first", Label: "same", Description: "description"},
+		{Value: "second", Label: "same", Description: "description"},
+		{Value: "third", Label: "line\nwith\ttabs", Description: "clean\x00me"},
+	}
+	lines, byLine := renderCandidates(items)
+	if len(lines) != len(items) || lines[0] == lines[1] {
+		t.Fatalf("rendered lines = %q", lines)
+	}
+	for index, line := range lines {
+		if got := byLine[line].Value; got != items[index].Value {
+			t.Fatalf("line %d maps to %q, want %q", index, got, items[index].Value)
+		}
+		if strings.ContainsAny(line, "\r\n\x00") {
+			t.Fatalf("unsafe rendered line %q", line)
+		}
+	}
+}

+	request := Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: []Item{

+		{Value: "two", Label: "beta", Description: "service"},
+		{Value: "three", Label: "gamma", Description: "docs"},
+	}}
+	model := newBuiltinModel(request)
+	updated, _ := model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune("service")})
+	model = updated.(builtinModel)
+	if len(model.visible) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("visible = %v", model.visible)
+	}
+	updated, _ = model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyDown})
+	model = updated.(builtinModel)
+	updated, command := model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEnter})
+	model = updated.(builtinModel)
+	if command == nil || !model.done || model.canceled || model.selected.Value != "two" {
+		t.Fatalf("selected model = %+v, command nil = %t", model, command == nil)
+	}
+
+	model = newBuiltinModel(request)
+	updated, command = model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEsc})
+	model = updated.(builtinModel)
+	if command == nil || !model.done || !model.canceled {
+		t.Fatalf("canceled model = %+v, command nil = %t", model, command == nil)
+	}

+		{Value: "first-value", Label: "same"},
+		{Value: "second-value", Label: "same"},
+	}}
+	result, err := selector.Select(t.Context(), request)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if !result.Selected || result.Canceled || result.Item.Value != "second-value" {
+		t.Fatalf("result = %+v", result)
+	}

+
+func TestExternalPickerCancellationCodes(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, mode := range []string{"exit-1", "exit-130"} {
+		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Setenv("DEV_PICKER_HELPER", mode)
+			result, err := helperSelector().Select(t.Context(), Request{Items: []Item{{Value: "v", Label: "item"}}})
+			if err != nil || !result.Canceled || result.Selected {

+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestExternalPickerRejectsUnknownOutput(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("DEV_PICKER_HELPER", "unknown")
+	_, err := helperSelector().Select(t.Context(), Request{Items: []Item{{Value: "v", Label: "item"}}})
+	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unknown selection") {
+		t.Fatalf("err = %v", err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestExternalPickerHonorsContext(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("DEV_PICKER_HELPER", "wait")
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	_, err := helperSelector().Select(ctx, Request{Items: []Item{{Value: "v", Label: "item"}}})
+	if !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
+		t.Fatalf("err = %v", err)
+	}
+}

+func helperSelector() *Selector {

+}

+func TestPickerHelperProcess(t *testing.T) {
+	mode := os.Getenv("DEV_PICKER_HELPER")
+	if mode == "" {
+		return
+	}
+	body, _ := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
+	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(body), "\n"), "\n")
+	switch mode {
+	case "select-second":
+		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, lines[1])
+		os.Exit(0)
+	case "exit-1":
+		os.Exit(1)
+	case "exit-130":
+		os.Exit(130)
+	case "unknown":
+		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, "not one of the candidates")
+		os.Exit(0)
+	case "wait":
+		time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
+	default:
+		os.Exit(2)
+	}
```

```text
+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {

+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",

+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {

+const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
+
+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}
```

```text
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
153
```

```text
29	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
30		input := textinput.New()
31		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
32		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
33		input.Focus()
34		model := builtinModel{
35			prompt: request.Prompt,
36			input:  input,
37			items:  append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
38			rows:   defaultVisibleRows,
39		}

41		return model
42	}

44	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
45		return textinput.Blink
46	}
47	
48	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
49		switch msg := message.(type) {
50		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
51			m.width = msg.Width
52			if available := msg.Height - 3; available > 0 && available < defaultVisibleRows {
53				m.rows = available
54			} else {
55				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
56			}
57			m.keepVisible()
58			return m, nil
59		case tea.KeyMsg:
60			switch msg.Type {
61			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
62				m.done = true
63				m.canceled = true
64				m.input.Blur()
65				return m, tea.Quit
66			case tea.KeyEnter:
67				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
68					return m, nil
69				}
70				m.done = true
71				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
72				m.input.Blur()
73				return m, tea.Quit
74			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
75				m.move(-1)
76				return m, nil
77			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
78				m.move(1)
79				return m, nil
80			}
81		}
82	
83		var command tea.Cmd
84		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
85		m.refilter()
86		return m, command
87	}
88	
89	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
90		if m.done {
91			return "\n"
92		}
93		var out strings.Builder
94		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
95		out.WriteByte('\n')
96		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
97			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
98			return out.String()
99		}
100		end := m.offset + m.rows
101		if end > len(m.visible) {
102			end = len(m.visible)
103		}
104		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
105			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
106			marker := "  "
107			if position == m.cursor {
108				marker = "> "
109			}
110			line := marker + item.Label
111			if item.Description != "" {
112				line += "  " + item.Description
113			}
114			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
115			out.WriteByte('\n')
116		}
117		return out.String()
118	}
119	
120	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
121		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
122		for index, item := range m.items {
123			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
124				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
125			}
126		}
127		m.cursor = 0
128		m.offset = 0
129	}
130	
131	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
132		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
133			return
134		}
135		m.cursor += delta
136		if m.cursor < 0 {
137			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
138		}
139		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
140			m.cursor = 0
141		}
142		m.keepVisible()
143	}
144	
145	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
146		if m.rows <= 0 {
147			m.rows = 1
148		}
149		if m.cursor < m.offset {
150			m.offset = m.cursor
151		}
152		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
153			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
154		}
155	}
156	
157	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
158		if width <= 0 {
159			return value
160		}
161		runes := []rune(value)
162		if len(runes) <= width {
163			return value
164		}
165		if width == 1 {
166			return "…"
167		}
168		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
169	}

171	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
172		program := tea.NewProgram(
173			newBuiltinModel(request),
174			tea.WithInput(s.in),
175			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
176			tea.WithContext(ctx),
177		)

179		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
180			return Result{}, ctxErr
181		}

184		}
185		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)

188		}

191		}
192		if !model.done {
193			return Result{}, nil
194		}
195		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
196	}
```

```text
1	// Package textmatch provides the small query language shared by interactive
2	// lists. It deliberately matches terms rather than assigning fuzzy scores so
3	// filtering stays predictable across dev's built-in interfaces.
4	package textmatch
5	
6	import "strings"
7	
8	// Terms reports whether every whitespace-separated query term appears in the
9	// haystack, case-insensitively and in any order. An empty query matches all.
10	func Terms(haystack, query string) bool {
11		haystack = strings.ToLower(haystack)
12		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
13		for term := range strings.FieldsSeq(query) {
14			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
15				return false
16			}
17		}
18		return true
19	}
20
```

```text
8	      jq -r '.[] | select(.repo.clone_url != null and .repo.clone_url != "") | select((.repo.clone_url | test("[\\t\\r\\n]")) | not) | [.repo.clone_url, (.repo.forge + ":" + .repo.full_name), (.repo.visibility // ""), (.local_path // ""), ((.repo.description // "") | gsub("[\\t\\r\\n]+"; " "))] | @tsv' |

10	  })"
11	  status=$?
12	  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
13	    return "$status"
14	  fi
15	  [ -n "$selected" ] || return 0
16	
17	  ref=${selected%%$'\t'*}
18	  [ -n "$ref" ] || return 1
19	  dev repo clone "$ref"
20	}
```

```text
+func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
+	manual := func() (string, error) {
+		return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")

+		return manual()
+	}

+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})
+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
+		app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
+	}
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
+		if result.Canceled {
+			return "", errPromptCanceled
+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil
+}

+const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
+
+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}
```

1	# Optional picker integrations
2	
3	These files compose with dev's existing structured output. They are examples,
4	not installed product state: copy or symlink only the integration you want.
5	
6	First populate the private forge inventory:
7	
8	```bash
9	dev repo remote --refresh
10	```
11	
12	## Television
13	
14	Copy or symlink `television/dev-remote-repos.toml` into Television's cable
15	directory, then select an exact clone URL:
16	
17	```bash
18	dev repo clone "$(tv dev-remote-repos)"
19	```
20	
21	The channel requires `dev` and `jq`. It reads only
22	`dev repo remote --cached --json`; opening the channel never contacts a forge.
23	
24	## fzf shell helper
25	
26	Source `fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash`, then run:
27	
28	```bash
29	dev-repo-clone-fzf
30	```
31	
32	The helper requires `dev`, `jq`, and `fzf`. It does not use `eval` or `xargs`:
33	the selected canonical clone URL is passed to `dev repo clone` as one quoted
34	argument. Canceling fzf performs no clone.
35	
36	Both integrations retain already-cloned rows because a second destination may
37	be intentional. `dev repo clone` remains responsible for destination and
38	nested-repository safety checks.

```text
1	# Source this file from Bash or Zsh after installing dev, jq, and fzf.
2	# Populate the private candidate cache once with: dev repo remote --refresh
3	
4	dev-repo-clone-fzf() {
5	  local selected status ref
6	  selected="$({
7	    dev repo remote --cached --json |
8	      jq -r '.[] | select(.repo.clone_url != null and .repo.clone_url != "") | select((.repo.clone_url | test("[\\t\\r\\n]")) | not) | [.repo.clone_url, (.repo.forge + ":" + .repo.full_name), (.repo.visibility // ""), (.local_path // ""), ((.repo.description // "") | gsub("[\\t\\r\\n]+"; " "))] | @tsv' |
9	      fzf --delimiter=$'\t' --with-nth=2.. --prompt='Repository to clone> '
10	  })"
11	  status=$?
12	  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
13	    return "$status"
14	  fi
15	  [ -n "$selected" ] || return 0
16	
17	  ref=${selected%%$'\t'*}
18	  [ -n "$ref" ] || return 1
19	  dev repo clone "$ref"
20	}
21
```
