72	// Load reads configuration and prepares the shared stores.
73	func (a *App) Load() error {
74		cfg, err := config.Load(a.configPath)
75		if err != nil {
76			return err
77		}
78		a.Cfg = cfg
79		if a.In == nil {
80			a.In = os.Stdin
81		}
82		if a.Out == nil {
83			a.Out = os.Stdout
84		}
85		if a.Err == nil {
86			a.Err = os.Stderr
87		}
88		a.Tasks = task.NewStore(cfg.TasksDir())
89		a.Catalog = catalog.NewStore(cfg.AssetsDir(), catalog.WithDiagnosticSink(func(diagnostic catalog.Diagnostic) {
90			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "%s %s\n", a.errStyle().warning("dev: warning:"), diagnostic.Error())
91		}))
92		a.Registry = catalog.NewRegistry(a.Catalog)
93		noteStore := note.NewStore(cfg.NotesDir(), note.WithDiagnosticSink(func(path string, err error) {
94			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: skipping note %s: %v\n", filepath.Base(path), err)
95		}))
96		a.Notes = note.NewService(noteStore, cfg.NotesIndexFile())
97		a.Notes.IndexDiagnostic = func(err error) {
98			fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "dev: warning: note search index: %v\n", err)
99		}
100		if a.Sizes == nil {
101			cache := diskusage.NewCache(filepath.Join(config.CacheHome(), "dev", "sizes-v1.json"), 10*time.Minute)
102			a.Sizes = diskusage.NewManager(cache, 2)
103		}
104		return nil
105	}
106	
107	func (a *App) interactive() bool {
108		if a.interactiveCheck != nil {
109			return a.interactiveCheck()
110		}
111		return interactive()
112	}
113	
114	// Runtime resolves the multiplexer backend for this invocation, honouring
115	// --runtime and --no-runtime.
116	func (a *App) Runtime() runtime.Runtime {
117		if a.runtimeInstance != nil {
118			return a.runtimeInstance
119		}
120		if a.noRuntime {
121			return runtime.None{}
122		}
123		backend := a.Cfg.Runtime.Backend
124		if a.runtimeOverride != "" {
125			backend = a.runtimeOverride
126		}
127		return a.runtimeNamed(backend)
128	}
129	
130	// runtimeNamed resolves the backend that owns a persisted opaque handle. It
131	// deliberately bypasses the current backend override: feeding a Herdr handle to
132	// tmux after a config change is never valid.
133	func (a *App) runtimeNamed(name string) runtime.Runtime {
134		if rt := a.runtimesByName[name]; rt != nil {
135			return rt
136		}
137		if a.runtimeInstance != nil && (name == "" || a.runtimeInstance.Name() == name) {
138			return a.runtimeInstance
139		}
140		rt := runtime.Select(name)
141		if h, ok := rt.(*runtime.Herdr); ok {
142			return h.WithMetadataSource(a.Cfg.Runtime.MetadataSource)
143		}
144		return rt
145	}
146	
147	// printf writes to the command's stdout.
148	func (a *App) printf(format string, args ...any) {
149		fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, format, args...)
150	}
151	
152	// warnf writes a non-fatal notice to stderr, so it never pollutes piped output.
153	func (a *App) warnf(format string, args ...any) {
154		message := fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
155		fmt.Fprintf(a.Err, "%s %s\n", a.errStyle().warning("dev:"), message)
156	}
157	
158	// cdDirective asks the shell wrapper to move its parent process. The wrapper
159	// gives dev a child-only file descriptor so normal output stays connected to
160	// the terminal and an inherited environment variable can never name a file to
161	// overwrite. NUL terminates the path because filesystem paths may contain
162	// newlines. Without the wrapper, retain the printable directive used by older
163	// integrations.
164	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) error {
165		// Windows shells do not inherit an extra descriptor the way the POSIX
166		// wrapper's `3>file` redirection does, so the PowerShell wrapper names a
167		// temp file instead and reads it back after dev exits.
168		if path := os.Getenv("DEV_SHELL_CD_FILE"); path != "" {
169			return os.WriteFile(path, append([]byte(dir), 0), 0o600)
170		}
171		if rawFD := os.Getenv("DEV_SHELL_CD_FD"); rawFD != "" {
172			fd, err := strconv.Atoi(rawFD)
173			if err != nil || fd < 3 {
174				return fmt.Errorf("invalid DEV_SHELL_CD_FD %q", rawFD)
175			}
176			file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), "dev-shell-cd")
177			if file == nil {
178				return fmt.Errorf("invalid shell directory descriptor %d", fd)
179			}
180			if _, err := file.Write(append([]byte(dir), 0)); err != nil {
181				return fmt.Errorf("write shell directory directive: %w", err)
182			}
183			if err := file.Close(); err != nil {
184				return fmt.Errorf("close shell directory directive: %w", err)
185			}
186			return nil
187		}
188		_, err := fmt.Fprintf(a.Out, "cd %s\n", shellQuote(dir))
189		return err
190	}
191	
192	// ctx is the cancellable context commands run under.
193	func ctxOf() context.Context { return context.Background() }

30	func newConfigInitCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
31		var (
32			force  bool
33			stdout bool
34		)
35		cmd := &cobra.Command{
36			Use:   "init",
37			Short: "Write a starter config.toml, detecting this machine's layout",
38			Long: `Generate a commented config.toml describing the paths that actually exist on
39	this machine.
40	
41	Where repositories live differs from person to person — ~/Documents/Program,
42	~/src, ~/code, a ghq root — so the generated file is built from what is found
43	rather than from a fixed set of defaults. A config pointing at directories that
44	do not exist is worse than none: dev would discover nothing and give no clue
45	why.
46	
47	Every value it writes is still a default you can change; nothing is inferred
48	that you cannot override.`,
49			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
50			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
51				layout := config.DetectLayout()
52				body := renderStarterConfig(layout.Fallbacks())
53	
54				if stdout {
55					fmt.Fprint(app.Out, body)
56					return nil
57				}
58	
59				path := app.configPath
60				if path == "" {
61					path = config.ConfigFile()
62				}
63				if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && !force {
64					return fmt.Errorf("%s already exists (use --force to overwrite, or --stdout to preview)",
65						config.Contract(path))
66				}
67				if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
68					return err
69				}
70				if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o644); err != nil {
71					return err
72				}
73	
74				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "wrote %s\n\n", config.Contract(path))
75				reportDetection(app, layout)
76				return nil
77			},
78		}
79		f := cmd.Flags()
80		f.BoolVarP(&force, "force", "f", false, "overwrite an existing config")
81		f.BoolVar(&stdout, "stdout", false, "print the generated config instead of writing it")
82		return cmd
83	}

85	// reportDetection explains what was found, so the user can see whether the
86	// generated config actually matches how they work.
87	func reportDetection(app *App, l config.Layout) {
88		if len(l.Found) == 0 {
89			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "No repository directories were recognised, so the defaults were used.")
90			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Edit paths.scan_roots to point at where you keep projects.")
91			return
92		}
93		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "Detected:")
94		t := app.newTable("ROOT", "REPOS", "ROLE")
95		for _, r := range l.ScanRoots {
96			role := "scan root"
97			switch r {
98			case l.ProjectRoot:
99				role = "scan root, new projects land here"
100			case l.TriesRoot:
101				role = "scan root, experiments"
102			}
103			t.Add(r, fmt.Sprintf("%d", l.Found[r]), role)
104		}
105		t.Render(app.Out)
106		if len(l.RepoPaths) > 0 {
107			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "\nExact repositories:")
108			for _, path := range l.RepoPaths {
109				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s\n", path)
110			}
111		}
112		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\nWorktrees will go to %s — change paths.worktree_root if that volume is wrong.\n",
113			l.WorktreeRoot)
114	}

116	// renderStarterConfig fills the annotated template with detected paths. Paths
117	// are written with forward slashes: a Windows path in a TOML basic string would
118	// otherwise read "C:\Users" as an invalid \U escape, and Go accepts / on every
119	// platform.
120	func renderStarterConfig(l config.Layout) string {
121		roots := make([]string, len(l.ScanRoots))
122		for i, r := range l.ScanRoots {
123			roots[i] = strconv.Quote(filepath.ToSlash(r))
124		}
125		r := strings.NewReplacer(
126			"@@SCAN_ROOTS@@", strings.Join(roots, ", "),
127			"@@REPO_PATHS@@", quotedStrings(l.RepoPaths),
128			"@@TRIES_ROOT@@", filepath.ToSlash(l.TriesRoot),
129			"@@PROJECT_ROOT@@", filepath.ToSlash(l.ProjectRoot),
130			"@@WORKTREE_ROOT@@", filepath.ToSlash(l.WorktreeRoot),
131		)
132		return r.Replace(starterConfig)
133	}
134	
135	func quotedStrings(values []string) string {
136		quoted := make([]string, len(values))
137		for index, value := range values {
138			quoted[index] = strconv.Quote(filepath.ToSlash(value))
139		}
140		return strings.Join(quoted, ", ")
141	}

42	func newDoctorCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {

46			Long: `Report what dev can and cannot do on this machine.
47	
48	Only git is required. Everything else — a multiplexer, a forge CLI — enables
49	extra behaviour and degrades cleanly when missing, so a warning here is not a
50	problem to fix unless you want that capability.`,
51			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
52			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
53				return runDoctor(app)

58	func runDoctor(app *App) error {
59		ctx := ctxOf()
60		var checks []check
61	
62		// What am I running? A build several commits past its last release behaves
63		// differently from that release, and `dev --version` alone does not say so.
64		checks = append(checks, check{"dev", checkOK, versionSummary()})
65		if install, err := runningInstall(); err == nil {
66			detail := install.Method.label() + " — " + install.Path
67			if install.Resolved != install.Path {
68				detail += " → " + install.Resolved
69			}
70			checks = append(checks, check{"install", checkOK, detail})
71			if others := otherDevInstalls(install, devInstallsOnPath()); len(others) > 0 {
72				var copies []string
73				for _, other := range others {
74					copies = append(copies, other.Method.label()+" at "+other.Path)
75				}
76				checks = append(checks, check{"dev copies", checkWarn,
77					"other executable(s) on PATH may shadow this install: " + strings.Join(copies, "; ")})
78			}
79		} else {
80			checks = append(checks, check{"install", checkWarn, "cannot locate the running executable: " + err.Error()})
81		}
82	
83		// Windows has no tmux/Zellij/Herdr, so a warning against those backends
84		// below is expected rather than something to fix.
85		if goruntime.GOOS == "windows" {
86			checks = append(checks, check{"platform", checkWarn,
87				"windows — tmux, Zellij and Herdr are unavailable; dev uses the no-multiplexer backend"})
88		}
89	
90		// Required.
91		if v, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "--version").Output(); err == nil {
92			checks = append(checks, check{"git", checkOK, strings.TrimSpace(string(v))})
93		} else {
94			checks = append(checks, check{"git", checkFail, "not found — dev cannot work without it"})
95		}
96	
97		// Runtime backends.
98		active := app.Runtime().Name()
99		for _, rt := range runtime.All() {
100			name := rt.Name()
101			detail := "not available"
102			st := checkWarn
103			if rt.Available() {
104				st, detail = checkOK, "available"
105				if sessions, err := rt.List(ctx); err == nil && len(sessions) > 0 {
106					detail = fmt.Sprintf("available, %d live session(s)", len(sessions))
107				}
108			}
109			if name == "none" {
110				st, detail = checkOK, "always available (prints a cd directive)"
111			}
112			if name == active {
113				detail += "  ← selected"
114			}
115			checks = append(checks, check{"runtime/" + name, st, detail})
116		}
117	
118		// Optional selector. Missing is a degradation, not a blocker: the built-in
119		// Bubble Tea picker implements the same selection contract.
120		if len(app.Cfg.Picker.Command) == 0 {
121			checks = append(checks, check{"picker", checkOK, "built-in picker selected by configuration"})
122		} else if path, err := exec.LookPath(app.Cfg.Picker.Command[0]); err == nil {
123			checks = append(checks, check{"picker", checkOK, path + " — external picker available"})
124		} else {
125			checks = append(checks, check{"picker", checkWarn,
126				app.Cfg.Picker.Command[0] + " not found — using the built-in picker"})
127		}
128	
129		// Optional forge CLIs.
130		for _, f := range []struct{ bin, purpose string }{
131			{"gh", "GitHub: clone, create, PRs"},
132			{"glab", "GitLab: clone, create, MRs"},
133		} {
134			if path, err := exec.LookPath(f.bin); err == nil {
135				checks = append(checks, check{f.bin, checkOK, path + " — " + f.purpose})
136			} else {
137				checks = append(checks, check{f.bin, checkWarn, "not found — " + f.purpose + " unavailable"})
138			}
139		}
140		if cwd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil {
141			if version, err := agentskill.ProviderVersion(ctx, cwd); err == nil {
142				checks = append(checks, check{"agent skills", checkOK, version})
143			} else {
144				checks = append(checks, check{"agent skills", checkWarn,
145					"provider unavailable without downloading — `dev skill add` bootstraps it explicitly"})
146			}
147		}
148		azureTargets := len(app.Cfg.Forge.AzureDevOps)
149		if path, err := exec.LookPath("az"); err != nil {
150			detail := "not found — Azure DevOps PRs unavailable"
151			if azureTargets > 0 {
152				detail += fmt.Sprintf("; %d configured inventory target(s) skipped", azureTargets)
153			}
154			checks = append(checks, check{"az", checkWarn, detail})
155		} else if err := forge.CheckAzureDevOps(ctx); err != nil {
156			checks = append(checks, check{"az", checkWarn, path + " — " + err.Error()})
157		} else {
158			detail := path + " — Azure DevOps: PRs"
159			if azureTargets == 0 {
160				detail += "; inventory disabled (no forge.azure_devops targets)"
161			} else {
162				detail += fmt.Sprintf("; %d inventory target(s)", azureTargets)
163			}
164			checks = append(checks, check{"az", checkOK, detail})
165		}
166	
167		// Shell integration: without the wrapper, `dev resume` prints a path
168		// instead of moving the user, which looks broken if unexplained.
169		if os.Getenv("DEV_SHELL_INIT") == "1" {
170			checks = append(checks, check{"shell wrapper", checkOK, "active"})
171		} else {
172			hint := `not detected — add: eval "$(dev shell-init zsh)"`
173			if goruntime.GOOS == "windows" {
174				hint = "not detected — add to your PowerShell profile: " +
175					"Invoke-Expression (& dev shell-init powershell | Out-String)"
176			}
177			checks = append(checks, check{"shell wrapper", checkWarn, hint})
178		}
179	
180		// Paths.
181		cfgSrc := app.Cfg.Source
182		if cfgSrc == "" {
183			cfgSrc = "built-in defaults (no config.toml)"
184		}
185		checks = append(checks, check{"config", checkOK, cfgSrc})
186		stateStatus, stateDetail := pathCheck(app.Cfg.StateDir())
187		checks = append(checks, check{"state dir", stateStatus, stateDetail})
188	
189		for _, root := range app.Cfg.ScanRoots() {
190			st, detail := pathCheck(root)
191			if st != checkOK {
192				detail = "missing — no repos will be discovered here"
193				st = checkWarn
194			}
195			checks = append(checks, check{"scan root", st, config.Contract(root) + " — " + detail})
196		}
197		for _, path := range app.Cfg.RepoPaths() {
198			st, detail := pathCheck(path)
199			if st != checkOK {
200				detail = "missing — this exact repository will be skipped"
201				st = checkWarn
202			}
203			checks = append(checks, check{"repo path", st, config.Contract(path) + " — " + detail})
204		}
205	
206		wtRoot := config.Expand(app.Cfg.Paths.WorktreeRoot)
207		sample, err := app.Cfg.WorktreePathFor("example", "/repo/example", "feat/demo", "")
208		if err != nil {
209			checks = append(checks, check{"worktree path", checkFail, err.Error()})
210		} else {
211			checks = append(checks, check{"worktree path", checkOK,
212				config.Contract(sample) + fmt.Sprintf("  (root %s, %s)", config.Contract(wtRoot), writableNote(wtRoot))})
213		}
214	
215		// Render.
216		failures := 0
217		style := app.outStyle()
218		for _, c := range checks {
219			if c.status == checkFail {
220				failures++
221			}
222			icon := c.status.icon()
223			detail := c.detail
224			switch c.status {
225			case checkOK:
226				icon = style.success(icon)
227			case checkWarn:
228				icon, detail = style.warning(icon), style.warning(detail)
229			case checkFail:
230				icon, detail = style.danger(icon), style.danger(detail)
231			}
232			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s %s\n", icon, style.label(fmt.Sprintf("%-16s", c.name)), detail)
233		}
234		if failures > 0 {
235			return fmt.Errorf("%d required check(s) failed", failures)
236		}
237		return nil
238	}
239	
240	func pathCheck(p string) (checkStatus, string) {
241		info, err := os.Stat(p)
242		switch {
243		case err == nil && info.IsDir():
244			return checkOK, config.Contract(p)
245		case os.IsNotExist(err):
246			return checkWarn, config.Contract(p) + " (will be created on first use)"
247		case err != nil:
248			return checkFail, err.Error()
249		default:
250			return checkFail, config.Contract(p) + " is not a directory"
251		}
252	}
253	
254	// writableNote reports whether dev could actually create a worktree under the
255	// configured root, walking up to the nearest existing ancestor. A root on an
256	// unmounted volume or a read-only mount is the failure this catches early,
257	// before a `dev wt create` gets halfway through.
258	func writableNote(root string) string {
259		dir := root
260		for {
261			if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil {
262				if !info.IsDir() {
263					return "not a directory"
264				}
265				if dirWritable(dir) {
266					return "writable"
267				}
268				return "NOT WRITABLE"
269			}
270			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
271			if parent == dir {
272				return "unreachable"
273			}
274			dir = parent
275		}
276	}
277	
278	// dirWritable probes by creating and removing a temp file. There is no
279	// portable stdlib permission check, and the mode bits alone would lie about
280	// read-only mounts and ACLs.
281	func dirWritable(dir string) bool {
282		f, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".dev-write-probe-*")
283		if err != nil {
284			return false
285		}
286		name := f.Name()
287		f.Close()
288		os.Remove(name)
289		return true
290	}

161			return errors.New("upstream-creation flags cannot be combined with a clone reference; the cloned remote is preserved")

250				}
251				if flags.preset == "" {
252					return errors.New("--preset is required for non-interactive repo setup")
253				}
254				request, err := buildSetupRepoRequest(app, root, flags)
255				if err != nil {
256					return err
257				}
258				return executeRepoSetup(app, request)
259			},
260		}
261		bindRepoBootstrapFlags(cmd, &flags, false, true, true)
262		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "handoff", fixedCompletions(repoHandoffCompletions()...))
263		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "check-in", fixedCompletions(repoCheckInCompletions()...))
264		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "forge", fixedCompletions("auto", "github", "gitlab", "none"))
265		registerFlagCompletion(cmd, "visibility", fixedCompletions("private", "public", "internal"))
266		cmd.ValidArgsFunction = completeRepos(app)
267		return cmd
268	}
269	
270	func bindRepoBootstrapFlags(cmd *cobra.Command, flags *repoBootstrapFlags, acquisition, remote, setup bool) {
271		f := cmd.Flags()
272		if acquisition {
273			f.StringVarP(&flags.category, "category", "c", "", "category subdirectory under project_root")
274			f.StringVar(&flags.path, "path", "", "exact destination path")
275		}
276		f.StringVar(&flags.preset, "preset", "", "scaffold preset")
277		f.StringVar(&flags.handoff, "handoff", "", "afterwards: stay, cd, open or start")
278		f.StringVar(&flags.checkIn, "check-in", "", "finish generated changes: auto, commit, stage or none")
279		f.StringVar(&flags.description, "description", "", "repository description")
280		f.StringSliceVar(&flags.gitignore, "gitignore", nil, "gitignore template (repeatable or comma-separated)")
281		f.StringVar(&flags.license, "license", "", "license keyword (for example mit or apache-2.0)")
282		f.StringVar(&flags.licenseHolder, "license-holder", "", "copyright holder used in the license template")
283		f.StringArrayVar(&flags.set, "set", nil, "preset input as key=value (repeatable)")
284		f.StringArrayVar(&flags.enable, "enable", nil, "enable a scaffold item by id (repeatable)")
285		f.StringArrayVar(&flags.disable, "disable", nil, "disable a scaffold item by id (repeatable)")
286		f.StringSliceVar(&flags.agents, "agent", nil, "agent targets for selected project skills")
287		f.BoolVar(&flags.browseSkills, "browse-skills", false, "open the upstream skills installer during setup")
288		f.BoolVar(&flags.importOrphans, "import-orphan-plans", false, "copy matching global Claude plans into the repository")
289		f.BoolVar(&flags.dryRun, "dry-run", false, "show the plan without changing anything")
290		f.BoolVarP(&flags.yes, "yes", "y", false, "confirm the non-interactive scaffold plan")
291		f.BoolVar(&flags.json, "json", false, "emit a machine-readable result")
292		messageDefault := ""
293		if setup {
294			messageDefault = "chore: initialize repository"
295		}
296		f.StringVarP(&flags.message, "message", "m", messageDefault, "commit message for --check-in=commit or stage")
297		if remote {
298			f.BoolVar(&flags.remote, "remote", false, "also create a GitHub or GitLab upstream")
299			f.StringVar(&flags.forge, "forge", "auto", "upstream provider: auto, github, gitlab or none")
300			f.StringVar(&flags.namespace, "namespace", "", "GitHub owner/org or GitLab namespace")
301			f.StringVar(&flags.visibility, "visibility", "", "upstream visibility: private, public or internal")
302			f.BoolVar(&flags.private, "private", true, "create a private upstream (compatibility flag)")
303			f.BoolVar(&flags.public, "public", false, "create a public upstream")
304			f.BoolVar(&flags.push, "push", true, "push the current branch after publishing")
305		}
306		if setup {
307			f.BoolVar(&flags.commit, "commit", false, "commit only the setup changes (requires a clean starting checkout)")
308		}
309	}
310	
311	func buildNewRepoRequest(app *App, name string, flags repoBootstrapFlags) (repoWorkflowRequest, error) {
312		destination, err := repoDestination(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot, flags.category, name, flags.path)
313		if err != nil {
314			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
315		}
316		inputs, selections, err := parseScaffoldOverrides(flags)
317		if err != nil {
318			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
319		}
320		preset := flags.preset
321		if preset == "" {
322			preset = "minimal"
323		}
324		prepared, err := prepareRepoScaffold(app, repoScaffoldRequest{
325			Root: destination, Name: name, Description: flags.description, Category: flags.category,
326			Preset: preset, Inputs: inputs, Selections: selections, Gitignore: explicitSlice(flags.gitignore),
327			License: flags.license, LicenseHolder: flags.licenseHolder, ImportOrphans: flags.importOrphans,
328			SkillAgents: explicitSlice(flags.agents),
329		})
330		if err != nil {
331			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
332		}
333		templateSource := prepared.Plan.Settings.Template
334		templateRef := prepared.Plan.Settings.TemplateRef
335		templateSubdir := prepared.Plan.Settings.TemplateSubdir
336		if flags.template != "" {
337			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(flags.template), "none") {
338				templateSource, templateRef, templateSubdir = "", "", ""
339			} else {
340				templateSource = flags.template
341			}
342		}
343		if flags.templateRef != "" {
344			templateRef = flags.templateRef
345		}
346		if flags.templateSubdir != "" {
347			templateSubdir = flags.templateSubdir
348		}
349		if strings.TrimSpace(templateSource) == "" && (strings.TrimSpace(templateRef) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(templateSubdir) != "") {
350			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, errors.New("--template-ref and --template-subdir require --template or a preset template")
351		}
352		// The raw preset source may contain URL credentials. It is no longer needed
353		// by the scaffold pipeline once the effective template selection is copied
354		// above, so keep every rendered/JSON plan display-safe.
355		prepared.Plan.Settings.Template = ""
356		prepared.Plan.Settings.TemplateRef = ""
357		prepared.Plan.Settings.TemplateSubdir = ""
358		checkIn, err := resolveRepoCheckIn(flags, prepared, repo.AcquireNew)
359		if err != nil {
360			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
361		}
362		handoff, err := flagsHandoff(flags, repoHandoffStay)
363		if err != nil {
364			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
365		}
366		publish, err := publishRequestFromFlags(flags, name)
367		if err != nil {
368			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
369		}
370		request := repoWorkflowRequest{
371			Kind: repo.AcquireNew, Name: name, Destination: destination,
372			Scaffold: repoScaffoldRequest{Root: destination, Name: name}, Prepared: prepared,
373			Handoff: handoff, Publish: publish, BrowseSkills: flags.browseSkills,
374			CheckIn: checkIn, CommitMessage: flags.message, DryRun: flags.dryRun, JSON: flags.json,
375		}
376		if err := validateRepoWorkflowRequest(app, request, flags.yes); err != nil {
377			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
378		}
379		if strings.TrimSpace(templateSource) != "" {
380			preparedTemplate, err := repotemplate.Prepare(ctxOf(), repotemplate.Request{
381				Source: templateSource, Ref: templateRef, Subdir: templateSubdir,
382			})
383			if err != nil {
384				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
385			}
386			request.Template = &preparedTemplate
387			request.Prepared.Plan.Settings.Template = preparedTemplate.Source
388			request.Prepared.Plan.Settings.TemplateRef = preparedTemplate.Ref
389			request.Prepared.Plan.Settings.TemplateSubdir = preparedTemplate.Subdir
390		}
391		return request, nil
392	}
393	
394	func buildCloneRepoRequest(app *App, ref string, flags repoBootstrapFlags) (repoWorkflowRequest, error) {
395		safeRef := repo.RedactCloneRef(ref)
396		name := repo.NameFromRef(safeRef)
397		if name == "" {
398			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a directory name from %q", safeRef)
399		}
400		destination, err := repoDestination(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot, flags.category, name, flags.path)
401		if err != nil {
402			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
403		}
404		handoff, err := flagsHandoff(flags, repoHandoffStay)
405		if err != nil {
406			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
407		}
408		checkIn, err := resolveRepoCheckIn(flags, preparedRepoScaffold{}, repo.AcquireClone)
409		if err != nil {
410			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
411		}
412		request := repoWorkflowRequest{
413			Kind: repo.AcquireClone, Name: name, Ref: ref, Destination: destination,
414			Handoff: handoff, BrowseSkills: flags.browseSkills, CheckIn: checkIn,
415			CommitMessage: flags.message, DryRun: flags.dryRun, JSON: flags.json,
416		}
417		if flags.preset == "" && cloneSetupOptionsSelected(flags) {
418			return request, errors.New("clone setup options require --preset")
419		}
420		if flags.preset != "" {
421			if !app.interactive() && !flags.yes {
422				return request, errors.New("non-interactive clone setup requires --yes")
423			}
424			inputs, selections, err := parseScaffoldOverrides(flags)
425			if err != nil {
426				return request, err
427			}
428			request.Scaffold = repoScaffoldRequest{
429				Root: destination, Name: name, Description: flags.description, Category: flags.category,
430				Preset: flags.preset, Inputs: inputs, Selections: selections,
431				Gitignore: explicitSlice(flags.gitignore), License: flags.license,
432				LicenseHolder: flags.licenseHolder, ImportOrphans: flags.importOrphans, Existing: true,
433				SkillAgents: explicitSlice(flags.agents),
434			}
435			// A clone's project layer does not exist until acquisition. Prepare it in
436			// executeRepoWorkflow after the clone succeeds.
437		}
438		return request, validateRepoWorkflowRequest(app, request, flags.yes)
439	}
440	
441	func cloneSetupOptionsSelected(flags repoBootstrapFlags) bool {
442		checkInNeedsSetup := flags.checkIn != "" &&
443			!strings.EqualFold(flags.checkIn, string(repoCheckInAuto)) &&
444			!strings.EqualFold(flags.checkIn, string(repoCheckInNone))
445		return flags.description != "" || flags.gitignore != nil || flags.license != "" || flags.licenseHolder != "" ||
446			len(flags.set) > 0 || len(flags.enable) > 0 || len(flags.disable) > 0 || flags.agents != nil ||
447			flags.browseSkills || flags.importOrphans || checkInNeedsSetup || flags.message != ""
448	}
449	
450	func buildSetupRepoRequest(app *App, root string, flags repoBootstrapFlags) (repoWorkflowRequest, error) {
451		inputs, selections, err := parseScaffoldOverrides(flags)
452		if err != nil {
453			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
454		}
455		name := filepath.Base(root)
456		prepared, err := prepareRepoScaffold(app, repoScaffoldRequest{
457			Root: root, Name: name, Description: flags.description, Preset: flags.preset,
458			Inputs: inputs, Selections: selections, Gitignore: explicitSlice(flags.gitignore),
459			License: flags.license, LicenseHolder: flags.licenseHolder,
460			ImportOrphans: flags.importOrphans, Existing: true, SkillAgents: explicitSlice(flags.agents),
461		})
462		if err != nil {
463			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
464		}
465		checkIn, err := resolveRepoCheckIn(flags, prepared, "")
466		if err != nil {
467			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
468		}
469		handoff, err := flagsHandoff(flags, repoHandoffStay)
470		if err != nil {
471			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
472		}
473		publish, err := publishRequestFromFlags(flags, name)
474		if err != nil {
475			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, err
476		}
477		if publish != nil && checkIn != repoCheckInCommit {
478			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, errors.New("publishing repository setup requires --check-in=commit (or --commit) so the upstream includes the setup changes")
479		}
480		request := repoWorkflowRequest{
481			Name: name, Destination: root, Prepared: prepared, Handoff: handoff,
482			Publish: publish, BrowseSkills: flags.browseSkills,
483			CheckIn: checkIn, CommitMessage: flags.message,
484			DryRun: flags.dryRun, JSON: flags.json,
485		}
486		return request, validateRepoWorkflowRequest(app, request, flags.yes)
487	}
488	
489	func validateRepoWorkflowRequest(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest, yes bool) error {
490		if request.JSON && request.Handoff != repoHandoffStay {
491			return errors.New("--json requires --handoff=stay")
492		}
493		if request.Handoff == repoHandoffStart && !app.interactive() {
494			return errors.New("--handoff=start requires an interactive terminal")
495		}
496		if request.JSON && request.BrowseSkills {
497			return errors.New("--json cannot open the interactive upstream skills installer")
498		}
499		if request.BrowseSkills && !app.interactive() {
500			return errors.New("--browse-skills requires an interactive terminal")
501		}
502		if request.Kind == repo.AcquireNew && request.Publish != nil && request.Publish.Push {
503			if request.CheckIn != repoCheckInCommit {
504				return errors.New("pushing a new upstream requires --check-in=commit; use --push=false to create an empty upstream")
505			}
506		}
507		if request.Publish != nil && request.CheckIn == repoCheckInStage {
508			return errors.New("--check-in=stage cannot create an upstream; review and commit locally before publishing")
509		}
510		if request.Handoff == repoHandoffStart && request.CheckIn != repoCheckInCommit &&
511			(request.Kind == repo.AcquireNew || request.Scaffold.Preset != "" || request.Prepared.Plan.Root != "") {
512			return errors.New("--handoff=start requires --check-in=commit when repository setup changes files")
513		}
514		if request.Kind != repo.AcquireNew && request.Publish != nil {
515			remoteName := strings.TrimSpace(request.Publish.RemoteName)
516			if remoteName == "" {
517				remoteName = "origin"
518			}
519			if current := gitx.Remote(ctxOf(), request.Destination, remoteName); current != "" {
520				return fmt.Errorf("remote %s already points to %s; omit --remote or remove it explicitly before publishing", remoteName, current)
521			}
522		}
523		if !app.interactive() && !yes && (len(request.Prepared.Plan.Hooks) > 0 || len(request.Prepared.Plan.Skills) > 0 || request.BrowseSkills) {
524			return errors.New("non-interactive hooks or skill setup require --yes")
525		}
526		for _, skill := range request.Prepared.Plan.Skills {
527			if _, err := agentskill.InstallCommand(ctxOf(), request.Destination, skill.Source, []string{skill.Name}, skill.Agents); err != nil {
528				return fmt.Errorf("skill %s cannot be installed: %w", skill.Name, err)
529			}
530			if skill.Setup == nil || skill.Setup.Builtin != "" || skill.Setup.Interpreter == "" {
531				continue
532			}
533			if _, err := exec.LookPath(skill.Setup.Interpreter); err != nil && skill.Setup.Required {
534				return fmt.Errorf("skill %s setup requires unavailable interpreter %q", skill.Name, skill.Setup.Interpreter)
535			}
536		}
537		for _, hook := range request.Prepared.Plan.Hooks {
538			if runtime.GOOS == "windows" && strings.TrimSpace(hook.Run) != "" {
539				return fmt.Errorf("hook %s uses a POSIX shell expression, which is unsupported on Windows; use command = [...]", hook.ID)
540			}
541			if len(hook.Command) > 0 && hook.Required && !isRepoLocalExecutable(request.Destination, hook.Command[0]) {
542				if _, err := exec.LookPath(hook.Command[0]); err != nil {
543					return fmt.Errorf("hook %s requires unavailable executable %q", hook.ID, hook.Command[0])
544				}
545			}
546		}
547		return nil
548	}
549	
550	func isRepoLocalExecutable(root, executable string) bool {
551		if !filepath.IsAbs(executable) {
552			return strings.ContainsAny(executable, `/\\`)
553		}
554		relative, err := filepath.Rel(root, executable)
555		return err == nil && relative != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(relative, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
556	}
557	
558	func executeRepoWorkflow(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest) error {
559		if request.Kind == repo.AcquireClone && request.DryRun {
560			return renderCloneDryRun(app, request)
561		}
562		if request.Kind == repo.AcquireNew && request.DryRun {
563			return renderRepoDryRun(app, request)
564		}
565		if request.Kind == repo.AcquireClone {
566			if err := executeRepoCloneAcquire(app, &request); err != nil {
567				return err
568			}
569			if request.Scaffold.Preset != "" {
570				prepared, err := prepareRepoScaffold(app, request.Scaffold)
571				if err != nil {
572					return fmt.Errorf("clone is ready at %s but setup could not be prepared: %w", config.Contract(request.Destination), err)
573				}
574				request.Prepared = prepared
575				if err := validateRepoWorkflowRequest(app, request, true); err != nil {
576					return fmt.Errorf("clone is ready at %s but setup cannot start: %w", config.Contract(request.Destination), err)
577				}
578				if err := executeRepoSetup(app, request); err != nil {
579					return fmt.Errorf("clone is ready at %s but setup failed: %w", config.Contract(request.Destination), err)
580				}
581				return nil
582			}
583			return finishRepoClone(app, request)
584		}
585	
586		acquired, err := repo.Acquire(ctxOf(), repo.AcquireRequest{
587			Kind: repo.AcquireNew, Name: request.Name, Destination: request.Destination,
588			InitialBranch: request.Prepared.Plan.Settings.InitialBranch,
589		})
590		if err != nil {
591			return err
592		}
593		request.Destination = acquired.Path
594		result := repoWorkflowResult{
595			Operation: "new", Path: acquired.Path, Preset: request.Prepared.Plan.Preset,
596			Created: true, Handoff: request.Handoff,
597		}
598		if request.Template != nil {
599			applied, err := request.Template.Apply(acquired.Path)
600			if err != nil {
601				return fmt.Errorf("repository remains at %s: apply template: %w", config.Contract(acquired.Path), err)
602			}
603			result.Template = &applied
604		}
605		if err := executeScaffoldPipeline(app, request, &result); err != nil {
606			return fmt.Errorf("repository remains at %s: %w", config.Contract(acquired.Path), err)
607		}
608		return finishRepoWorkflow(app, request, result)
609	}
610	
611	func executeRepoCloneAcquire(app *App, request *repoWorkflowRequest) error {
612		if request.DryRun {
613			return renderCloneDryRun(app, *request)
614		}
615		acquired, err := repo.Acquire(ctxOf(), repo.AcquireRequest{
616			Kind: repo.AcquireClone, Name: request.Name, CloneRef: request.Ref, Destination: request.Destination,
617		})
618		if err != nil {
619			return err
620		}
621		request.Destination = acquired.Path
622		request.Name = acquired.Name
623		return nil
624	}
625	
626	func finishRepoClone(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest) error {
627		result := repoWorkflowResult{
628			Operation: "clone", Path: request.Destination, Created: true, Cloned: true, Handoff: request.Handoff,
629		}
630		return finishRepoWorkflow(app, request, result)
631	}
632	
633	func executeRepoSetup(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest) error {
634		if request.Prepared.Plan.Root == "" {
635			prepared, err := prepareRepoScaffold(app, request.Scaffold)
636			if err != nil {
637				return err
638			}
639			request.Prepared = prepared
640		}
641		if request.DryRun {
642			return renderRepoDryRun(app, request)
643		}
644		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctxOf(), request.Destination)
645		if err != nil {
646			return err
647		}
648		if status.Dirty() {
649			return errors.New("repo setup requires a clean checkout so its changes remain attributable")
650		}
651		operation := "setup"
652		created, cloned := false, false
653		if request.Kind == repo.AcquireClone {
654			operation, created, cloned = "clone", true, true
655		}
656		result := repoWorkflowResult{
657			Operation: operation, Path: request.Destination, Preset: request.Prepared.Plan.Preset,
658			Created: created, Cloned: cloned, Handoff: request.Handoff,
659		}
660		if err := executeScaffoldPipeline(app, request, &result); err != nil {
661			return err
662		}
663		return finishRepoWorkflow(app, request, result)
664	}
665	
666	func executeScaffoldPipeline(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest, result *repoWorkflowResult) error {
667		trustApp := app
668		if request.JSON {
669			copy := *app
670			copy.Out = app.Err
671			copy.interactiveCheck = func() bool { return false }
672			trustApp = &copy
673		}
674		if err := ensureProjectConfigTrust(trustApp, request.Destination, request.Prepared.Project, request.Prepared.Plan); err != nil {
675			return err
676		}
677		applied, err := applyPreparedRepoScaffold(request.Prepared, request.Kind != repo.AcquireNew || request.Template != nil)
678		if err != nil {
679			return err
680		}
681		result.Scaffold = applied
682		result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, applied.Native.Warnings...)
683		for _, warning := range applied.Native.Warnings {
684			app.warnf("%s", warning)
685		}
686	
687		workingApp := app
688		if request.JSON {
689			copy := *app
690			copy.Out = app.Err
691			workingApp = &copy
692		}
693		skills := repoSkillsFromPlan(request.Prepared.Plan)
694		installed, err := installRepoSkills(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, skills)
695		if err != nil {
696			return err
697		}
698		result.Skills.Installed = append(result.Skills.Installed, installed.Installed...)
699		result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, installed.Warnings...)
700		if request.BrowseSkills {
701			source := agentskill.DefaultSource
702			if len(request.Prepared.Plan.Catalog) > 0 && request.Prepared.Plan.Catalog[0].Source != "" {
703				source = request.Prepared.Plan.Catalog[0].Source
704			}
705			if err := runUpstreamSkillCatalog(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, source); err != nil {
706				return err
707			}
708		}
709		hooks := repoHooksFromPlan(request.Prepared.Plan)
710		beforeSkill, err := runRepoSkillSetups(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, repoHookBeforeCommit, skills)
711		if err != nil {
712			return err
713		}
714		result.Skills.Setup = append(result.Skills.Setup, beforeSkill.Setup...)
715		result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, beforeSkill.Warnings...)
716		beforeHooks, err := runRepoHooks(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, repoHookBeforeCommit, hooks)
717		result.Hooks = appendRepoHookResult(result.Hooks, beforeHooks)
718		result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, beforeHooks.Warnings...)
719		if err != nil {
720			return err
721		}
722	
723		checkIn := request.CheckIn
724		if checkIn == repoCheckInAuto || checkIn == "" {
725			checkIn = repoCheckInNone
726		}
727		if checkIn != repoCheckInNone {
728			if request.Kind != repo.AcquireNew {
729				status, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctxOf(), request.Destination)
730				if statusErr != nil {
731					return statusErr
732				}
733				if !status.Dirty() {
734					checkIn = repoCheckInNone
735				}
736			}
737		}
738		if checkIn == repoCheckInStage {
739			message := repoCommitMessage(request)
740			staged, provider, warning, err := stageRepoForReview(ctxOf(), request.Destination, message)
741			if err != nil {
742				return err
743			}
744			result.Staged = staged > 0
745			result.StagedPaths = staged
746			result.CommitMessage = message
747			result.CommitDraftProvider = provider
748			if warning != "" {
749				result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, warning)
750				app.warnf("%s", warning)
751			}
752		}
753		if checkIn == repoCheckInCommit {
754			message := repoCommitMessage(request)
755			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctxOf(), request.Destination, "add", "-A"); err != nil {
756				return err
757			}
758			commitArgs := []string{"commit", "-m", message}
759			if request.Kind == repo.AcquireNew {
760				commitArgs = append(commitArgs, "--allow-empty")
761			}
762			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctxOf(), request.Destination, commitArgs...); err != nil {
763				return err
764			}
765			result.Commit = true
766			result.CommitMessage = message
767			afterSkill, err := runRepoSkillSetups(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, repoHookAfterCommit, skills)
768			if err != nil {
769				return err
770			}
771			result.Skills.Setup = append(result.Skills.Setup, afterSkill.Setup...)
772			result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, afterSkill.Warnings...)
773			afterHooks, err := runRepoHooks(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, repoHookAfterCommit, hooks)
774			result.Hooks = appendRepoHookResult(result.Hooks, afterHooks)
775			result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, afterHooks.Warnings...)
776			if err != nil {
777				return err
778			}
779		}
780		if request.Publish != nil {
781			published, err := publishRepository(ctxOf(), request.Destination, *request.Publish)
782			result.Remote = &published
783			if err != nil {
784				detail := ""
785				if published.Remote.URL != "" {
786					detail = "; upstream may already exist at " + published.Remote.URL
787				}
788				return fmt.Errorf("local repository is ready but upstream publication failed%s: %w", detail, err)
789			}
790			afterRemoteSkill, err := runRepoSkillSetups(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, repoHookAfterRemote, skills)
791			if err != nil {
792				return err
793			}
794			result.Skills.Setup = append(result.Skills.Setup, afterRemoteSkill.Setup...)
795			result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, afterRemoteSkill.Warnings...)
796			afterRemoteHooks, err := runRepoHooks(ctxOf(), workingApp, request.Destination, repoHookAfterRemote, hooks)
797			result.Hooks = appendRepoHookResult(result.Hooks, afterRemoteHooks)
798			result.Warnings = append(result.Warnings, afterRemoteHooks.Warnings...)
799			if err != nil {
800				return err
801			}
802		}
803		return nil
804	}

806	func appendRepoHookResult(results []repoHookResult, next repoHookResult) []repoHookResult {
807		if len(next.Ran) == 0 && len(next.Warnings) == 0 {

809		}
810		return append(results, next)

813	func finishRepoWorkflow(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest, result repoWorkflowResult) error {

820		if verb == "new" {
821			verb = "created"
822		} else if verb == "clone" {
823			verb = "cloned"
824		} else {
825			verb = "set up"
826		}
827		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "%s %s\n", verb, config.Contract(result.Path))
828		if result.Preset != "" {
829			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  preset  %s\n", result.Preset)
830		}
831		if result.Remote != nil && result.Remote.Remote.URL != "" {
832			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  remote  %s\n", result.Remote.Remote.URL)
833		}
834		if result.Template != nil {
835			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  template %s (%d files)\n", result.Template.Source, result.Template.AppliedFiles)
836		}
837		if result.Commit {
838			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  commit  %s\n", result.CommitMessage)
839		} else if result.Staged {
840			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  staged  %d path(s) for review\n", result.StagedPaths)
841			if result.CommitDraftProvider == "lazygit" {
842				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  message %s (prefilled for lazygit c)\n", result.CommitMessage)
843			} else {
844				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  message %s\n", result.CommitMessage)
845			}
846		}
847		warnOutsideDiscovery(app, result.Path)
848		if result.Handoff == repoHandoffStart {
849			status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctxOf(), result.Path)
850			if err == nil && status.Dirty() {
851				return errors.New("cannot start an isolated task while setup changes are uncommitted; commit them or choose --handoff=cd")
852			}
853		}
854		return performRepoHandoff(app, result.Path, filepath.Base(result.Path), result.Handoff)
855	}

973	func repoDestination(projectRoot, category, name, exact string) (string, error) {
974		if err := pathx.ValidateComponent(name); err != nil {
975			return "", fmt.Errorf("repository name %q: %w", name, err)
976		}
977		if exact != "" {
978			return pathx.Canonical(config.Expand(exact))
979		}
980		root := config.Expand(projectRoot)
981		components, err := categoryComponents(category)
982		if err != nil {
983			return "", err
984		}
985		components = append(components, name)
986		return pathx.JoinChild(root, components...)
987	}

989	func categoryComponents(category string) ([]string, error) {
990		category = strings.TrimSpace(category)
991		if filepath.IsAbs(category) || filepath.VolumeName(category) != "" {
992			return nil, fmt.Errorf("category %q must be relative to project_root", category)
993		}
994		var result []string
995		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(category, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
996			if component != "" {
997				result = append(result, component)
998			}
999		}
1000		return result, nil
1001	}

1033	func publishRequestFromFlags(flags repoBootstrapFlags, name string) (*repoPublishRequest, error) {
1034		if !flags.remote && flags.forge == "auto" {
1035			return nil, nil
1036		}
1037		if flags.forge == "none" {
1038			return nil, nil
1039		}
1040		kind, err := chooseForge(flags.forge)
1041		if err != nil {
1042			return nil, err
1043		}
1044		readiness := forge.Probe(ctxOf(), kind)
1045		if !readiness.Ready() {
1046			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s is not ready: %s; %s", kind, readiness.Detail, readiness.Action)
1047		}
1048		visibility := forge.VisibilityPrivate
1049		if flags.public && flags.visibility != "" && flags.visibility != string(forge.VisibilityPublic) {
1050			return nil, errors.New("--public conflicts with --visibility")
1051		}
1052		if flags.public {
1053			visibility = forge.VisibilityPublic
1054		} else if flags.visibility != "" {
1055			visibility = forge.Visibility(flags.visibility)
1056		} else if !flags.private {
1057			visibility = forge.VisibilityPublic
1058		}
1059		switch visibility {
1060		case forge.VisibilityPrivate, forge.VisibilityPublic, forge.VisibilityInternal:
1061		default:
1062			return nil, fmt.Errorf("visibility %q: want private, public or internal", visibility)
1063		}
1064		return &repoPublishRequest{
1065			Forge: kind, Name: name, Namespace: flags.namespace,
1066			Description: flags.description, Visibility: visibility, Push: flags.push,
1067		}, nil
1068	}

1070	func chooseForge(name string) (forge.Kind, error) {
1071		switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
1072		case "github":
1073			return forge.GitHub, nil
1074		case "gitlab":
1075			return forge.GitLab, nil
1076		case "", "auto":
1077			for _, readiness := range forge.ProbeAll(ctxOf()) {
1078				if readiness.Ready() {
1079					return readiness.Forge, nil
1080				}
1081			}
1082			return forge.Unknown, errors.New("neither GitHub nor GitLab CLI is installed and authenticated")
1083		default:
1084			return forge.Unknown, fmt.Errorf("forge %q: want auto, github, gitlab or none", name)
1085		}
1086	}

1088	func looksLikeCloneReference(value string) bool {
1089		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
1090		if strings.Contains(value, "://") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "git@") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "file://") {
1091			return true
1092		}
1093		if strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
1094			return true
1095		}
1096		if filepath.IsAbs(value) || strings.HasPrefix(value, "./") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "../") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "~/") {
1097			return true
1098		}
1099		return false
1100	}

1102	func resolveSetupRepo(app *App, args []string) (string, error) {
1103		if len(args) == 0 {
1104			cwd, err := os.Getwd()
1105			if err != nil {
1106				return "", err
1107			}
1108			discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctxOf(), cwd)
1109			if err != nil {
1110				return "", errors.New("current directory is not a repository; pass a repo or path")
1111			}
1112			return discovered.Root, nil
1113		}
1114		ref := args[0]
1115		if looksLikeRepoPath(ref) {
1116			discovered, err := gitx.Discover(ctxOf(), config.Expand(ref))
1117			if err == nil {
1118				return discovered.Root, nil
1119			}
1120		}
1121		resolved, _, err := resolveRepoRef(app, ref)
1122		if err != nil {
1123			return "", err
1124		}
1125		return resolved.Path, nil
1126	}
1127	
1128	func looksLikeRepoPath(value string) bool {
1129		return filepath.IsAbs(value) || strings.HasPrefix(value, ".") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "~") ||
1130			strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`)
1131	}

1133	func warnOutsideDiscovery(app *App, path string) {
1134		for _, root := range app.Cfg.ScanRoots() {
1135			if contains, _ := pathx.Contains(root, path); contains {
1136				return
1137			}
1138		}
1139		for _, exact := range app.Cfg.RepoPaths() {
1140			left, _ := pathx.Canonical(exact)
1141			right, _ := pathx.Canonical(path)
1142			if left != "" && left == right {
1143				return
1144			}
1145		}
1146		app.warnf("%s is outside paths.scan_roots/repo_paths and will not appear in dev repo list", config.Contract(path))
1147	}

1149	func parseInputDefault(value any) string {
1150		switch typed := value.(type) {
1151		case string:
1152			return typed
1153		case bool:
1154			return strconv.FormatBool(typed)
1155		default:
1156			return ""

164					}

166				}
167				if result.Runtime.Name() == "none" {

169				}
170				if focus && !jsonOut {

172				}

237		}

239		rootPaneID := launchableStartRootPane(t, runtimeName, opened)

241			TaskID: t.ID, Repo: t.Repo, RepoPath: repoPath, Branch: t.Branch, Base: t.Base,
242			Mode: string(t.EffectiveMode()), WorktreePath: worktreePath, Checkout: checkout,
243			Runtime: startRuntimeJSON{
244				Name: runtimeName, Handle: opened.Handle, Surface: opened.Surface,
245				Opened: opened.Opened, Created: opened.Created, RootPaneID: rootPaneID,
246			},
247		})

287	func annotate(app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, t *task.Task) {
288		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {

12	// joinRepoAssets matches a discovery snapshot without persisting every repo.

15	func joinRepoAssets(app *App, repos []repo.Repo) (assets []*catalog.Entry, complete bool, err error) {
16		assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(repos))
17		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil {
18			return assets, true, nil
19		}
20		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
21		if err != nil {
22			app.warnf("could not read catalog metadata: %v; leaving repository rows unsuppressed", err)
23			return assets, false, nil
24		}
25		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
26			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
27		}
28		complete = len(diagnostics) == 0
29		host := configHostname()
30		for index, repository := range repos {
31			var matches []*catalog.Entry
32			for _, entry := range entries {
33				location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
34				if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent {
35					continue
36				}
37				if repoLocationMatches(repository, location) {
38					matches = append(matches, entry)
39				}
40			}
41			catalog.Sort(matches)
42			switch len(matches) {
43			case 1:
44				assets[index] = matches[0].Clone()
45			case 0:
46			default:
47				ids := make([]string, len(matches))
48				for i, entry := range matches {
49					ids[i] = entry.ID
50				}
51				sort.Strings(ids)
52				app.warnf("repository %s matches multiple catalog assets (%v); leaving it unsuppressed", repository.Path, ids)
53			}
54		}
55		return assets, complete, nil
56	}

59		repositoryPaths := canonicalRepoValues(repository.Path, repository.RealPath)

64			}

67		return common != "" && common == canonicalRepoValue(location.GitCommonDir)
68	}

89	func matchesSize(usage *diskusage.Usage, expression string) bool {
90		if usage == nil {
91			return false
92		}
93		expression = strings.TrimSpace(expression)
94		operator := "="
95		for _, candidate := range []string{">=", "<=", ">", "<", "="} {
96			if strings.HasPrefix(expression, candidate) {
97				operator = candidate
98				expression = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(expression, candidate))
99				break
100			}
101		}
102		bytes, err := humanize.ParseBytes(expression)
103		if err != nil {
104			return false
105		}
106		owned := uint64(max(usage.OwnedBytes, 0))
107		switch operator {
108		case ">=":
109			return owned >= bytes
110		case "<=":
111			return owned <= bytes
112		case ">":
113			return owned > bytes
114		case "<":
115			return owned < bytes
116		default:
117			return owned == bytes
118		}
119	}

133			fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s", styleDim.Render("checkout"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(usage.CheckoutBytes, 0)))),
134		}

137				humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.PrivateGitBytes, 0)))))
138		}
139		if usage.SharedGitBytes != nil {
140			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %s  %s (not reclaimable with this checkout)",
141				styleDim.Render("shared .git"), humanize.IBytes(uint64(max(*usage.SharedGitBytes, 0)))))
142		}
143		if !usage.Complete {

1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"

15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16	)
17	
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory; CommonDir is shared
38		// by every linked worktree of the clone.
39		GitDir    string
40		CommonDir string
41		MainRoot  string
42		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
43		Bare bool
44		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
45		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
46		// initialise them.
47		HasGit bool
48	}
49	
50	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
51	func (r Repo) Display() string {
52		if r.Category == "" {
53			return r.Name
54		}
55		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
56	}
57	
58	// Options tunes discovery.
59	type Options struct {
60		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
61		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
62		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
63		MaxDepth int
64		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
65		IncludeNonRepos bool
66		// Fast avoids per-repository git subprocesses. It is intended for shell
67		// completion: direct .git-file checkouts are skipped as linked worktrees and
68		// symlink aliases are deduplicated by their physical path.
69		Fast bool
70	}
71	
72	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
73	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
74	
75	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.
76	func CompletionOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3, Fast: true} }
77	
78	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
79	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
80	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
81		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
82		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
83		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
84		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,

87	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
88	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
89	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101	
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108	
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}

17	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
18	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.

21		SourceID  string                  `json:"source_id,omitempty"`

23		Complete  bool                    `json:"complete,omitempty"`

25		Repos     []RemoteRepo            `json:"repos"`
26	}
27	
28	const (
29		CacheVersion      = 2
30		maxCacheBytes     = 32 << 20
31		maxCachedRepos    = 100_000
32		maxCacheClockSkew = 5 * time.Minute
33	)
34	
35	var cacheWriteLocks sync.Map
36	
37	type ProviderStatus struct {
38		FetchedAt time.Time `json:"fetched_at,omitempty"`
39		Complete  bool      `json:"complete"`
40		Error     string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
41	}
42	
43	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
44	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
45	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
46		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
47		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
48			return Cache{}, false
49		}
50		return c, true
51	}
52	
53	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
54	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
55	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
56		info, err := os.Stat(path)
57		if err != nil || info.Size() < 0 || info.Size() > maxCacheBytes {
58			return Cache{}, false
59		}
60		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Cache{}, false
63		}
64		var c Cache
65		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || !validCache(c, time.Now().UTC()) {
66			return Cache{}, false
67		}
68		if c.Version == 0 {
69			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
70			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
71			c.Complete = false
72		}
73		return c, true
74	}
75	
76	func validCache(c Cache, now time.Time) bool {
77		if (c.Version != 0 && c.Version != CacheVersion) || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() ||
78			c.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) || len(c.Repos) > maxCachedRepos ||
79			!validCacheString(c.SourceID, 128, false) {
80			return false
81		}
82		for kind, status := range c.Providers {
83			if !validForgeKind(kind) || len(status.Error) > 16<<10 || strings.ContainsRune(status.Error, '\x00') ||
84				status.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) {
85				return false
86			}
87		}
88		for _, repository := range c.Repos {
89			if !validForgeKind(repository.Forge) || pathx.ValidateComponent(repository.Name) != nil ||
90				!validCacheString(repository.FullName, 2048, true) ||
91				!validCacheString(repository.Description, 64<<10, false) ||
92				!validCacheString(repository.URL, 8<<10, false) ||
93				!validCacheString(repository.CloneURL, 8<<10, false) ||
94				!validCacheString(repository.SSHURL, 8<<10, false) ||
95				!validCacheString(repository.Visibility, 128, false) ||
96				!validCacheString(repository.DefaultBranch, 1024, false) ||
97				repository.UpdatedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) {
98				return false
99			}
100		}
101		return true
102	}
103	
104	func validForgeKind(kind Kind) bool {
105		return kind == GitHub || kind == GitLab || kind == AzureDevOps
106	}
107	
108	func validCacheString(value string, limit int, required bool) bool {
109		return (!required || strings.TrimSpace(value) != "") && len(value) <= limit && !strings.ContainsRune(value, '\x00')
110	}
111	
112	// FreshFor additionally requires the cache to describe the same configured
113	// provider endpoints/targets. Caches without a source ID remain displayable but
114	// are immediately revalidated.
115	func (c Cache) FreshFor(maxAge time.Duration, sourceID string) bool {
116		return sourceID != "" && c.SourceID == sourceID && c.Fresh(maxAge)
117	}
118	
119	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
120		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
121			return false
122		}
123		if maxAge <= 0 {
124			return true
125		}
126		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
127			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
128		}
129		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
130			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
131				return false
132			}
133		}
134		return true
135	}

28	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {

47		switch msg := message.(type) {
48		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
49			m.width = msg.Width

64			case tea.KeyEnter:
65				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
66					return m, nil
67				}
68				m.done = true
69				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
70				m.input.Blur()

72			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:

74				return m, nil
75			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
76				m.move(1)
77				return m, nil
78			}
79		}

87	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
88		if m.done {
89			return "\n"

91		var out strings.Builder
92		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
93		out.WriteByte('\n')

95			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
96			return out.String()
97		}
98		end := m.offset + m.rows
99		if end > len(m.visible) {
100			end = len(m.visible)
101		}
102		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
103			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]

105			if position == m.cursor {

152	func (r RepoRow) matches(query string) bool {
153		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
154		for _, term := range strings.Fields(query) {
155			key, value, structured := strings.Cut(term, ":")
156			if structured {
157				switch key {
158				case "tag":
159					if r.Asset == nil || !r.Asset.HasTag(value) {
160						return false
161					}
162					continue
163				case "remote":
164					if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Topology.Summary()), value) {
165						return false
166					}
167					continue
168				case "size":
169					if !matchesSize(r.Usage, value) {
170						return false
171					}
172					continue
173				case "kind":
174					kind := catalog.KindRepository
175					if r.Asset != nil {
176						kind = r.Asset.Kind
177					}
178					if string(kind) != value {
179						return false
180					}
181					continue
182				}
183			}
184			if !strings.Contains(r.searchText(), term) {
185				return false
186			}
187		}
188		return true
189	}

42	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
43		return textinput.Blink

46	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
47		switch msg := message.(type) {
48		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
49			m.width = msg.Width
50			available := msg.Height - 3
51			switch {
52			case available < 1:
53				m.rows = 1
54			case available < defaultVisibleRows:
55				m.rows = available
56			default:
57				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
58			}
59			m.keepVisible()
60			return m, nil
61		case tea.KeyMsg:
62			switch msg.Type {
63			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
64				m.done = true
65				m.canceled = true
66				m.input.Blur()
67				return m, tea.Quit
68			case tea.KeyEnter:
69				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.done = true
73				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
74				m.input.Blur()
75				return m, tea.Quit
76			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
77				m.move(-1)
78				return m, nil
79			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
80				m.move(1)
81				return m, nil
82			}
83		}
84	
85		var command tea.Cmd
86		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
87		m.refilter()
88		return m, command

91	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
92		if m.done {
93			return "\n"
94		}
95		var out strings.Builder
96		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
97		out.WriteByte('\n')
98		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
99			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
100			return out.String()
101		}
102		end := m.offset + m.rows
103		if end > len(m.visible) {
104			end = len(m.visible)
105		}
106		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
107			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
108			marker := "  "
109			if position == m.cursor {
110				marker = "> "
111			}
112			line := marker + item.Label
113			if item.Description != "" {
114				line += "  " + item.Description
115			}
116			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
117			out.WriteByte('\n')
118		}
119		return out.String()

122	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
123		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
124		for index, item := range m.items {
125			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
126				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)

128		}
129		m.cursor = 0
130		m.offset = 0

135			return
136		}

139			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
140		}
141		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
142			m.cursor = 0
143		}

153		}

173	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
174		program := tea.NewProgram(
175			newBuiltinModel(request),
176			tea.WithInput(s.in),
177			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
178			tea.WithContext(ctx),
179		)
180		final, err := program.Run()
181		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
182			return Result{}, ctxErr
183		}
184		if err != nil {
185			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
186		}
187		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
188		if !ok {
189			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
190		}
191		if model.canceled {
192			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
193		}
194		if !model.done {
195			return Result{}, nil
196		}
197		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
198	}

+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}

+const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
+
+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}

162	// newlines. Without the wrapper, retain the printable directive used by older

164	func (a *App) cdDirective(dir string) error {
165		// Windows shells do not inherit an extra descriptor the way the POSIX
166		// wrapper's `3>file` redirection does, so the PowerShell wrapper names a
167		// temp file instead and reads it back after dev exits.

170		}

172			fd, err := strconv.Atoi(rawFD)
173			if err != nil || fd < 3 {
174				return fmt.Errorf("invalid DEV_SHELL_CD_FD %q", rawFD)

177			if file == nil {

179			}

182			}

185			}

+func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
+	manual := func() (string, error) {
+		return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
+	}
+	if !app.canPick() {
+		return manual()
+	}
+
+	cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
+	sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})
+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
+		app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
+	}
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
+		if result.Canceled {
+			return "", errPromptCanceled
+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil
+}

 	if name == "" {
 		return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a repository name from %q", ref)

 		return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
 	}
 	flags.category = category
 	defaultDestination, err := repoDestination(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot, flags.category, name, flags.path)
 	if err != nil {
 		return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
 	}
 	destination, err := p.line("Destination", config.Contract(defaultDestination))

+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())

+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath

+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})

+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil

119	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
120		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
121			return false
122		}
123		if maxAge <= 0 {
124			return true
125		}
126		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
127			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
128		}
129		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
130			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
131				return false
132			}
133		}
134		return true
135	}

139	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {

142		for _, repo := range repos {

144		}

1377	func matchRemoteLocals(ctx context.Context, app *App, remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1378		locals, _ := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
1379		assets, _, assetErr := joinRepoAssets(app, locals)
1380		if assetErr != nil {
1381			app.warnf("could not join catalog metadata to remote locals: %v", assetErr)
1382			assets = make([]*catalog.Entry, len(locals))
1383		}
1384		type localMatch struct {
1385			repository repo.Repo
1386			asset      *catalog.Entry
1387		}
1388		localByRemote := map[string]localMatch{}
1389		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1390		for index, r := range locals {
1391			if r.Bare {
1392				continue
1393			}
1394			kind, name := forge.IdentityFromURL(gitx.RemoteFromConfig(r.CommonDir, "origin"))
1395			if kind == forge.Unknown || name == "" {
1396				continue
1397			}
1398			key := string(kind) + "/" + strings.ToLower(name)
1399			if ambiguous[key] {
1400				continue
1401			}
1402			if _, exists := localByRemote[key]; exists {
1403				delete(localByRemote, key)
1404				ambiguous[key] = true
1405				continue
1406			}
1407			localByRemote[key] = localMatch{repository: r, asset: assets[index]}
1408		}
1409		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1410		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1411			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1412			if local, ok := localByRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1413				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.repository.Path, local.repository.Display()
1414				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1415				if local.asset != nil {
1416					row.LocalKind = local.asset.Kind
1417				}
1418			}
1419			out = append(out, row)
1420		}
1421		// Linked-worktree Tries are intentionally absent from repo.Discover's project
1422		// inventory, so use their explicit catalog identity as a second safe source.
1423		applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app, out)

1427	func applyCatalogRemoteMatches(app *App, rows []tui.RemoteRow) {
1428		if app == nil || app.Catalog == nil || len(rows) == 0 {
1429			return
1430		}
1431		entries, diagnostics, err := app.Catalog.ListWithDiagnostics()
1432		if err != nil {
1433			app.warnf("could not read catalog for remote matching: %v", err)
1434			return
1435		}
1436		for _, diagnostic := range diagnostics {
1437			app.warnf("%s", diagnostic.Error())
1438		}
1439		if len(diagnostics) > 0 {
1440			return
1441		}
1442		host := config.Hostname()
1443		byIdentity := make(map[string][]*catalog.Entry)
1444		for _, entry := range entries {
1445			location, ok := entry.LocationFor(host)
1446			if !ok || location.State != catalog.LocationPresent || entry.RemoteIdentity == "" ||
1447				liveCatalogLocationPath(location) == "" {
1448				continue
1449			}
1450			byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity] = append(byIdentity[entry.RemoteIdentity], entry)
1451		}
1452		for index := range rows {
1453			identity := catalog.NormalizeRemoteIdentity(rows[index].Repo.CloneURL)
1454			matches := byIdentity[identity]
1455			if identity == "" || len(matches) != 1 {
1456				continue
1457			}
1458			location, _ := matches[0].LocationFor(host)
1459			rows[index].LocalPath = liveCatalogLocationPath(location)
1460			rows[index].LocalName = matches[0].Name
1461			rows[index].LocalKind = matches[0].Kind
1462		}
1463	}

1465	func liveCatalogLocationPath(location catalog.Location) string {
1466		for _, candidate := range []string{location.CurrentPath, location.RealPath} {
1467			if candidate == "" {
1468				continue
1469			}
1470			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
1471				return candidate
1472			}
1473		}
1474		return ""
1475	}

1515				}
1516				_ = os.Remove(path)
1517				return nil
1518			},
