```text
42	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
43		return textinput.Blink
44	}
45	
46	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
47		switch msg := message.(type) {
48		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
49			m.width = msg.Width
50			available := msg.Height - 3
51			switch {
52			case available < 1:
53				m.rows = 1
54			case available < defaultVisibleRows:
55				m.rows = available
56			default:
57				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
58			}
59			m.keepVisible()
60			return m, nil
61		case tea.KeyMsg:
62			switch msg.Type {
63			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
64				m.done = true
65				m.canceled = true
66				m.input.Blur()
67				return m, tea.Quit
68			case tea.KeyEnter:
69				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.done = true
73				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
74				m.input.Blur()
75				return m, tea.Quit
76			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
77				m.move(-1)
78				return m, nil
79			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
80				m.move(1)
81				return m, nil
82			}
83		}
84	
85		query := m.input.Value()
86		var command tea.Cmd
87		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
88		if m.input.Value() != query {
89			m.refilter()
90		}
91		return m, command
92	}
93	
94	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
95		if m.done {
96			return "\n"
97		}
98		var out strings.Builder
99		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
100		out.WriteByte('\n')
101		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
102			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
103			return out.String()
104		}
105		end := m.offset + m.rows
106		if end > len(m.visible) {
107			end = len(m.visible)
108		}
109		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
110			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
111			marker := "  "
112			if position == m.cursor {
113				marker = "> "
114			}
115			line := marker + item.Label
116			if item.Description != "" {
117				line += "  " + item.Description
118			}
119			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
120			out.WriteByte('\n')
121		}
122		return out.String()
123	}
124	
125	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
126		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
127		for index, item := range m.items {
128			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
129				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
130			}
131		}
132		m.cursor = 0
133		m.offset = 0
134	}
135	
136	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
137		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
138			return
139		}
140		m.cursor += delta
141		if m.cursor < 0 {
142			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
143		}
144		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
145			m.cursor = 0
146		}
147		m.keepVisible()
148	}
149	
150	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
151		if m.rows <= 0 {
152			m.rows = 1
153		}
154		if m.cursor < m.offset {
155			m.offset = m.cursor
156		}
157		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
158			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
159		}
160	}
161	
162	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
163		if width <= 0 {
164			return value
165		}
166		runes := []rune(value)
167		if len(runes) <= width {
168			return value
169		}
170		if width == 1 {
171			return "…"
172		}
173		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
174	}
175	
176	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
177		program := tea.NewProgram(
178			newBuiltinModel(request),
179			tea.WithInput(s.in),
180			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
181			tea.WithContext(ctx),
182		)
183		final, err := program.Run()
184		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
185			return Result{}, ctxErr
186		}
187		if err != nil {
188			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
189		}
190		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
191		if !ok {
192			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
193		}
194		if model.canceled {
195			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
196		}
197		if !model.done {
198			return Result{}, nil
199		}
200		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
201	}
```

```text
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
153
```

```text
9	func (a *App) canPick() bool {
10		return a.pickerSelect != nil || terminalPair(a.In, a.Out)
11	}
12	
13	// pick opens a selector only when both application streams are terminals. The
14	// bool reports whether an interaction was attempted, allowing callers to retain
15	// their deterministic line-oriented fallback for pipes and tests.
16	func (a *App) pick(ctx context.Context, request picker.Request) (picker.Result, bool, error) {
17		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
18			return picker.Result{}, false, nil
19		}
20		if a.pickerSelect != nil {
21			result, err := a.pickerSelect(ctx, request)
22			return result, true, err
23		}
24		if !a.canPick() {
25			return picker.Result{}, false, nil
26		}
27		result, err := picker.New(a.In, a.Out, a.Err, a.Cfg.Picker.Command).Select(ctx, request)
28		return result, true, err
29	}
```

```text
17	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
18	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.
19	type Cache struct {
20		Version   int                     `json:"version,omitempty"`
21		SourceID  string                  `json:"source_id,omitempty"`
22		FetchedAt time.Time               `json:"fetched_at"`
23		Complete  bool                    `json:"complete,omitempty"`
24		Providers map[Kind]ProviderStatus `json:"providers,omitempty"`
25		Repos     []RemoteRepo            `json:"repos"`
26	}
27	
28	const (
29		CacheVersion      = 2
30		maxCacheBytes     = 32 << 20
31		maxCachedRepos    = 100_000
32		maxCacheClockSkew = 5 * time.Minute
33	)
34	
35	var cacheWriteLocks sync.Map
36	
37	type ProviderStatus struct {
38		FetchedAt time.Time `json:"fetched_at,omitempty"`
39		Complete  bool      `json:"complete"`
40		Error     string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
41	}
42	
43	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
44	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
45	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
46		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
47		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
48			return Cache{}, false
49		}
50		return c, true
51	}
52	
53	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
54	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
55	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
56		info, err := os.Stat(path)
57		if err != nil || info.Size() < 0 || info.Size() > maxCacheBytes {
58			return Cache{}, false
59		}
60		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Cache{}, false
63		}
64		var c Cache
65		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || !validCache(c, time.Now().UTC()) {
66			return Cache{}, false
67		}
68		if c.Version == 0 {
69			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
70			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
71			c.Complete = false
72		}
73		return c, true
74	}
75	
76	func validCache(c Cache, now time.Time) bool {
77		if (c.Version != 0 && c.Version != CacheVersion) || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() ||
78			c.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) || len(c.Repos) > maxCachedRepos ||
79			!validCacheString(c.SourceID, 128, false) {
80			return false
81		}
82		for kind, status := range c.Providers {
83			if !validForgeKind(kind) || len(status.Error) > 16<<10 || strings.ContainsRune(status.Error, '\x00') ||
84				status.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) {
85				return false
86			}
87		}
88		for _, repository := range c.Repos {
89			if !validForgeKind(repository.Forge) || pathx.ValidateComponent(repository.Name) != nil ||
90				!validCacheString(repository.FullName, 2048, true) ||
91				!validCacheString(repository.Description, 64<<10, false) ||
92				!validCacheString(repository.URL, 8<<10, false) ||
93				!validCacheString(repository.CloneURL, 8<<10, false) ||
94				!validCacheString(repository.SSHURL, 8<<10, false) ||
95				!validCacheString(repository.Visibility, 128, false) ||
96				!validCacheString(repository.DefaultBranch, 1024, false) ||
97				repository.UpdatedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) {
98				return false
99			}
100		}
101		return true
102	}
103	
104	func validForgeKind(kind Kind) bool {
105		return kind == GitHub || kind == GitLab || kind == AzureDevOps
106	}
107	
108	func validCacheString(value string, limit int, required bool) bool {
109		return (!required || strings.TrimSpace(value) != "") && len(value) <= limit && !strings.ContainsRune(value, '\x00')
110	}
111	
112	// FreshFor additionally requires the cache to describe the same configured
113	// provider endpoints/targets. Caches without a source ID remain displayable but
114	// are immediately revalidated.
115	func (c Cache) FreshFor(maxAge time.Duration, sourceID string) bool {
116		return sourceID != "" && c.SourceID == sourceID && c.Fresh(maxAge)
117	}
118	
119	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
120		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
121			return false
122		}
123		if maxAge <= 0 {
124			return true
125		}
126		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
127			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
128		}
129		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
130			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
131				return false
132			}
133		}
134		return true
135	}
136	
137	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
138	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
139	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
140		now := time.Now().UTC()
141		providers := map[Kind]ProviderStatus{}
142		for _, repo := range repos {
143			providers[repo.Forge] = ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
144		}
145		return SaveCacheState(path, Cache{Version: CacheVersion, FetchedAt: now, Complete: true, Providers: providers, Repos: repos})
146	}
147	
148	// SaveCacheState atomically replaces the versioned inventory cache.
149	func SaveCacheState(path string, cache Cache) error {
150		return SaveCacheStateContext(context.Background(), path, cache)
151	}
152	
153	// SaveCacheStateContext serializes one cache target and checks cancellation
154	// while holding that ordering boundary. A superseded generation therefore
155	// cannot rename after a newer generation has committed.
156	func SaveCacheStateContext(ctx context.Context, path string, cache Cache) error {
157		if path == "" {
158			return errors.New("empty cache path")
159		}
160		if ctx == nil {
161			ctx = context.Background()
162		}
163		lock := cacheWriteLock(path)
164		lock.Lock()
165		defer lock.Unlock()
166		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if cache.Version == 0 {
173			cache.Version = CacheVersion
174		}
175		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
176			cache.FetchedAt = time.Now().UTC()
177		}
178		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cache, "", "  ")
179		if err != nil {
180			return err
181		}
182		b = append(b, '\n')
183		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
184		if err != nil {
185			return err
186		}
187		name := tmp.Name()
188		defer os.Remove(name)
189		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
190			tmp.Close()
191			return err
192		}
193		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
194			return err
195		}
196		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
197			return err
198		}
199		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
200			return err
201		}
202		return os.Rename(name, path)
203	}
204	
205	func cacheWriteLock(path string) *sync.Mutex {
206		loaded, _ := cacheWriteLocks.LoadOrStore(filepath.Clean(path), &sync.Mutex{})
207		return loaded.(*sync.Mutex)
208	}
209	
210	// CacheExists reports whether any cache file exists, even stale. Used only for
211	// diagnostics.
212	func CacheExists(path string) bool {
213		_, err := os.Stat(path)
214		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
215	}
```

```text
1164	func matchRemoteRepoRows(remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo, locals []tui.RepoRow) []tui.RemoteRow {
1165		byRemote := map[string]tui.RepoRow{}
1166		ambiguous := map[string]bool{}
1167		for _, r := range locals {
1168			if r.RemoteForge == forge.Unknown || r.RemoteName == "" {
1169				continue
1170			}
1171			key := string(r.RemoteForge) + "/" + strings.ToLower(r.RemoteName)
1172			if ambiguous[key] {
1173				continue
1174			}
1175			if _, exists := byRemote[key]; exists {
1176				delete(byRemote, key)
1177				ambiguous[key] = true
1178				continue
1179			}
1180			byRemote[key] = r
1181		}
1182		out := make([]tui.RemoteRow, 0, len(remoteRepos))
1183		for _, rr := range remoteRepos {
1184			row := tui.RemoteRow{Repo: rr}
1185			if local, ok := byRemote[string(rr.Forge)+"/"+strings.ToLower(rr.FullName)]; ok {
1186				row.LocalPath, row.LocalName = local.Repo.Path, local.Repo.Display()
1187				row.LocalKind = catalog.KindRepository
1188				if local.Asset != nil {
1189					row.LocalKind = local.Asset.Kind
1190				}
1191			}
1192			out = append(out, row)
1193		}
1194		return out
1195	}

1197	// cachedRemotes returns a fresh, already-local-matched cache for instant TUI
1198	// navigation. Local paths are recomputed rather than cached because clones can
1199	// move independently of the forge inventory.
1200	func cachedRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, bool) {
1201		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1202		if !ok || !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1203			return nil, false
1204		}
1205		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), true
1206	}
1207	
1208	func cachedRemotesAny(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, forge.Cache, bool) {
1209		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1210		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != remoteCacheSourceID(app)) {
1211			return nil, forge.Cache{}, false
1212		}
1213		return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, cache.Repos), cache, true
1214	}

1216	// collectRemotes aggregates configured forge CLIs, caches the normalised response, then
1217	// marks remotes that already have a checkout under the configured scan roots.
1218	// Calls run concurrently so one slow forge does not serialise the other.
1219	type remoteCollectOptions struct {
1220		Locals       []tui.RepoRow
1221		LocalsSet    bool
1222		Providers    []forge.Forge
1223		ProvidersSet bool
1224	}
1225	
1226	func collectRemotes(ctx context.Context, app *App) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1227		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{})
1228	}
1229	
1230	func collectRemotesForRows(ctx context.Context, app *App, locals []tui.RepoRow) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1231		return collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx, app, remoteCollectOptions{Locals: locals, LocalsSet: true})
1232	}

1234	func collectRemotesWithOptions(ctx context.Context, app *App, options remoteCollectOptions) ([]tui.RemoteRow, error) {
1235		type result struct {
1236			kind  forge.Kind
1237			repos []forge.RemoteRepo
1238			err   error
1239		}
1240		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
1241		matchRows := func(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) []tui.RemoteRow {
1242			if options.LocalsSet {
1243				return matchRemoteRepoRows(repos, options.Locals)
1244			}
1245			return matchRemoteLocals(ctx, app, repos)
1246		}
1247		providers := options.Providers
1248		if !options.ProvidersSet {
1249			providers = configuredForges(app)
1250		}
1251		ch := make(chan result, len(providers))
1252		var wg sync.WaitGroup
1253		available := 0
1254		var unavailable []error
1255		expected := map[forge.Kind]bool{}
1256		var unavailableKinds []forge.Kind
1257		for _, f := range providers {
1258			if !f.Available() {
1259				// GitHub and GitLab remain opportunistic, but an explicit Azure
1260				// target should report why it did not contribute any repositories.
1261				if f.Kind() == forge.AzureDevOps {
1262					unavailable = append(unavailable, &forge.ErrNoCLI{Kind: forge.AzureDevOps, Bin: "az"})
1263					expected[f.Kind()] = true
1264					unavailableKinds = append(unavailableKinds, f.Kind())
1265				}
1266				continue
1267			}
1268			expected[f.Kind()] = true
1269			available++
1270			wg.Add(1)
1271			go func(f forge.Forge) {
1272				defer wg.Done()
1273				r, err := f.ListRepos(ctx)
1274				ch <- result{kind: f.Kind(), repos: r, err: err}
1275			}(f)
1276		}
1277		wg.Wait()
1278		close(ch)
1279		if available == 0 {
1280			if cached, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath()); ok && cached.SourceID == sourceID {
1281				rows := matchRows(cached.Repos)
1282				if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1283					return rows, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1284				}
1285				return rows, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1286			}
1287			if len(unavailable) > 0 {
1288				return nil, errors.Join(unavailable...)
1289			}
1290			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no supported forge CLI is installed")
1291		}
1292	
1293		old, _ := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
1294		if old.SourceID != sourceID {
1295			old = forge.Cache{}
1296		}
1297		byProvider := map[forge.Kind][]forge.RemoteRepo{}
1298		statuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1299		for _, r := range old.Repos {
1300			byProvider[r.Forge] = append(byProvider[r.Forge], r)
1301		}
1302		for kind, status := range old.Providers {
1303			statuses[kind] = status
1304		}
1305		errs := append([]error(nil), unavailable...)
1306		successful := 0
1307		now := time.Now().UTC()
1308		for _, kind := range unavailableKinds {
1309			status := statuses[kind]
1310			status.Error = "provider CLI unavailable"
1311			statuses[kind] = status
1312		}
1313		for res := range ch {
1314			if res.err != nil {
1315				errs = append(errs, res.err)
1316				status := statuses[res.kind]
1317				status.Error = res.err.Error()
1318				if len(byProvider[res.kind]) == 0 && len(res.repos) > 0 {
1319					byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1320					status.FetchedAt = now
1321					status.Complete = false
1322				}
1323				statuses[res.kind] = status
1324				continue
1325			}
1326			successful++
1327			byProvider[res.kind] = res.repos
1328			statuses[res.kind] = forge.ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
1329		}
1330		var remoteRepos []forge.RemoteRepo
1331		complete := true
1332		providerStatuses := map[forge.Kind]forge.ProviderStatus{}
1333		for kind := range expected {
1334			status, ok := statuses[kind]
1335			if !ok || !status.Complete {
1336				complete = false
1337			}
1338			if ok {
1339				providerStatuses[kind] = status
1340			}
1341			remoteRepos = append(remoteRepos, byProvider[kind]...)
1342		}
1343		sortRemoteRepos(remoteRepos)
1344		if successful > 0 {
1345			_ = forge.SaveCacheStateContext(ctx, remoteCachePath(), forge.Cache{
1346				Version: forge.CacheVersion, SourceID: sourceID, FetchedAt: now, Complete: complete,
1347				Providers: providerStatuses, Repos: remoteRepos,
1348			})
1349		}
1350		return matchRows(remoteRepos), errors.Join(errs...)
1351	}

1353	func sortRemoteRepos(repos []forge.RemoteRepo) {
1354		sort.SliceStable(repos, func(i, j int) bool {

1356				return repos[i].UpdatedAt.After(repos[j].UpdatedAt)
1357			}
1358			return repos[i].Label() < repos[j].Label()
1359		})
1360	}
```

```text
85	### Added
86	
87	- The TUI can write an opt-in, versioned performance trace when
88	  `DEV_TUI_TRACE` names an absolute new file. Relative timings distinguish CLI
89	  load, initial view construction, requested-tab cache/live snapshots, aggregate
90	  row counts, producer completion, discarded stale generations, and key-update
91	  work without recording repository/task/host/tool names, paths, commands, key
92	  values, URLs, handles, or raw errors. Traces are bounded, private, local-only,
93	  and written after the alternate screen is restored; activity `stats.db`
94	  remains unchanged.
95	- TASKS, REPOS, and TRY now publish independently from one shared local load
96	  cycle. Each cycle reads task intent, runtime sessions, and repository discovery
97	  once, shares an eight-slot TASKS/REPOS enrichment limit, and lets FLEET and
98	  REMOTE reuse the accepted REPOS snapshot instead of rescanning local projects.
99	
100	### Fixed
101	
102	- TUI construction and rendering no longer wait for runtime auto-detection,
103	  project-root discovery, cache decoding, interactive shell tool probes, or the
104	  passive release refresh. Per-view generations reject late results, cancel
105	  superseded reads, retain usable rows on refresh failure, and distinguish a
106	  successful empty result from no result.
107	- Successful empty forge refreshes now replace obsolete cached repositories;
108	  fleet cache identity includes the SSH port; forge cache identity includes
109	  configured GH/GL hosts and Azure targets; GitLab inventory no longer infers its
110	  host from cwd; canceled refreshes cannot commit cache state; oversized or
111	  malformed forge/fleet caches are ignored; and cached repository names cannot
112	  escape `project_root` when cloning.
113	
114	## [0.2.2] - 2026-08-31
115	
116	### Added
117	
118	- `dev start --run '<shell command>'` can dispatch an explicit command to the
119	  exact root pane returned for a newly created first-class Herdr worktree.
```

```text
97	func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
98		discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
99		if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
100			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
101		}
102	
103		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
104		byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
105		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
106		add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
107			if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
108				return
109			}
110			identity := repository.RealPath
111			if identity == "" {
112				identity = repository.Path
113			}
114			identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
115			if seen[identity] {
116				return
117			}
118			seen[identity] = true
119			byPath[repository.Path] = repository
120			items = append(items, picker.Item{
121				Value:       repository.Path,
122				Label:       repository.Display(),
123				Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
124			})
125		}
126		add(current)
127		for _, repository := range discovered {
128			add(repository)
129		}
130		if len(items) == 0 {
131			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
132		}
133		items = append(items, picker.Item{
134			Value:       manualStartRepository,
135			Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
136			Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
137		})
138	
139		result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
142		}
143		if result.Canceled {
144			return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
145		}
146		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
147			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
148		}
149		selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
150		if !ok {
151			return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
152		}
153		resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
154		if err != nil {
155			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
156		}
157		return resolved, true, nil
158	}

160	func runStartWizard(ctx context.Context, app *App, req startRequest) (*startSpec, bool, error) {
161		p := newPrompter(app)
162		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Start a tracked change stream"))
163	
164		r, err := promptStartRepository(ctx, app, p, req)
165		if err != nil {
166			return nil, false, err
167		}
168		if r.Bare {
169			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a bare repository and cannot host a task checkout", r.Display())
170		}
171		req.RepoRef, req.RepoExplicit = r.Path, true
172	
173		for strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
174			req.Name, err = p.line("Task name", "")
175			if err != nil {
176				return nil, false, err
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
179				fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("task name is required"))
180			}
181		}
182	
183		for {
184			if !req.ModeExplicit {
185				fallback := "worktree"
186				switch req.Mode {
187				case task.ModeBranch:
188					fallback = "branch-only"
189				case task.ModeDirect:
190					fallback = "direct"
191				}
192				selected, err := p.choice("Mode (w=worktree, b=branch-only, d=direct)", fallback,
193					"worktree (w), branch-only (b), direct (d)", map[string]string{
194						"w": "worktree", "worktree": "worktree",
195						"b": "branch-only", "branch": "branch-only", "branch-only": "branch-only",
196						"d": "direct", "direct": "direct",
197					})
198				if err != nil {
199					return nil, false, err
200				}
201				switch selected {
202				case "direct":
203					req.Mode = task.ModeDirect
204				case "branch-only":
205					req.Mode = task.ModeBranch
206				default:
207					req.Mode = task.ModeWorktree
208				}
209			}
210	
211			if req.Mode == task.ModeDirect {
212				st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
213				if statusErr != nil {
214					return nil, false, statusErr
215				}
216				req.Branch, req.Base = st.Branch, st.Branch
217			} else {
218				if !req.BranchExplicit {
219					fallback := req.Branch
220					if fallback == "" {
221						fallback = "feat/" + config.Slug(req.Name)
222					}
223					req.Branch, err = p.line("Branch", fallback)
224					if err != nil {
225						return nil, false, err
226					}
227				}
228				if !req.BaseExplicit {
229					fallback := req.Base
230					if fallback == "" {
231						fallback = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, r.Path)
232					}
233					req.Base, err = p.line("Base", fallback)
234					if err != nil {
235						return nil, false, err
236					}
237				}
238			}
239			if !req.NextExplicit {
240				req.Next, err = p.line("Next action (optional)", req.Next)
241				if err != nil {
242					return nil, false, err
243				}
244			}
245	
246			spec, buildErr := buildStartSpec(ctx, app, req)
247			if buildErr != nil {
248				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(buildErr.Error()))
249				if req.BranchExplicit || req.BaseExplicit || req.ModeExplicit {
250					return nil, false, buildErr
251				}
252				req.Branch, req.Base = "", ""
253				continue
254			}
255	
256			rt := app.Runtime()
257			checkout := spec.RepoPath
258			if spec.WorktreePath != "" {
259				checkout = spec.WorktreePath
260			}
261			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "\n"+p.style.title("Summary"))
262			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s  %s (%s)\n", p.style.label("repository"), spec.RepoName, config.Contract(spec.RepoPath))
263			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("task"), spec.Name)
264			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("mode"), spec.Mode)
265			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s      %s\n", p.style.label("branch"), spec.Branch)
266			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("base"), spec.Base)
267			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s    %s\n", p.style.label("checkout"), config.Contract(checkout))
268			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s   %s\n", p.style.label("provision"), p.style.success(fmt.Sprint(!spec.NoProvision)))
269			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s     %s\n", p.style.label("runtime"), p.style.success(rt.Name()))
270			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s       %s\n", p.style.label("focus"), fmt.Sprint(spec.Focus))
271			if spec.Run != "" {
272				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s         %s\n", p.style.label("run"), "configured for the new Herdr root pane")
273			}
274			if spec.Next != "" {
275				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("next"), spec.Next)
276			}
277	
278			confirmed, err := p.confirm("Create this task?", true)
279			if err != nil {
280				return nil, false, err
281			}
282			return spec, confirmed, nil
283		}
```

```text
 func promptStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, p *prompter, req startRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {

+const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
+
+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}
```

```text
97	func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
98		discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
99		if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
100			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
101		}
102	
103		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
104		byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
105		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
106		add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
107			if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
108				return
109			}
110			identity := repository.RealPath
111			if identity == "" {
112				identity = repository.Path
113			}
114			identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
115			if seen[identity] {
116				return
117			}
118			seen[identity] = true
119			byPath[repository.Path] = repository
120			items = append(items, picker.Item{
121				Value:       repository.Path,
122				Label:       repository.Display(),
123				Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
124			})
125		}
126		add(current)
127		for _, repository := range discovered {
128			add(repository)
129		}
130		if len(items) == 0 {
131			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
132		}
133		items = append(items, picker.Item{
134			Value:       manualStartRepository,
135			Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
136			Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
137		})
138	
139		result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
142		}
143		if result.Canceled {
144			return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
145		}
146		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
147			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
148		}
149		selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
150		if !ok {
151			return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
152		}
153		resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
154		if err != nil {
155			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
156		}
157		return resolved, true, nil
158	}
```

```text
1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
153
```

```text
9	func (a *App) canPick() bool {
10		return a.pickerSelect != nil || terminalPair(a.In, a.Out)
11	}
12	
13	// pick opens a selector only when both application streams are terminals. The
14	// bool reports whether an interaction was attempted, allowing callers to retain
15	// their deterministic line-oriented fallback for pipes and tests.
16	func (a *App) pick(ctx context.Context, request picker.Request) (picker.Result, bool, error) {
17		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
18			return picker.Result{}, false, nil
19		}
20		if a.pickerSelect != nil {
21			result, err := a.pickerSelect(ctx, request)
22			return result, true, err
23		}
24		if !a.canPick() {
25			return picker.Result{}, false, nil
26		}
27		result, err := picker.New(a.In, a.Out, a.Err, a.Cfg.Picker.Command).Select(ctx, request)
28		return result, true, err
29	}
```

```text
1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
153
```

```text
17	func promptStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, p *prompter, req startRequest) (repo.Repo, error) {
18		if req.RepoExplicit {
19			return resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, req.RepoRef)
20		}
21	
22		var current repo.Repo
23		if r, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, ""); err == nil {
24			current = r
25		}
26		if app.canPick() {
27			selected, ok, err := pickStartRepository(ctx, app, current)
28			if err != nil {
29				return repo.Repo{}, err
30			}
31			if ok {
32				return selected, nil
33			}
34		}
35		if current.Path == "" {
36			all, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.DefaultOptions())
37			if err != nil {
38				return repo.Repo{}, err
39			}
40			candidates := all[:0:0]
41			for _, r := range all {
42				if r.HasGit && !r.Bare {
43					candidates = append(candidates, r)
44				}
45			}
46			all = candidates
47			if len(all) == 0 {
48				return repo.Repo{}, errors.New("no non-bare repositories found under paths.scan_roots")
49			}
50			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Repositories:"))
51			for i, r := range all {
52				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %d) %-24s %s\n", i+1, r.Display(), config.Contract(r.Path))
53			}
54			fallback := ""
55			if len(all) == 1 {
56				fallback = all[0].Display()
57			}
58			for {
59				value, err := p.line("Repository", fallback)
60				if err != nil {
61					return repo.Repo{}, err
62				}
63				if value == "" {
64					fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("repository is required"))
65					continue
66				}
67				var index int
68				if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(value, "%d", &index); err == nil && index > 0 && index <= len(all) {
69					return all[index-1], nil
70				}
71				r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), value)
72				if err == nil {
73					return r, nil
74				}
75				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(err.Error()))
76			}
77		}
78	
79		for {
80			value, err := p.line("Repository", current.Display())
81			if err != nil {
82				return repo.Repo{}, err
83			}
84			if value == current.Display() || value == current.Name || value == current.Path {
85				return current, nil
86			}
87			r, _, err := repo.Resolve(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), value)
88			if err == nil {
89				return r, nil
90			}
91			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning(err.Error()))
92		}
93	}

95	const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
96	
97	func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
98		discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
99		if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
100			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
101		}
102	
103		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
104		byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
105		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
106		add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
107			if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
108				return
109			}
110			identity := repository.RealPath
111			if identity == "" {
112				identity = repository.Path
113			}
114			identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
115			if seen[identity] {
116				return
117			}
118			seen[identity] = true
119			byPath[repository.Path] = repository
120			items = append(items, picker.Item{
121				Value:       repository.Path,
122				Label:       repository.Display(),
123				Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
124			})
125		}
126		add(current)
127		for _, repository := range discovered {
128			add(repository)
129		}
130		if len(items) == 0 {
131			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
132		}
133		items = append(items, picker.Item{
134			Value:       manualStartRepository,
135			Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
136			Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
137		})
138	
139		result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
140		if err != nil {
141			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
142		}
143		if result.Canceled {
144			return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
145		}
146		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
147			return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
148		}
149		selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
150		if !ok {
151			return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
152		}
153		resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
154		if err != nil {
155			return repo.Repo{}, false, err
156		}
157		return resolved, true, nil
158	}

160	func runStartWizard(ctx context.Context, app *App, req startRequest) (*startSpec, bool, error) {
161		p := newPrompter(app)
162		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Start a tracked change stream"))
163	
164		r, err := promptStartRepository(ctx, app, p, req)
165		if err != nil {
166			return nil, false, err
167		}
168		if r.Bare {
169			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("%s is a bare repository and cannot host a task checkout", r.Display())
170		}
171		req.RepoRef, req.RepoExplicit = r.Path, true
172	
173		for strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
174			req.Name, err = p.line("Task name", "")
175			if err != nil {
176				return nil, false, err
177			}
178			if strings.TrimSpace(req.Name) == "" {
179				fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("task name is required"))
180			}
181		}
182	
183		for {
184			if !req.ModeExplicit {
185				fallback := "worktree"
186				switch req.Mode {
187				case task.ModeBranch:
188					fallback = "branch-only"
189				case task.ModeDirect:
190					fallback = "direct"
191				}
192				selected, err := p.choice("Mode (w=worktree, b=branch-only, d=direct)", fallback,
193					"worktree (w), branch-only (b), direct (d)", map[string]string{
194						"w": "worktree", "worktree": "worktree",
195						"b": "branch-only", "branch": "branch-only", "branch-only": "branch-only",
196						"d": "direct", "direct": "direct",
197					})
198				if err != nil {
199					return nil, false, err
200				}
201				switch selected {
202				case "direct":
203					req.Mode = task.ModeDirect
204				case "branch-only":
205					req.Mode = task.ModeBranch
206				default:
207					req.Mode = task.ModeWorktree
208				}
209			}
210	
211			if req.Mode == task.ModeDirect {
212				st, statusErr := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, r.Path)
213				if statusErr != nil {
214					return nil, false, statusErr
215				}
216				req.Branch, req.Base = st.Branch, st.Branch
217			} else {
218				if !req.BranchExplicit {
219					fallback := req.Branch
220					if fallback == "" {
221						fallback = "feat/" + config.Slug(req.Name)

223					req.Branch, err = p.line("Branch", fallback)

236					}
237				}
238			}
239			if !req.NextExplicit {
240				req.Next, err = p.line("Next action (optional)", req.Next)
241				if err != nil {
242					return nil, false, err
243				}
244			}
245	
246			spec, buildErr := buildStartSpec(ctx, app, req)
```

```text
17	func runRepoNewWizard(app *App, flags repoBootstrapFlags) (repoWorkflowRequest, bool, error) {
18		p := newPrompter(app)
19		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Create a repository"))
20		name, err := p.line("Repository name or clone reference", "")
21		if err != nil {
22			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
23		}
24		if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
25			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, fmt.Errorf("repository name is required")
26		}
27		if looksLikeCloneReference(name) {
28			if err := validateNewAsCloneFlags(flags); err != nil {
29				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
30			}
31			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.dim("detected a clone reference; source history and remote will be preserved"))
32			request, _, confirmed, err := promptRepoCloneWizard(app, p, flags, name, false)
33			return request, confirmed, err
34		}
35		flags.category, err = p.line("Category (optional)", flags.category)
36		if err != nil {
37			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
38		}
39		defaultDestination, err := repoDestination(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot, flags.category, name, flags.path)
40		if err != nil {
41			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
42		}
43		destination, err := p.line("Destination", config.Contract(defaultDestination))
44		if err != nil {
45			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
46		}
47		flags.path = config.Expand(destination)
48	
49		catalog, _, err := loadRepoScaffoldConfig(app, "", false)
50		if err != nil {
51			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
52		}
53		defaultPreset := interactiveDefaultPreset(catalog)
54		flags.preset, err = promptScaffoldPreset(p, catalog, defaultPreset)
55		if err != nil {
56			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
57		}
58		preset, err := catalog.ResolvePreset(flags.preset)
59		if err != nil {
60			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
61		}
62		flags.description, err = p.line("Description (optional)", flags.description)
63		if err != nil {
64			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
65		}
66		customize, err := p.confirm("Customize preset and template options?", repoWizardCustomizationSelected(flags) || presetRequiresWizardInput(preset))
67		if err != nil {
68			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
69		}
70		if customize {
71			templateDefault := preset.Template
72			if flags.template != "" {
73				templateDefault = flags.template
74			}
75			flags.template, err = p.lineWithDisplayFallback(
76				"Template source (optional; local path, Git URL, or owner/repo)",
77				templateDefault,
78				repo.RedactCloneRef(templateDefault),
79			)
80			if err != nil {
81				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
82			}
83			if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(flags.template), "none") {
84				flags.templateRef, flags.templateSubdir = "", ""
85			} else if strings.TrimSpace(flags.template) != "" {
86				refDefault := preset.TemplateRef
87				if flags.templateRef != "" {
88					refDefault = flags.templateRef
89				}
90				flags.templateRef, err = p.line("Template ref (optional branch/tag/commit)", refDefault)
91				if err != nil {
92					return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
93				}
94				subdirDefault := preset.TemplateSubdir
95				if flags.templateSubdir != "" {
96					subdirDefault = flags.templateSubdir
97				}
98				flags.templateSubdir, err = p.line("Template subdirectory (optional)", subdirDefault)
99				if err != nil {
100					return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
101				}
102			}
103			if err := promptScaffoldOptions(p, catalog, flags.preset, &flags); err != nil {
104				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
105			}
106		}
107		if flags.remote || preset.Remote == "ask" {
108			if err := promptUpstream(app, p, name, &flags); err != nil {
109				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
110			}
111		}
112		checkInDefault := presetInitialCheckIn(preset)
113		if flags.checkIn != "" && flags.checkIn != string(repoCheckInAuto) {
114			checkInDefault = flags.checkIn
115		}
116		if flags.remote && (flags.checkIn == "" || flags.checkIn == string(repoCheckInAuto)) {
117			flags.checkIn = string(repoCheckInCommit)
118			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  check-in     commit (required before publishing)")
119		} else {
120			flags.checkIn, err = promptRepoCheckIn(p, checkInDefault)
121			if err != nil {
122				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
123			}
124		}
125		handoffDefault := defaultString(flags.handoff, defaultString(preset.Handoff, "cd"))
126		flags.handoff, err = promptRepoHandoff(p, handoffDefault)
127		if err != nil {
128			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
129		}
130		request, err := buildNewRepoRequest(app, name, flags)
131		if err != nil {
132			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, err
133		}
134		fmt.Fprintln(p.out)
135		renderPreparedRepoScaffold(app, request.Prepared)
136		renderRepoWorkflowSummary(app, request)
137		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Create this repository?", true)
138		return request, confirmed, err
139	}

153	func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
154		manual := func() (string, error) {
155			return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
156		}
157		if !app.canPick() {
158			return manual()
159		}
160	
161		cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
162		sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
163		if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
164			return manual()
165		}
166		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
167		for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
168			if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
169				continue
170			}
171			var details []string
172			if remote.Visibility != "" {
173				details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
174			}
175			if remote.Archived {
176				details = append(details, "archived")
177			}
178			if remote.Description != "" {
179				details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
180			}
181			items = append(items, picker.Item{
182				Value:       remote.CloneURL,
183				Label:       remote.Label(),
184				Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
185			})
186		}
187		if len(items) == 0 {
188			return manual()
189		}
190		items = append(items, picker.Item{
191			Value:       manualCloneReference,
192			Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
193			Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
194		})
195		if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
196			app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
197		}
198		result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
199		if err != nil {
200			return "", err
201		}
202		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
203			if result.Canceled {
204				return "", errPromptCanceled
205			}
206			return manual()
207		}
208		return result.Item.Value, nil
209	}

211	func promptRepoCloneWizard(app *App, p *prompter, flags repoBootstrapFlags, ref string, offerSetup bool) (repoWorkflowRequest, bool, bool, error) {
212		name := repoNameFromRef(repo.RedactCloneRef(ref))
213		if name == "" {
214			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a repository name from %q", ref)
215		}
216		category, err := p.line("Category (optional)", flags.category)
217		if err != nil {
218			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
219		}
220		flags.category = category
221		defaultDestination, err := repoDestination(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot, flags.category, name, flags.path)
222		if err != nil {
223			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
224		}
225		destination, err := p.line("Destination", config.Contract(defaultDestination))
226		if err != nil {
227			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
228		}
229		flags.path = config.Expand(destination)
230		setup := flags.preset != ""
231		if offerSetup && !setup {
232			setup, err = p.confirm("Apply a repository setup preset after cloning?", false)
233			if err != nil {
234				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
235			}
236		}
237		flags.handoff, err = promptRepoHandoff(p, defaultString(flags.handoff, "cd"))
238		if err != nil {
239			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
240		}
241		request, err := buildCloneRepoRequest(app, ref, flags)
242		if err != nil {
243			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
244		}
245		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "\n"+p.style.title("Summary"))
246		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  source       %s\n", repo.RedactCloneRef(ref))
247		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  destination  %s\n", config.Contract(request.Destination))
248		if request.Scaffold.Preset != "" {
249			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  setup        %s\n", request.Scaffold.Preset)
250		} else {
251			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  setup        %t\n", setup)
252		}
253		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  handoff      %s\n", request.Handoff)
254		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Clone this repository?", true)
255		return request, setup, confirmed, err
256	}

339	func promptScaffoldPreset(p *prompter, catalog scaffold.Config, fallback string) (string, error) {
340		names := scaffoldPresetNames(catalog)
341		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, p.style.title("Presets:"))
342		for _, name := range names {
343			preset, _ := catalog.ResolvePreset(name)
344			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %-16s %s\n", name, preset.Description)
345		}
346		for {
347			value, err := p.line("Preset", fallback)
348			if err != nil {
349				return "", err
350			}
351			if _, ok := catalog.Presets[value]; ok {
352				return value, nil
353			}
354			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s\n", p.style.warning("choose one of: "+strings.Join(names, ", ")))
355		}
356	}

358	func promptScaffoldOptions(p *prompter, catalog scaffold.Config, presetName string, flags *repoBootstrapFlags) error {
359		preset, err := catalog.ResolvePreset(presetName)
360		if err != nil {
361			return err
362		}
363		for _, input := range preset.Inputs {
364			label := input.Label
365			if label == "" {
366				label = input.ID
367			}
368			fallback := parseInputDefault(input.Default)
369			switch input.Type {
370			case scaffold.InputBool:
371				value, _ := strconvParseBoolDefault(fallback)
372				chosen, err := p.confirm(label, value)
373				if err != nil {
374					return err
375				}
376				flags.set = replaceSetValue(flags.set, input.ID, fmt.Sprint(chosen))
377			case scaffold.InputChoice:
378				choices := map[string]string{}
379				for _, choice := range input.Choices {
380					choices[strings.ToLower(choice)] = choice
381				}
382				if fallback == "" && len(input.Choices) > 0 {
383					fallback = input.Choices[0]
384				}
385				value, err := p.choice(label+" ("+strings.Join(input.Choices, "/")+")", fallback,
386					strings.Join(input.Choices, ", "), choices)
387				if err != nil {
388					return err
389				}
390				flags.set = replaceSetValue(flags.set, input.ID, value)
391			default:
392				for {
393					value, err := p.line(label, fallback)
394					if err != nil {
395						return err
396					}
397					if input.IsRequired() && strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
398						fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning(label+" is required"))
399						continue
400					}
401					flags.set = replaceSetValue(flags.set, input.ID, value)
402					break
403				}
404			}
405		}
406	
407		readme := preset.Readme != nil && *preset.Readme
408		readme, err = p.confirm("Create README.md?", readme)
409		if err != nil {
410			return err
411		}
412		if presetHasItem(preset, "readme") {
413			setSelection(flags, "readme", readme)
414		}
415	
416		gitignoreFallback := strings.Join(preset.Gitignore, ",")
417		gitignore, err := p.line("Gitignore templates (comma-separated, blank for common only)", gitignoreFallback)
418		if err != nil {
419			return err
420		}
421		flags.gitignore = splitCommaValues(gitignore)
422	
423		licenseFallback := preset.License
424		if licenseFallback == "ask" || licenseFallback == "" {
425			licenseFallback = "none"
426		}
427		flags.license, err = p.line("License (none/mit/apache-2.0/...)", licenseFallback)
428		if err != nil {
429			return err
430		}
431		if flags.license != "" && flags.license != "none" {
432			flags.licenseHolder, err = p.line("License holder", flags.licenseHolder)
433			if err != nil {
434				return err
435			}
436		}
437	
438		if preset.ClaudePlans != nil || presetHasItem(preset, "claude-settings") || presetHasItem(preset, "claude-plans-directory") {
439			claudePlans := preset.ClaudePlans != nil && *preset.ClaudePlans
440			claudePlans, err = p.confirm("Keep Claude plans in .claude/plans?", claudePlans)
441			if err != nil {
442				return err
443			}
444			if presetHasItem(preset, "claude-settings") {
445				setSelection(flags, "claude-settings", claudePlans)
446			}
447			if presetHasItem(preset, "claude-plans-directory") {
448				setSelection(flags, "claude-plans-directory", claudePlans)
449			}
450		}
451	
452		if preset.AgentContract != "" || presetHasItem(preset, "agent-contract") {
453			agentContract := preset.AgentContract != "" && preset.AgentContract != "none"
454			agentContract, err = p.confirm("Create AGENTS.md guidance?", agentContract)
455			if err != nil {
456				return err
457			}
458			if presetHasItem(preset, "agent-contract") {
459				setSelection(flags, "agent-contract", agentContract)
460			}
461		}
462	
463		for _, item := range preset.Catalog {
464			selected, err := p.confirm("Enable "+item.Label+"?", item.IsDefault())
465			if err != nil {
466				return err
467			}
468			setSelection(flags, item.ID, selected)
469		}
470		if len(preset.Skills) > 0 {
471			agentDefault := catalog.DefaultAgents
472			if flags.agents != nil {
473				agentDefault = flags.agents
474			}
475			agents, err := p.line("Skill agents (comma-separated)", strings.Join(agentDefault, ","))
476			if err != nil {
477				return err
478			}
479			flags.agents = splitCommaValues(agents)
480			if len(flags.agents) == 0 {
481				return fmt.Errorf("at least one skill agent is required")
482			}
483		}
484		flags.browseSkills, err = p.confirm("Browse additional skills in the upstream installer?", flags.browseSkills)
485		return err
486	}

488	func promptUpstream(app *App, p *prompter, name string, flags *repoBootstrapFlags) error {
489		create, err := p.confirm("Create a GitHub/GitLab upstream?", flags.remote)
490		if err != nil || !create {
491			flags.remote = false
492			return err
493		}
494		ready := forge.ProbeAll(ctxOf())
495		var available []forge.Readiness
496		for _, candidate := range ready {
497			if candidate.Ready() {
498				available = append(available, candidate)
499			} else {
500				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s: %s (%s)\n", candidate.Forge, candidate.Status, candidate.Action)
501			}
502		}
503		if len(available) == 0 {
504			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "  "+p.style.warning("no authenticated GitHub or GitLab CLI is ready; creating locally only"))
505			flags.remote = false
506			return nil
507		}
508		selected := available[0].Forge
509		if len(available) > 1 {
510			choices := map[string]string{"github": "github", "gh": "github", "gitlab": "gitlab", "gl": "gitlab"}
511			choice, err := p.choice("Forge (github/gitlab)", string(selected), "github, gitlab", choices)
512			if err != nil {
513				return err
514			}
515			selected = forge.Kind(choice)
516		}
517		flags.remote = true
518		flags.forge = string(selected)
519		flags.namespace, err = p.line("Owner / organization / namespace (optional)", flags.namespace)
520		if err != nil {
521			return err
522		}
523		flags.visibility, err = p.choice("Visibility (private/public/internal)", "private",
524			"private, public, internal", map[string]string{
525				"private": "private", "public": "public", "internal": "internal",
526			})
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		flags.push, err = p.confirm("Push the initial branch?", true)
531		_ = name
532		return err
533	}

535	func promptRepoHandoff(p *prompter, fallback string) (string, error) {

537			"stay": "stay", "s": "stay", "cd": "cd", "c": "cd",
538			"open": "open", "o": "open", "start": "start", "t": "start",
539		})
540	}

542	func promptRepoCheckIn(p *prompter, fallback string) (string, error) {
543		return p.choice("Check-in generated changes (commit/stage/none)", fallback, "commit, stage, none", map[string]string{
544			"commit": "commit", "c": "commit",
545			"stage": "stage", "s": "stage",
546			"none": "none", "n": "none",
547		})
548	}

550	func presetInitialCheckIn(preset scaffold.Preset) string {
551		if preset.InitialCheckIn != "" {
552			return preset.InitialCheckIn
553		}
554		if preset.InitialCommit == nil || *preset.InitialCommit {
555			return string(repoCheckInCommit)
556		}
557		return string(repoCheckInNone)
558	}

560	func repoWizardCustomizationSelected(flags repoBootstrapFlags) bool {
561		return flags.template != "" || flags.templateRef != "" || flags.templateSubdir != "" ||
562			flags.gitignore != nil || flags.license != "" || flags.licenseHolder != "" ||
563			len(flags.set) > 0 || len(flags.enable) > 0 || len(flags.disable) > 0 ||
564			flags.agents != nil || flags.browseSkills || flags.importOrphans
565	}
566	
567	func presetRequiresWizardInput(preset scaffold.Preset) bool {
568		for _, input := range preset.Inputs {
569			if input.IsRequired() && strings.TrimSpace(parseInputDefault(input.Default)) == "" {
570				return true
571			}
572		}
573		return false
574	}

576	func renderRepoWorkflowSummary(app *App, request repoWorkflowRequest) {
577		fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().title("Repository workflow"))
578		if template := repoTemplateSummary(request.Template); template != nil {
579			selection := template.Source
580			if template.Ref != "" {
581				selection += "@" + template.Ref
582			}
583			if template.Subdir != "" {
584				selection += "//" + template.Subdir
585			}
```

```text
13	const defaultVisibleRows = 10
14	
15	type builtinModel struct {
16		input    textinput.Model
17		items    []Item
18		visible  []int
19		cursor   int
20		offset   int
21		rows     int
22		width    int
23		done     bool
24		canceled bool
25		selected Item
26	}
27	
28	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
29		input := textinput.New()
30		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
31		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
32		input.Focus()
33		model := builtinModel{
34			input: input,
35			items: append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
36			rows:  defaultVisibleRows,
37		}
38		model.refilter()
39		return model
40	}
41	
42	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
43		return textinput.Blink
44	}
45	
46	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
47		switch msg := message.(type) {
48		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
49			m.width = msg.Width
50			available := msg.Height - 3
51			switch {
52			case available < 1:
53				m.rows = 1
54			case available < defaultVisibleRows:
55				m.rows = available
56			default:
57				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
58			}
59			m.keepVisible()
60			return m, nil
61		case tea.KeyMsg:
62			switch msg.Type {
63			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
64				m.done = true
65				m.canceled = true
66				m.input.Blur()
67				return m, tea.Quit
68			case tea.KeyEnter:
69				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.done = true
73				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
74				m.input.Blur()
75				return m, tea.Quit
76			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
77				m.move(-1)
78				return m, nil
79			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
80				m.move(1)
81				return m, nil
82			}
83		}
84	
85		query := m.input.Value()
86		var command tea.Cmd
87		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
88		if m.input.Value() != query {
89			m.refilter()
90		}
91		return m, command
92	}
93	
94	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
95		if m.done {
96			return "\n"
97		}
98		var out strings.Builder
99		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
100		out.WriteByte('\n')
101		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
102			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
103			return out.String()
104		}
105		end := m.offset + m.rows
106		if end > len(m.visible) {
107			end = len(m.visible)
108		}
109		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
110			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
111			marker := "  "
112			if position == m.cursor {
113				marker = "> "
114			}
115			line := marker + item.Label
116			if item.Description != "" {
117				line += "  " + item.Description
118			}
119			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
120			out.WriteByte('\n')
121		}
122		return out.String()
123	}
124	
125	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
126		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
127		for index, item := range m.items {
128			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
129				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
130			}
131		}
132		m.cursor = 0
133		m.offset = 0
134	}
135	
136	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
137		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
138			return
139		}
140		m.cursor += delta
141		if m.cursor < 0 {
142			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
143		}
144		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
145			m.cursor = 0
146		}
147		m.keepVisible()
148	}
149	
150	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
151		if m.rows <= 0 {
152			m.rows = 1
153		}
154		if m.cursor < m.offset {
155			m.offset = m.cursor
156		}
157		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
158			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
159		}
160	}
161	
162	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
163		if width <= 0 {
164			return value
165		}
166		runes := []rune(value)
167		if len(runes) <= width {
168			return value
169		}
170		if width == 1 {
171			return "…"
172		}
173		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
174	}
175	
176	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
177		program := tea.NewProgram(
178			newBuiltinModel(request),
179			tea.WithInput(s.in),
180			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
181			tea.WithContext(ctx),
182		)
183		final, err := program.Run()
184		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
185			return Result{}, ctxErr
186		}
187		if err != nil {
188			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
189		}
190		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
191		if !ok {
192			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
193		}
194		if model.canceled {
195			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
196		}
197		if !model.done {
198			return Result{}, nil
199		}
200		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
201	}
```

```text
1	// Package textmatch provides the small query language shared by interactive
2	// lists. It deliberately matches terms rather than assigning fuzzy scores so
3	// filtering stays predictable across dev's built-in interfaces.
4	package textmatch
5	
6	import "strings"
7	
8	// Terms reports whether every whitespace-separated query term appears in the
9	// haystack, case-insensitively and in any order. An empty query matches all.
10	func Terms(haystack, query string) bool {
11		haystack = strings.ToLower(haystack)
12		query = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(query))
13		for term := range strings.FieldsSeq(query) {
14			if !strings.Contains(haystack, term) {
15				return false
16			}
17		}
18		return true
19	}
```

```text
97	func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {

247			if buildErr != nil {

249				if req.BranchExplicit || req.BaseExplicit || req.ModeExplicit {
250					return nil, false, buildErr
251				}
252				req.Branch, req.Base = "", ""
253				continue
254			}
255	
256			rt := app.Runtime()
257			checkout := spec.RepoPath
258			if spec.WorktreePath != "" {
259				checkout = spec.WorktreePath
260			}
261			fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "\n"+p.style.title("Summary"))
262			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s  %s (%s)\n", p.style.label("repository"), spec.RepoName, config.Contract(spec.RepoPath))
263			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("task"), spec.Name)
264			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("mode"), spec.Mode)
265			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s      %s\n", p.style.label("branch"), spec.Branch)
266			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("base"), spec.Base)
267			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s    %s\n", p.style.label("checkout"), config.Contract(checkout))
268			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s   %s\n", p.style.label("provision"), p.style.success(fmt.Sprint(!spec.NoProvision)))
269			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s     %s\n", p.style.label("runtime"), p.style.success(rt.Name()))
270			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s       %s\n", p.style.label("focus"), fmt.Sprint(spec.Focus))
271			if spec.Run != "" {
272				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s         %s\n", p.style.label("run"), "configured for the new Herdr root pane")
273			}
274			if spec.Next != "" {
275				fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  %s        %s\n", p.style.label("next"), spec.Next)
276			}
277	
278			confirmed, err := p.confirm("Create this task?", true)
279			if err != nil {
280				return nil, false, err
281			}
282			return spec, confirmed, nil
283		}
284	}
```

```text
190			return nil, err

209			parent := filepath.Dir(path)

212			}

214		}
215	}
```
