239		rootPaneID := launchableStartRootPane(t, runtimeName, opened)
240		return json.NewEncoder(app.Out).Encode(startJSON{
241			TaskID: t.ID, Repo: t.Repo, RepoPath: repoPath, Branch: t.Branch, Base: t.Base,
242			Mode: string(t.EffectiveMode()), WorktreePath: worktreePath, Checkout: checkout,
243			Runtime: startRuntimeJSON{
244				Name: runtimeName, Handle: opened.Handle, Surface: opened.Surface,
245				Opened: opened.Opened, Created: opened.Created, RootPaneID: rootPaneID,
246			},
247		})
248	}
249	
250	func launchableStartRootPane(t *task.Task, runtimeName string, opened runtime.OpenResult) string {
251		if t.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree || runtimeName != "herdr" ||
252			opened.Surface != "worktree" || !opened.Opened || !opened.Created {
253			return ""
254		}
255		return opened.RootPaneID
256	}
257	
258	func startRunUnavailable(result *startResult) error {
259		return fmt.Errorf("task %s was created at %s, but --run was not dispatched: "+
260			"the runtime did not return a newly created first-class Herdr worktree root pane "+
261			"(runtime=%s surface=%s opened=%t created=%t); open it with `dev wt open %s --repo %s` and run the command manually",
262			result.Task.ID, config.Contract(checkoutOf(result.Task)), result.Runtime.Name(),
263			result.Opened.Surface, result.Opened.Opened, result.Opened.Created,
264			result.Task.Branch, result.Task.Repo)
265	}
266	
267	// checkoutOf is where a task's code lives right now.
268	func checkoutOf(t *task.Task) string {
269		if t.WorktreePath != "" {
270			return t.WorktreePath
271		}
272		return t.RepoPath
273	}
274	
275	// annotate pushes the task's state and next action into the runtime as
276	// display-only metadata, so a sidebar can show why a session is open without
277	// anyone having to ask dev.
278	//
279	// For herdr this lands as workspace metadata tokens. A token only renders if
280	// the sidebar row layout in ~/.config/herdr/config.toml names it, e.g.
281	//
282	//	[ui.sidebar.spaces]
283	//	rows = [["state_icon", "workspace", "$stage"], ["branch", "git_status"], ["$next"]]
284	//
285	// Setting a token with no matching layout entry succeeds and shows nothing,
286	// which is why dev never treats a failure here as an error.
287	func annotate(app *App, rt runtime.Runtime, t *task.Task) {
288		if t.RuntimeHandle == "" {
289			return
290		}
291		kv := map[string]string{
292			"stage": t.State.Label(),
293			"next":  t.Next,
294		}
295		if err := rt.Annotate(ctxOf(), t.RuntimeHandle, kv); err != nil {
296			app.warnf("could not annotate the runtime session: %v", err)
297		}
298	}
299	
300	func reportProvision(app *App, res *wt.CreateResult) {
301		p := res.Provision
302		if n := len(p.Copied); n > 0 {
303			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "   copied    %d gitignored file(s): %s\n", n, strings.Join(p.Copied, ", "))
304		}
305		if n := len(p.Linked); n > 0 {
306			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "   linked    %s\n", strings.Join(p.Linked, ", "))
307		}
308		for _, e := range p.Failures {
309			fmt.Fprintf(app.Err, "   warning   %v\n", e)
310		}
311	}
312

```text
1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}
153

8		"github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles/textinput"
9		tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/textmatch"
11	)
12	
13	const defaultVisibleRows = 10
14	
15	type builtinModel struct {
16		input    textinput.Model
17		items    []Item
18		visible  []int
19		cursor   int
20		offset   int
21		rows     int
22		width    int
23		done     bool
24		canceled bool
25		selected Item
26	}
27	
28	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
29		input := textinput.New()
30		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
31		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
32		input.Focus()
33		model := builtinModel{
34			input: input,
35			items: append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
36			rows:  defaultVisibleRows,
37		}
38		model.refilter()
39		return model
40	}
41	
42	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
43		return textinput.Blink
44	}
45	
46	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
47		switch msg := message.(type) {
48		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
49			m.width = msg.Width
50			available := msg.Height - 3
51			switch {
52			case available < 1:
53				m.rows = 1
54			case available < defaultVisibleRows:
55				m.rows = available
56			default:
57				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
58			}
59			m.keepVisible()
60			return m, nil
61		case tea.KeyMsg:
62			switch msg.Type {
63			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
64				m.done = true
65				m.canceled = true
66				m.input.Blur()
67				return m, tea.Quit
68			case tea.KeyEnter:
69				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.done = true
73				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
74				m.input.Blur()
75				return m, tea.Quit
76			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
77				m.move(-1)
78				return m, nil
79			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
80				m.move(1)
81				return m, nil
82			}
83		}
84	
85		query := m.input.Value()
86		var command tea.Cmd
87		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
88		if m.input.Value() != query {
89			m.refilter()
90		}
91		return m, command
92	}
93	
94	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
95		if m.done {
96			return "\n"
97		}
98		var out strings.Builder
99		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
100		out.WriteByte('\n')
101		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
102			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
103			return out.String()
104		}
105		end := m.offset + m.rows
106		if end > len(m.visible) {
107			end = len(m.visible)
108		}
109		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
110			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
111			marker := "  "
112			if position == m.cursor {
113				marker = "> "
114			}
115			line := marker + item.Label
116			if item.Description != "" {
117				line += "  " + item.Description
118			}
119			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
120			out.WriteByte('\n')
121		}
122		return out.String()
123	}
124	
125	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
126		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
127		for index, item := range m.items {
128			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
129				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
130			}
131		}
132		m.cursor = 0
133		m.offset = 0
134	}
135	
136	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
137		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
138			return
139		}
140		m.cursor += delta
141		if m.cursor < 0 {
142			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
143		}
144		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
145			m.cursor = 0
146		}
147		m.keepVisible()
148	}
149	
150	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
151		if m.rows <= 0 {
152			m.rows = 1
153		}
154		if m.cursor < m.offset {
155			m.offset = m.cursor
156		}
157		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
158			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
159		}
160	}
161	
162	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
163		if width <= 0 {
164			return value
165		}
166		runes := []rune(value)
167		if len(runes) <= width {
168			return value
169		}
170		if width == 1 {
171			return "…"
172		}
173		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
174	}
175	
176	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
177		program := tea.NewProgram(
178			newBuiltinModel(request),
179			tea.WithInput(s.in),
180			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
181			tea.WithContext(ctx),
182		)
183		final, err := program.Run()
184		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
185			return Result{}, ctxErr
186		}
187		if err != nil {
188			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
189		}
190		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
191		if !ok {
192			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
193		}
194		if model.canceled {
195			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
196		}
197		if !model.done {
198			return Result{}, nil
199		}
200		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
201	}
202

13	const defaultVisibleRows = 10
14	
15	type builtinModel struct {
16		input    textinput.Model
17		items    []Item
18		visible  []int
19		cursor   int
20		offset   int
21		rows     int
22		width    int
23		done     bool
24		canceled bool
25		selected Item
26	}
27	
28	func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
29		input := textinput.New()
30		input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
31		input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
32		input.Focus()
33		model := builtinModel{
34			input: input,
35			items: append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
36			rows:  defaultVisibleRows,
37		}
38		model.refilter()
39		return model
40	}
41	
42	func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
43		return textinput.Blink
44	}
45	
46	func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
47		switch msg := message.(type) {
48		case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
49			m.width = msg.Width
50			available := msg.Height - 3
51			switch {
52			case available < 1:
53				m.rows = 1
54			case available < defaultVisibleRows:
55				m.rows = available
56			default:
57				m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
58			}
59			m.keepVisible()
60			return m, nil
61		case tea.KeyMsg:
62			switch msg.Type {
63			case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
64				m.done = true
65				m.canceled = true
66				m.input.Blur()
67				return m, tea.Quit
68			case tea.KeyEnter:
69				if len(m.visible) == 0 {
70					return m, nil
71				}
72				m.done = true
73				m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
74				m.input.Blur()
75				return m, tea.Quit
76			case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
77				m.move(-1)
78				return m, nil
79			case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
80				m.move(1)
81				return m, nil
82			}
83		}
84	
85		query := m.input.Value()
86		var command tea.Cmd
87		m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
88		if m.input.Value() != query {
89			m.refilter()
90		}
91		return m, command
92	}
93	
94	func (m builtinModel) View() string {
95		if m.done {
96			return "\n"
97		}
98		var out strings.Builder
99		out.WriteString(m.input.View())
100		out.WriteByte('\n')
101		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
102			out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
103			return out.String()
104		}
105		end := m.offset + m.rows
106		if end > len(m.visible) {
107			end = len(m.visible)
108		}
109		for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
110			item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
111			marker := "  "
112			if position == m.cursor {
113				marker = "> "
114			}
115			line := marker + item.Label
116			if item.Description != "" {
117				line += "  " + item.Description
118			}
119			out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
120			out.WriteByte('\n')
121		}
122		return out.String()
123	}
124	
125	func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
126		m.visible = m.visible[:0]
127		for index, item := range m.items {
128			if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
129				m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
130			}
131		}
132		m.cursor = 0
133		m.offset = 0
134	}
135	
136	func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
137		if len(m.visible) == 0 {
138			return
139		}
140		m.cursor += delta
141		if m.cursor < 0 {
142			m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
143		}
144		if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
145			m.cursor = 0
146		}
147		m.keepVisible()
148	}
149	
150	func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
151		if m.rows <= 0 {
152			m.rows = 1
153		}
154		if m.cursor < m.offset {
155			m.offset = m.cursor
156		}
157		if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
158			m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
159		}
160	}
161	
162	func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
163		if width <= 0 {
164			return value
165		}
166		runes := []rune(value)
167		if len(runes) <= width {
168			return value
169		}
170		if width == 1 {
171			return "…"
172		}
173		return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
174	}
175	
176	func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
177		program := tea.NewProgram(
178			newBuiltinModel(request),
179			tea.WithInput(s.in),
180			tea.WithOutput(s.out),
181			tea.WithContext(ctx),
182		)
183		final, err := program.Run()
184		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
185			return Result{}, ctxErr
186		}
187		if err != nil {
188			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
189		}
190		model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
191		if !ok {
192			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
193		}
194		if model.canceled {
195			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
196		}
197		if !model.done {
198			return Result{}, nil
199		}
200		return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
201	}

+const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
+
+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}

190		items = append(items, picker.Item{

192			Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
193			Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
194		})
195		if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
196			app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
197		}
198		result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
199		if err != nil {
200			return "", err
201		}
202		if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
203			if result.Canceled {
204				return "", errPromptCanceled
205			}
206			return manual()
207		}
208		return result.Item.Value, nil
209	}

608	func setSelection(flags *repoBootstrapFlags, id string, enabled bool) {
609		flags.enable = removeString(flags.enable, id)
610		flags.disable = removeString(flags.disable, id)

618	func replaceSetValue(values []string, key, value string) []string {
619		prefix := key + "="
620		result := values[:0]
621		for _, existing := range values {
622			if !strings.HasPrefix(existing, prefix) {
623				result = append(result, existing)
624			}
625		}
626		return append(result, prefix+value)
627	}
628	
629	func removeString(values []string, remove string) []string {
630		result := values[:0]
631		for _, value := range values {
632			if value != remove {
633				result = append(result, value)
634			}
635		}
636		return result
637	}
638	
639	func splitCommaValues(value string) []string {
640		var result []string
641		for _, part := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
642			if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(part); trimmed != "" {
643				result = append(result, trimmed)
644			}
645		}
646		return result
647	}
648	
649	func defaultString(value, fallback string) string {
650		if value != "" {
651			return value
652		}
653		return fallback
654	}

663		return catalog.DefaultPreset
664	}

666	func strconvParseBoolDefault(value string) (bool, bool) {
667		parsed, err := strconv.ParseBool(value)
668		return parsed, err == nil

330	// Load reads config.toml over the defaults. A missing file is not an error —
331	// dev must be useful with zero setup. A malformed file is, because silently
332	// falling back to defaults would send worktrees to the wrong volume.
333	func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
334		cfg := Default()
335		if path == "" {
336			path = ConfigFile()
337		}
338		md, err := toml.DecodeFile(path, &cfg)
339		switch {
340		case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
341			return cfg, nil
342		case err != nil:
343			return cfg, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
344		}
345		if undecoded := md.Undecoded(); len(undecoded) > 0 {
346			// Unknown keys are usually typos ("worktree_dir" vs "worktree_root").
347			// Warn rather than fail so a newer config still works on an older dev.
348			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dev: warning: unknown key(s) in %s: %v\n", path, undecoded)
349		}
350		cfg.Source = path
351		return cfg, cfg.Validate()
352	}
353	
354	// Validate catches the settings that would otherwise fail deep inside a
355	// worktree create, when a directory has already been made.
356	func (c Config) Validate() error {
357		switch c.Runtime.Backend {
358		case "", "auto", "herdr", "tmux", "zellij", "none":
359		default:
360			return fmt.Errorf("runtime.backend %q: want auto, herdr, tmux, zellij or none", c.Runtime.Backend)
361		}
362		if c.Paths.WorktreePath == "" {
363			return errors.New("paths.worktree_path must not be empty")
364		}
365		if _, err := Render(c.Paths.WorktreePath, c.probeVars()); err != nil {
366			return fmt.Errorf("paths.worktree_path: %w", err)
367		}
368		if err := c.LocalFiles.Limits().Validate(); err != nil {
369			return fmt.Errorf("local_files: %w", err)
370		}
371		switch c.Bootstrap.Layout {
372		case "", "flat", "preserve":
373		default:
374			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.layout %q: want flat or preserve", c.Bootstrap.Layout)
375		}
376		if c.Bootstrap.MaxDepth < 0 {
377			return fmt.Errorf("bootstrap.max_depth must be zero (unlimited) or positive")

1	// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
2	// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
3	// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
4	package picker
5	
6	import (
7		"bytes"
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"os/exec"
13		"strings"
14	)
15	
16	// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
17	// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
18	type Item struct {
19		Value       string
20		Label       string
21		Description string
22	}
23	
24	// Request describes one selection interaction.
25	type Request struct {
26		Prompt       string
27		InitialQuery string
28		Items        []Item
29	}
30	
31	// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
32	type Result struct {
33		Item     Item
34		Selected bool
35		Canceled bool
36	}
37	
38	// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
39	type Selector struct {
40		in       io.Reader
41		out      io.Writer
42		errOut   io.Writer
43		command  []string
44		lookPath func(string) (string, error)
45	}
46	
47	// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
48	// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
49	func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
50		return &Selector{
51			in:       in,
52			out:      out,
53			errOut:   errOut,
54			command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
55			lookPath: exec.LookPath,
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
60	// built-in picker otherwise.
61	func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
62		if len(request.Items) == 0 {
63			return Result{}, nil
64		}
65		if len(s.command) == 0 {
66			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
67		}
68		path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
69		if err != nil {
70			return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
71		}
72		return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
73	}
74	
75	func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
76		lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
77		args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
78		for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
79			args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
80		}
81		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
82		cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
83		if s.errOut == nil {
84			cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
85		} else {
86			cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
87		}
88		var stdout bytes.Buffer
89		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
90	
91		err := cmd.Run()
92		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
93			return Result{}, ctxErr
94		}
95		if err != nil {
96			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
97			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
98				return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
99			}
100			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
101		}
102	
103		selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
104		if err != nil {
105			return Result{}, err
106		}
107		item, ok := items[selected]
108		if !ok {
109			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
110		}
111		return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
115		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
116		output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
117		if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
118			return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
119		}
120		return output, nil
121	}
122	
123	func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
124		lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
125		byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
126		for _, item := range items {
127			label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
128			if label == "" {
129				label = "(unnamed)"
130			}
131			base := label
132			if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
133				base += "\t" + description
134			}
135			line := base
136			for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
137				if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
138					break
139				}
140				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
141			}
142			lines = append(lines, line)
143			byLine[line] = item
144		}
145		return lines, byLine
146	}
147	
148	func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
149		return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
150			return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
151		}), " ")
152	}

541		}

    30	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label

    32	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {

    40	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
    41	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
    42	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
    43		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)

    54			c.Complete = false

    59	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
    60		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {

    62		}

+func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
+	manual := func() (string, error) {
+		return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
+	}
+	if !app.canPick() {
+		return manual()
+	}
+
+	cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
+	sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})
+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
+		app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
+	}
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
+		if result.Canceled {
+			return "", errPromptCanceled
+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil
+}

+## Repository selection
+
+Bare `dev repo clone` uses the existing private forge cache as a candidate list.
+It passes the selected provider's exact clone URL into the normal acquisition
+flow, supports stale/incomplete cache with a warning, and never refreshes the
+network merely because the picker opened. Manual URL, path, and `owner/name`
+entry remains available; a missing or source-mismatched cache goes directly to
+that prompt.
+
+Bare `dev start` uses fast live repository discovery for its picker and performs
+a full resolve after selection. `[picker].command` is one direct argv vector,
+defaulting to `fzf`; no shell evaluates it. A missing executable falls back to
+the built-in Bubble Tea selector, while `command = []` forces that backend.
+Compatible external selectors read lines on stdin and return one unchanged line
+on stdout. See the repository `contrib/` directory for Television and fzf
+composition over `dev repo remote --cached --json`.

17	// Cache is the on-disk forge inventory. It exists for UI latency, not as a
18	// source of truth: the REMOTE tab should open instantly, and r refreshes it.
19	type Cache struct {
20		Version   int                     `json:"version,omitempty"`
21		SourceID  string                  `json:"source_id,omitempty"`
22		FetchedAt time.Time               `json:"fetched_at"`
23		Complete  bool                    `json:"complete,omitempty"`

25		Repos     []RemoteRepo            `json:"repos"`
26	}
27	
28	const (
29		CacheVersion      = 2
30		maxCacheBytes     = 32 << 20
31		maxCachedRepos    = 100_000
32		maxCacheClockSkew = 5 * time.Minute
33	)
34	
35	var cacheWriteLocks sync.Map
36	
37	type ProviderStatus struct {
38		FetchedAt time.Time `json:"fetched_at,omitempty"`
39		Complete  bool      `json:"complete"`
40		Error     string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
41	}
42	
43	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
44	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
45	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
46		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
47		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
48			return Cache{}, false
49		}
50		return c, true
51	}
52	
53	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
54	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
55	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
56		info, err := os.Stat(path)
57		if err != nil || info.Size() < 0 || info.Size() > maxCacheBytes {
58			return Cache{}, false
59		}
60		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Cache{}, false
63		}
64		var c Cache
65		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || !validCache(c, time.Now().UTC()) {
66			return Cache{}, false
67		}
68		if c.Version == 0 {
69			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
70			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
71			c.Complete = false
72		}
73		return c, true
74	}
75	
76	func validCache(c Cache, now time.Time) bool {
77		if (c.Version != 0 && c.Version != CacheVersion) || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() ||
78			c.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) || len(c.Repos) > maxCachedRepos ||
79			!validCacheString(c.SourceID, 128, false) {
80			return false
81		}
82		for kind, status := range c.Providers {
83			if !validForgeKind(kind) || len(status.Error) > 16<<10 || strings.ContainsRune(status.Error, '\x00') ||
84				status.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) {
85				return false
86			}
87		}
88		for _, repository := range c.Repos {
89			if !validForgeKind(repository.Forge) || pathx.ValidateComponent(repository.Name) != nil ||
90				!validCacheString(repository.FullName, 2048, true) ||
91				!validCacheString(repository.Description, 64<<10, false) ||
92				!validCacheString(repository.URL, 8<<10, false) ||
93				!validCacheString(repository.CloneURL, 8<<10, false) ||
94				!validCacheString(repository.SSHURL, 8<<10, false) ||
95				!validCacheString(repository.Visibility, 128, false) ||
96				!validCacheString(repository.DefaultBranch, 1024, false) ||
97				repository.UpdatedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) {
98				return false
99			}
100		}
101		return true
102	}

104	func validForgeKind(kind Kind) bool {
105		return kind == GitHub || kind == GitLab || kind == AzureDevOps
106	}

108	func validCacheString(value string, limit int, required bool) bool {
109		return (!required || strings.TrimSpace(value) != "") && len(value) <= limit && !strings.ContainsRune(value, '\x00')
110	}

112	// FreshFor additionally requires the cache to describe the same configured
113	// provider endpoints/targets. Caches without a source ID remain displayable but

@@ -0,0 +1,201 @@
+package picker
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles/textinput"
+	tea "github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea"
+	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/textmatch"
+)
+
+const defaultVisibleRows = 10
+
+type builtinModel struct {
+	input    textinput.Model
+	items    []Item
+	visible  []int
+	cursor   int
+	offset   int
+	rows     int
+	width    int
+	done     bool
+	canceled bool
+	selected Item
+}
+
+func newBuiltinModel(request Request) builtinModel {
+	input := textinput.New()
+	input.Prompt = fmt.Sprintf("? %s: ", request.Prompt)
+	input.SetValue(request.InitialQuery)
+	input.Focus()
+	model := builtinModel{
+		input: input,
+		items: append([]Item(nil), request.Items...),
+		rows:  defaultVisibleRows,
+	}
+	model.refilter()
+	return model
+}
+
+func (m builtinModel) Init() tea.Cmd {
+	return textinput.Blink
+}
+
+func (m builtinModel) Update(message tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	switch msg := message.(type) {
+	case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
+		m.width = msg.Width
+		available := msg.Height - 3
+		switch {
+		case available < 1:
+			m.rows = 1
+		case available < defaultVisibleRows:
+			m.rows = available
+		default:
+			m.rows = defaultVisibleRows
+		}
+		m.keepVisible()
+		return m, nil
+	case tea.KeyMsg:
+		switch msg.Type {
+		case tea.KeyEsc, tea.KeyCtrlC:
+			m.done = true
+			m.canceled = true
+			m.input.Blur()
+			return m, tea.Quit
+		case tea.KeyEnter:
+			if len(m.visible) == 0 {
+				return m, nil
+			}
+			m.done = true
+			m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]
+			m.input.Blur()
+			return m, tea.Quit
+		case tea.KeyUp, tea.KeyCtrlP:
+			m.move(-1)
+			return m, nil
+		case tea.KeyDown, tea.KeyCtrlN:
+			m.move(1)
+			return m, nil
+		}
+	}
+
+	query := m.input.Value()
+	var command tea.Cmd
+	m.input, command = m.input.Update(message)
+	if m.input.Value() != query {
+		m.refilter()
+	}
+	return m, command
+}
+
+func (m builtinModel) View() string {
+	if m.done {
+		return "\n"
+	}
+	var out strings.Builder
+	out.WriteString(m.input.View())
+	out.WriteByte('\n')
+	if len(m.visible) == 0 {
+		out.WriteString("  No matches\n")
+		return out.String()
+	}
+	end := m.offset + m.rows
+	if end > len(m.visible) {
+		end = len(m.visible)
+	}
+	for position := m.offset; position < end; position++ {
+		item := m.items[m.visible[position]]
+		marker := "  "
+		if position == m.cursor {
+			marker = "> "
+		}
+		line := marker + item.Label
+		if item.Description != "" {
+			line += "  " + item.Description
+		}
+		out.WriteString(clipRunes(line, m.width))
+		out.WriteByte('\n')
+	}
+	return out.String()
+}
+
+func (m *builtinModel) refilter() {
+	m.visible = m.visible[:0]
+	for index, item := range m.items {
+		if textmatch.Terms(item.Label+" "+item.Description, m.input.Value()) {
+			m.visible = append(m.visible, index)
+		}
+	}
+	m.cursor = 0
+	m.offset = 0
+}
+
+func (m *builtinModel) move(delta int) {
+	if len(m.visible) == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	m.cursor += delta
+	if m.cursor < 0 {
+		m.cursor = len(m.visible) - 1
+	}
+	if m.cursor >= len(m.visible) {
+		m.cursor = 0
+	}
+	m.keepVisible()
+}
+
+func (m *builtinModel) keepVisible() {
+	if m.rows <= 0 {
+		m.rows = 1
+	}
+	if m.cursor < m.offset {
+		m.offset = m.cursor
+	}
+	if m.cursor >= m.offset+m.rows {
+		m.offset = m.cursor - m.rows + 1
+	}
+}
+
+func clipRunes(value string, width int) string {
+	if width <= 0 {
+		return value
+	}
+	runes := []rune(value)
+	if len(runes) <= width {
+		return value
+	}
+	if width == 1 {
+		return "…"
+	}
+	return string(runes[:width-1]) + "…"
+}
+
+func (s *Selector) selectBuiltin(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
+	program := tea.NewProgram(
+		newBuiltinModel(request),
+		tea.WithInput(s.in),
+		tea.WithOutput(s.out),
+		tea.WithContext(ctx),
+	)
+	final, err := program.Run()
+	if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
+		return Result{}, ctxErr
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker: %w", err)
+	}
+	model, ok := final.(builtinModel)
+	if !ok {
+		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("built-in picker returned an unexpected model")
+	}
+	if model.canceled {
+		return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
+	}
+	if !model.done {
+		return Result{}, nil
+	}
+	return Result{Item: model.selected, Selected: true}, nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/picker/picker.go b/internal/picker/picker.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8e0345a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/picker/picker.go
@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+// Package picker selects one value from a caller-provided list. It can hand
+// the terminal to a line-oriented external picker such as fzf, and otherwise
+// falls back to dev's built-in Bubble Tea interface.
+package picker
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"os/exec"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// Item is one selectable value. Value is opaque caller data and is never sent
+// to an external picker; Label and Description are display-only.
+type Item struct {
+	Value       string
+	Label       string
+	Description string
+}
+
+// Request describes one selection interaction.
+type Request struct {
+	Prompt       string
+	InitialQuery string
+	Items        []Item
+}
+
+// Result distinguishes a selection from an explicit cancellation.
+type Result struct {
+	Item     Item
+	Selected bool
+	Canceled bool
+}
+
+// Selector owns the streams and optional external command for one application.
+type Selector struct {
+	in       io.Reader
+	out      io.Writer
+	errOut   io.Writer
+	command  []string
+	lookPath func(string) (string, error)
+}
+
+// New constructs a selector. command is an argv vector, not a shell command;
+// an empty vector always selects the built-in backend.
+func New(in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, command []string) *Selector {
+	return &Selector{
+		in:       in,
+		out:      out,
+		errOut:   errOut,
+		command:  append([]string(nil), command...),
+		lookPath: exec.LookPath,
+	}
+}
+
+// Select uses the configured external picker when it is installed and the
+// built-in picker otherwise.
+func (s *Selector) Select(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Result, error) {
+	if len(request.Items) == 0 {
+		return Result{}, nil
+	}
+	if len(s.command) == 0 {
+		return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
+	}
+	path, err := s.lookPath(s.command[0])
+	if err != nil {
+		return s.selectBuiltin(ctx, request)
+	}
+	return s.selectExternal(ctx, path, request)
+}
+
+func (s *Selector) selectExternal(ctx context.Context, path string, request Request) (Result, error) {
+	lines, items := renderCandidates(request.Items)
+	args := make([]string, len(s.command)-1)
+	for index, arg := range s.command[1:] {
+		args[index] = strings.ReplaceAll(arg, "{prompt}", request.Prompt)
+	}
+	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, path, args...)
+	cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines, "\n") + "\n")
+	if s.errOut == nil {
+		cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
+	} else {
+		cmd.Stderr = s.errOut
+	}
+	var stdout bytes.Buffer
+	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
+
+	err := cmd.Run()
+	if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
+		return Result{}, ctxErr
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
+		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) && (exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 || exitErr.ExitCode() == 130) {
+			return Result{Canceled: true}, nil
+		}
+		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	selected, err := selectedLine(stdout.String())
+	if err != nil {
+		return Result{}, err
+	}
+	item, ok := items[selected]
+	if !ok {
+		return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("external picker returned an unknown selection")
+	}
+	return Result{Item: item, Selected: true}, nil
+}
+
+func selectedLine(output string) (string, error) {
+	output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\n")
+	output = strings.TrimSuffix(output, "\r")
+	if output == "" || strings.ContainsAny(output, "\r\n\x00") {
+		return "", errors.New("external picker returned malformed output")
+	}
+	return output, nil
+}
+
+func renderCandidates(items []Item) ([]string, map[string]Item) {
+	lines := make([]string, 0, len(items))
+	byLine := make(map[string]Item, len(items))
+	for _, item := range items {
+		label := cleanDisplay(item.Label)
+		if label == "" {
+			label = "(unnamed)"
+		}
+		base := label
+		if description := cleanDisplay(item.Description); description != "" {
+			base += "\t" + description
+		}
+		line := base
+		for ordinal := 2; ; ordinal++ {
+			if _, exists := byLine[line]; !exists {
+				break
+			}
+			line = fmt.Sprintf("%s\t[%d]", base, ordinal)
+		}
+		lines = append(lines, line)
+		byLine[line] = item
+	}
+	return lines, byLine
+}
+
+func cleanDisplay(value string) string {
+	return strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
+		return r == '\r' || r == '\n' || r == '\t' || r == 0
+	}), " ")
+}
```

CONFIRMED — `byPath` adds O(n) duplicate storage and an unnecessary synchronization invariant: `"byPath[repository.Path] = repository"` mirrors `"Value: repository.Path"`, then only supplies `selected.Path`. Both real picker backends return the exact request item: built-in uses `"m.selected = m.items[m.visible[m.cursor]]"`; external uses `"item, ok := items[selected]"` after mapping rendered lines to original items. The manual sentinel is safely intercepted first by `"result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository"`. Therefore `resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, result.Item.Value)` is equivalent for valid selections and removes the drift-prone map; only the test-only injectable `pickerSelect` can forge an out-of-request item, currently producing the bespoke `"picker returned an unknown repository"` error.

+func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
+	manual := func() (string, error) {
+		return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
+	}
+	if !app.canPick() {
+		return manual()
+	}
+
+	cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
+	sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})
+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
+		app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
+	}
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
+		if result.Canceled {
+			return "", errPromptCanceled
+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil
+}

+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}

43	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
44	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
45	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
46		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
47		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
48			return Cache{}, false
49		}
50		return c, true
51	}

53	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
54	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
55	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
56		info, err := os.Stat(path)
57		if err != nil || info.Size() < 0 || info.Size() > maxCacheBytes {
58			return Cache{}, false
59		}
60		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
61		if err != nil {
62			return Cache{}, false
63		}
64		var c Cache

66			return Cache{}, false
67		}
68		if c.Version == 0 {
69			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
70			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
71			c.Complete = false
72		}
73		return c, true
74	}

76	func validCache(c Cache, now time.Time) bool {
77		if (c.Version != 0 && c.Version != CacheVersion) || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() ||
78			c.FetchedAt.After(now.Add(maxCacheClockSkew)) || len(c.Repos) > maxCachedRepos ||

112	// FreshFor additionally requires the cache to describe the same configured
113	// provider endpoints/targets. Caches without a source ID remain displayable but
114	// are immediately revalidated.
115	func (c Cache) FreshFor(maxAge time.Duration, sourceID string) bool {
116		return sourceID != "" && c.SourceID == sourceID && c.Fresh(maxAge)
117	}

119	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
120		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
121			return false
122		}
123		if maxAge <= 0 {
124			return true
125		}
126		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
127			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
128		}
129		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
130			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
131				return false
132			}
133		}
134		return true
135	}

137	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
138	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
139	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
140		now := time.Now().UTC()
141		providers := map[Kind]ProviderStatus{}
142		for _, repo := range repos {
143			providers[repo.Forge] = ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
144		}
145		return SaveCacheState(path, Cache{Version: CacheVersion, FetchedAt: now, Complete: true, Providers: providers, Repos: repos})
146	}
147	
148	// SaveCacheState atomically replaces the versioned inventory cache.
149	func SaveCacheState(path string, cache Cache) error {
150		return SaveCacheStateContext(context.Background(), path, cache)
151	}
152	
153	// SaveCacheStateContext serializes one cache target and checks cancellation
154	// while holding that ordering boundary. A superseded generation therefore
155	// cannot rename after a newer generation has committed.
156	func SaveCacheStateContext(ctx context.Context, path string, cache Cache) error {
157		if path == "" {
158			return errors.New("empty cache path")
159		}
160		if ctx == nil {
161			ctx = context.Background()
162		}
163		lock := cacheWriteLock(path)
164		lock.Lock()
165		defer lock.Unlock()
166		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
167			return err
168		}
169		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
170			return err
171		}
172		if cache.Version == 0 {
173			cache.Version = CacheVersion
174		}
175		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
176			cache.FetchedAt = time.Now().UTC()
177		}
178		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(cache, "", "  ")
179		if err != nil {
180			return err
181		}
182		b = append(b, '\n')
183		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), ".remotes-*.tmp")
184		if err != nil {
185			return err
186		}
187		name := tmp.Name()
188		defer os.Remove(name)
189		if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
190			tmp.Close()
191			return err
192		}
193		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
194			return err
195		}
196		if err := os.Chmod(name, 0o600); err != nil {
197			return err
198		}
199		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
200			return err
201		}
202		return os.Rename(name, path)
203	}
204	
205	func cacheWriteLock(path string) *sync.Mutex {
206		loaded, _ := cacheWriteLocks.LoadOrStore(filepath.Clean(path), &sync.Mutex{})
207		return loaded.(*sync.Mutex)
208	}

211	// diagnostics.

213		_, err := os.Stat(path)
214		return err == nil || !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)
215	}

72	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.

74	
75	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.

78	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
79	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
80	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
81		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
82		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
83		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
84		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,

86	
87	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
88	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
89	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101	
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108	
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}
131				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
132					return filepath.SkipDir
133				}
134	
135				rel := "."
136				depth := 0
137				if !isRoot {
138					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
139					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
140				}
141	
142				if isRepoDir(path) {
143					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
144					if real == "" {
145						real = path
146					}
147					bare := isBareDir(path)
148					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
149					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
150						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
151						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
152						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
153						return filepath.SkipDir
154					}
155					if !bare && !opts.Fast {
156						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
157							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
158							// project in the repo inventory.
159							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
160								return filepath.SkipDir
161							}
162							identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot
163							real = g.MainRoot
164						}
165					}
166					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
167						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
168						out = append(out, Repo{
169							Name:      name,
170							Path:      path,
171							RealPath:  real,
172							Symlink:   isLink,
173							Root:      rootClean,
174							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
175							GitDir:    gitDir,
176							CommonDir: commonDir,
177							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
178							Bare:      bare,
179							HasGit:    true,
180						})
181					}
182					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
183					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
184					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.

+		if remote.Archived {

+		}

+		}

+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})

+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil

+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())

+	}

+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {

+	}

+	}

+	}

54			keys := make(map[string]bool, len(overrides))
55			for _, override := range overrides {
56				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(override, "=")
57				keys[key] = true
58			}
59			env := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+len(overrides))
60			for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
61				key, _, _ := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
62				if !keys[key] {
63					env = append(env, entry)
64				}
65			}
66			env = append(env, overrides...)
67			cmd.Env = env
68		}

70		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
71		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
72		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {

    30	// LoadCache returns only a fresh, complete cache. TUI callers that can label
    31	// stale rows while refreshing use LoadCacheAny instead.
    32	func LoadCache(path string, maxAge time.Duration) (Cache, bool) {
    33		c, ok := LoadCacheAny(path)
    34		if !ok || !c.Fresh(maxAge) {
    35			return Cache{}, false
    36		}
    37		return c, true
    38	}
    39	
    40	// LoadCacheAny returns a cache regardless of age or completeness. This powers
    41	// stale-while-revalidate UI behavior; callers must inspect Fresh/Complete.
    42	func LoadCacheAny(path string) (Cache, bool) {
    43		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    44		if err != nil {
    45			return Cache{}, false
    46		}
    47		var c Cache
    48		if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) != nil || c.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
    49			return Cache{}, false
    50		}
    51		if c.Version == 0 {
    52			// Version 1 caches were valid snapshots but capped per provider, so they
    53			// are useful for instant display and must immediately be refreshed.
    54			c.Complete = false
    55		}
    56		return c, true
    57	}
    58	
    59	func (c Cache) Fresh(maxAge time.Duration) bool {
    60		if c.Version != CacheVersion || !c.Complete {
    61			return false
    62		}
    63		if maxAge <= 0 {
    64			return true
    65		}
    66		if len(c.Providers) == 0 {
    67			return time.Since(c.FetchedAt) <= maxAge
    68		}
    69		for _, provider := range c.Providers {
    70			if !provider.Complete || provider.Error != "" || provider.FetchedAt.IsZero() || time.Since(provider.FetchedAt) > maxAge {
    71				return false
    72			}
    73		}
    74		return true
    75	}
    76	
    77	// SaveCache atomically replaces the cache. A partial forge response may be
    78	// cached — its FetchedAt still says exactly when it was observed.
    79	func SaveCache(path string, repos []RemoteRepo) error {
    80		now := time.Now().UTC()
    81		providers := map[Kind]ProviderStatus{}
    82		for _, repo := range repos {
    83			providers[repo.Forge] = ProviderStatus{FetchedAt: now, Complete: true}
    84		}
    85		return SaveCacheState(path, Cache{Version: CacheVersion, FetchedAt: now, Complete: true, Providers: providers, Repos: repos})
    86	}

    88	// SaveCacheState atomically replaces the versioned inventory cache.

    91			return errors.New("empty cache path")
    92		}
    93		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {

    95		}
    96		if cache.Version == 0 {

    98		}
    99		if cache.FetchedAt.IsZero() {
   100			cache.FetchedAt = time.Now().UTC()

34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory; CommonDir is shared
38		// by every linked worktree of the clone.
39		GitDir    string

42		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).

45		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
46		// initialise them.
47		HasGit bool
48	}
49

51	func (r Repo) Display() string {
52		if r.Category == "" {

45	func Expand(p string) string {

63	func Contract(p string) string {
64		h := home()

66			return "~"
67		}

69			return "~" + p[len(h):]

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-09-03 09:09:44Z)**_

The contradiction is representable in Go, and the two consumers do assign opposite precedence: start treats cancellation first, while clone accepts an ordinary selected item before it ever checks cancellation. However, the current production backends only emit zero/no-result, cancellation, or selection as mutually exclusive literals; the remaining question is whether any production-accessible seam can bypass those constructors, rather than merely same-package tests.

+func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
+	manual := func() (string, error) {
+		return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
+	}
+	if !app.canPick() {
+		return manual()
+	}
+
+	cache, ok := forge.LoadCacheAny(remoteCachePath())
+	sourceID := remoteCacheSourceID(app)
+	if !ok || (cache.SourceID != "" && cache.SourceID != sourceID) {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(cache.Repos)+1)
+	for _, remote := range cache.Repos {
+		if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		var details []string
+		if remote.Visibility != "" {
+			details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
+		}
+		if remote.Archived {
+			details = append(details, "archived")
+		}
+		if remote.Description != "" {
+			details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
+		}
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       remote.CloneURL,
+			Label:       remote.Label(),
+			Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
+		})
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return manual()
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualCloneReference,
+		Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
+		Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
+	})
+	if !cache.FreshFor(app.Cfg.Forge.CacheTTL.Duration, sourceID) {
+		app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
+	}
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
+		if result.Canceled {
+			return "", errPromptCanceled
+		}
+		return manual()
+	}
+	return result.Item.Value, nil
+}

+const manualStartRepository = "\x00manual-start-repository"
+
+func pickStartRepository(ctx context.Context, app *App, current repo.Repo) (repo.Repo, bool, error) {
+	discovered, err := repo.Discover(ctx, app.Cfg.DiscoveryRoots(), repo.CompletionOptions())
+	if err != nil && current.Path == "" {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+
+	items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(discovered)+2)
+	byPath := make(map[string]repo.Repo, len(discovered)+1)
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(discovered)+1)
+	add := func(repository repo.Repo) {
+		if repository.Path == "" || !repository.HasGit || repository.Bare {
+			return
+		}
+		identity := repository.RealPath
+		if identity == "" {
+			identity = repository.Path
+		}
+		identity = filepath.Clean(identity)
+		if seen[identity] {
+			return
+		}
+		seen[identity] = true
+		byPath[repository.Path] = repository
+		items = append(items, picker.Item{
+			Value:       repository.Path,
+			Label:       repository.Display(),
+			Description: config.Contract(repository.Path),
+		})
+	}
+	add(current)
+	for _, repository := range discovered {
+		add(repository)
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	items = append(items, picker.Item{
+		Value:       manualStartRepository,
+		Label:       "Enter a repository name or path manually…",
+		Description: "resolve a repository not present in the discovered list",
+	})
+
+	result, used, err := app.pick(ctx, picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: items})
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	if result.Canceled {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, errPromptCanceled
+	}
+	if !used || !result.Selected || result.Item.Value == manualStartRepository {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, nil
+	}
+	selected, ok := byPath[result.Item.Value]
+	if !ok {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, fmt.Errorf("picker returned an unknown repository")
+	}
+	resolved, err := resolveStartRepository(ctx, app, selected.Path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return repo.Repo{}, false, err
+	}
+	return resolved, true, nil
+}

1	// Package repo discovers the repositories a user actually owns by walking the
2	// configured scan roots. It answers "what projects do I have?", which is a
3	// different question from "what am I working on?" — that one belongs to
4	// package task.
5	package repo
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"io/fs"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"sort"
13		"strings"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
16	)
17	
18	// Repo is one discovered repository.
19	type Repo struct {
20		// Name is the directory basename, which is how users refer to it.
21		Name string
22		// Path is the absolute path reached through the scan root. It may be a
23		// symlink from a bootstrap index; commands intentionally keep that human
24		// navigation path rather than replacing it with the physical one.
25		Path string
26		// RealPath is the physical checkout path.
27		RealPath string
28		// Symlink reports that Path is an alias to RealPath.
29		Symlink bool
30		// Root is the scan root it was found under.
31		Root string
32		// Category is the path between the scan root and the repo ("Quant",
33		// "Web/Frontend"), empty for a repo sitting directly in the root. It is
34		// human organisation metadata, preserved for `dev graduate` to place new
35		// projects consistently.
36		Category string
37		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory; CommonDir is shared
38		// by every linked worktree of the clone.
39		GitDir    string
40		CommonDir string
41		MainRoot  string
42		// Bare reports a bare repository (a worktree hub).
43		Bare bool
44		// HasGit distinguishes a real repo from a plain directory that was found
45		// in a scan root; non-repos are reported so `dev repo list` can offer to
46		// initialise them.
47		HasGit bool
48	}
49	
50	// Display renders "Category/Name" or just "Name".
51	func (r Repo) Display() string {
52		if r.Category == "" {
53			return r.Name
54		}
55		return r.Category + "/" + r.Name
56	}
57	
58	// Options tunes discovery.
59	type Options struct {
60		// MaxDepth limits how deep below a scan root a repo may be found. The
61		// default layout is <root>/<Category>/<Repo>, so 2 suffices; 3 leaves room
62		// for a nested grouping without walking an entire home directory.
63		MaxDepth int
64		// IncludeNonRepos reports plain directories alongside repositories.
65		IncludeNonRepos bool
66		// Fast avoids per-repository git subprocesses. It is intended for shell
67		// completion: direct .git-file checkouts are skipped as linked worktrees and
68		// symlink aliases are deduplicated by their physical path.
69		Fast bool
70	}
71	
72	// DefaultOptions is the discovery configuration used by dev's commands.
73	func DefaultOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3} }
74	
75	// CompletionOptions trades full Git metadata for interactive latency.
76	func CompletionOptions() Options { return Options{MaxDepth: 3, Fast: true} }
77	
78	// skipDirs are never descended into. These are large, never contain a project
79	// the user organises by hand, and walking them dominates scan time.
80	var skipDirs = map[string]bool{
81		"node_modules": true, ".venv": true, "venv": true, "target": true,
82		"vendor": true, "__pycache__": true, ".tox": true, "dist": true,
83		"build": true, ".next": true, ".cache": true, ".terraform": true,
84		"Library": true, ".Trash": true,
85	}
86	
87	// Discover walks every root and returns the repositories found, sorted by
88	// display name. Unreadable directories are skipped rather than fatal — a scan
89	// root that has been unmounted must not break `dev ls`.
90	func Discover(ctx context.Context, roots []string, opts Options) ([]Repo, error) {
91		if opts.MaxDepth <= 0 {
92			opts.MaxDepth = DefaultOptions().MaxDepth
93		}
94		seen := map[string]bool{}
95		// clone identities stop a physical path and a symlink index from showing
96		// the same repository twice. The first scan root wins, which lets users
97		// choose whether the curated index or the physical hierarchy is their UI
98		// simply by ordering scan_roots.
99		identities := map[string]bool{}
100		var out []Repo
101	
102		for _, root := range roots {
103			info, err := os.Stat(root)
104			if err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
105				continue // a missing scan root is normal on a fresh machine
106			}
107			rootClean := filepath.Clean(root)
108	
109			err = filepath.WalkDir(rootClean, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
110				if err != nil {
111					return nil // unreadable entry: skip, keep walking
112				}
113				if ctx.Err() != nil {
114					return ctx.Err()
115				}
116				isRoot := path == rootClean
117				name := d.Name()
118				isLink := d.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0
119				isDir := d.IsDir()
120				if isLink {
121					// WalkDir does not follow symlinks. Inspect a direct symlink to
122					// a repository, but do not recurse through arbitrary symlinked
123					// containers — bootstrap does that with cycle detection.
124					if info, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
125						isDir = info.IsDir()
126					}
127				}
128				if !isDir {
129					return nil
130				}
131				if !isRoot && (skipDirs[name] || (strings.HasPrefix(name, ".") && name != ".bare")) {
132					return filepath.SkipDir
133				}
134	
135				rel := "."
136				depth := 0
137				if !isRoot {
138					rel, _ = filepath.Rel(rootClean, path)
139					depth = len(strings.Split(rel, string(filepath.Separator)))
140				}
141	
142				if isRepoDir(path) {
143					real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
144					if real == "" {
145						real = path
146					}
147					bare := isBareDir(path)
148					identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot := real, real, real, real
149					if !bare && opts.Fast && gitEntryIsFile(path) {
150						// A direct .git file at a discovered root is a linked
151						// worktree. Submodules are already hidden below their parent
152						// repository because discovery never descends into one.
153						return filepath.SkipDir
154					}
155					if !bare && !opts.Fast {
156						if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
157							// A linked worktree is execution state, not another
158							// project in the repo inventory.
159							if g.IsLinkedWorktree {
160								return filepath.SkipDir
161							}
162							identity, gitDir, commonDir, mainRoot = g.GitCommonDir, g.GitDir, g.GitCommonDir, g.MainRoot
163							real = g.MainRoot
164						}
165					}
166					if !seen[path] && !identities[identity] {
167						seen[path], identities[identity] = true, true
168						out = append(out, Repo{
169							Name:      name,
170							Path:      path,
171							RealPath:  real,
172							Symlink:   isLink,
173							Root:      rootClean,
174							Category:  filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(rel)),
175							GitDir:    gitDir,
176							CommonDir: commonDir,
177							MainRoot:  mainRoot,
178							Bare:      bare,
179							HasGit:    true,
180						})
181					}
182					// Never descend into a repo: its subdirectories are source
183					// code, and any nested .git is a submodule or a worktree that
184					// belongs to this repo, not a project of its own.
185					return filepath.SkipDir
186				}
187				if depth >= opts.MaxDepth {
188					return filepath.SkipDir
189				}
190				if opts.IncludeNonRepos && depth == 1 {
191					if !seen[path] {
192						seen[path] = true
193						out = append(out, Repo{Name: name, Path: path, Root: rootClean, Category: ""})
194					}
195				}
196				return nil
197			})
198			if err != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
199				return out, ctx.Err()
200			}
201		}
202	
203		for i := range out {
204			if out[i].Category == "." {
205				out[i].Category = ""
206			}
207		}
208		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
209			if out[i].Name != out[j].Name {
210				return strings.ToLower(out[i].Name) < strings.ToLower(out[j].Name)
211			}
212			return out[i].Path < out[j].Path
213		})
214		return out, nil
215	}
216	
217	// isRepoDir reports whether path is a repository root: it holds a .git entry
218	// (directory for a normal clone, file for a linked worktree or submodule).
219	func isRepoDir(path string) bool {
220		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git")); err == nil {
221			return true
222		}
223		return isBareDir(path)
224	}
225	
226	func gitEntryIsFile(path string) bool {
227		info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(path, ".git"))
228		return err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular()
229	}
230	
231	// isBareDir recognises a bare repository by its skeleton, without shelling out.
232	func isBareDir(path string) bool {
233		for _, marker := range []string{"HEAD", "objects", "refs"} {
234			if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(path, marker)); err != nil {
235				return false
236			}
237		}
238		return true
239	}
240	
241	// Resolve finds a repo by name, display name, or path.
242	//
243	// Matching is deliberately layered: an exact name or path wins outright, and
244	// only then does a substring search run — so a repo literally named "web"
245	// is never shadowed by "web-frontend".
246	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
247		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, DefaultOptions())
248	}
249	
250	// ResolveCompletion resolves the same references without launching one Git
251	// process per repository in the scan roots.
252	func ResolveCompletion(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
253		return resolve(ctx, roots, ref, CompletionOptions())
254	}
255	
256	func resolve(ctx context.Context, roots []string, ref string, opts Options) (Repo, []Repo, error) {
257		all, err := Discover(ctx, roots, opts)
258		if err != nil {
259			return Repo{}, nil, err
260		}
261		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(ref); err == nil {
262			if g, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, abs); err == nil {
263				real, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs)
264				if real == "" {
265					real = g.MainRoot
266				}
267				// Preserve an explicit navigation alias. The caller named this
268				// path on purpose; resolving it to the physical checkout would
269				// defeat a bootstrap symlink catalog.
270				return Repo{
271					Name: filepath.Base(abs), Path: abs, RealPath: real,
272					Symlink: real != abs, CommonDir: g.GitCommonDir, HasGit: true, Bare: g.Bare,
273				}, nil, nil
274			}
275		}
276		for _, r := range all {
277			if r.Name == ref || r.Display() == ref || r.Path == ref {
278				return r, nil, nil
279			}
280		}
281		needle := strings.ToLower(ref)
282		var hits []Repo
283		for _, r := range all {
284			if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Display()), needle) {
285				hits = append(hits, r)
286			}
287		}
288		switch len(hits) {
289		case 1:
290			return hits[0], nil, nil
291		case 0:
292			return Repo{}, nil, &NotFoundError{Ref: ref}
293		default:
294			return Repo{}, hits, &AmbiguousError{Ref: ref, Candidates: hits}
295		}
296	}
297	
298	// NotFoundError reports a repo reference that matched nothing.
299	type NotFoundError struct{ Ref string }
300	
301	func (e *NotFoundError) Error() string { return "no repository matching " + e.Ref }
302	
303	// AmbiguousError reports a repo reference that matched several repos.
304	type AmbiguousError struct {
305		Ref        string
306		Candidates []Repo
307	}
308	
309	func (e *AmbiguousError) Error() string {
310		names := make([]string, len(e.Candidates))
311		for i, c := range e.Candidates {
312			names[i] = c.Display()
313		}
314		return e.Ref + " is ambiguous: " + strings.Join(names, ", ")
315	}

17	func TestRenderCandidatesKeepsDuplicateItemsDistinct(t *testing.T) {

20			{Value: "second", Label: "same", Description: "description"},
21			{Value: "third", Label: "line\nwith\ttabs", Description: "clean\x00me"},

29				t.Fatalf("line %d maps to %q, want %q", index, got, items[index].Value)
30			}

37	func TestBuiltinModelFiltersNavigatesAndCancels(t *testing.T) {
38		request := Request{Prompt: "Repository", Items: []Item{
39			{Value: "one", Label: "alpha", Description: "service"},
40			{Value: "two", Label: "beta", Description: "service"},
41			{Value: "three", Label: "gamma", Description: "docs"},
42		}}

44		updated, _ := model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyRunes, Runes: []rune("service")})
45		model = updated.(builtinModel)
46		if len(model.visible) != 2 {
47			t.Fatalf("visible = %v", model.visible)
48		}
49		updated, _ = model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyDown})
50		model = updated.(builtinModel)
51		updated, _ = model.Update(struct{}{})
52		model = updated.(builtinModel)
53		if model.cursor != 1 {
54			t.Fatalf("non-input message reset cursor to %d", model.cursor)
55		}
56		updated, _ = model.Update(tea.WindowSizeMsg{Width: 40, Height: 2})
57		model = updated.(builtinModel)
58		if model.rows != 1 || model.cursor != 1 {
59			t.Fatalf("resized model rows=%d cursor=%d", model.rows, model.cursor)
60		}
61		updated, command := model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEnter})
62		model = updated.(builtinModel)
63		if command == nil || !model.done || model.canceled || model.selected.Value != "two" {
64			t.Fatalf("selected model = %+v, command nil = %t", model, command == nil)
65		}
66	
67		model = newBuiltinModel(request)
68		updated, command = model.Update(tea.KeyMsg{Type: tea.KeyEsc})
69		model = updated.(builtinModel)
70		if command == nil || !model.done || !model.canceled {
71			t.Fatalf("canceled model = %+v, command nil = %t", model, command == nil)
72		}
73	}
